izzyondroid:com.tuyafeng.orientationlock.name: Orientation Lock
izzyondroid:com.tuyafeng.orientationlock.description:
Orientation Lock is a simple open source app to lock the screen orientation, for Android 5.0+.
 Features: 
 Minimalist and lightweight: less than 100KB in size;
 Clean design: easy-to-use interface;
 Open source: no dependencies, no ads, no trackers.
 Why Orientation Lock? 
 When using an Android tablet, you might find that some applications do not support landscape mode or specific orientations. This was quite troublesome for me. I tried several screen orientation locking apps available on the market, but they were overloaded with features. I simply needed an app to lock the screen orientation, so I decided to create one myself.
 The principle behind locking the screen orientation is very simple: it involves using a floating window to render a view in a specified orientation. This is just a straightforward application, and I wanted to keep it lightweight. Therefore, I implemented it using native methods without any third-party libraries. Pretty cool, isn’t it?

fdroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.name: Aegis Authenticator
fdroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.summary: Free, secure and open source 2FA app to manage tokens for your online services
fdroid:com.beemdevelopment.aegis.description:
Aegis Authenticator is a free, secure and open source app to manage your 2-step verification tokens for your online services.
 Compatibility 
Aegis supports the HOTP and TOTP algorithms. These two algorithms are industry-standard and widely supported, making Aegis compatible with thousands of services. Any web service that supports Google Authenticator will also work with Aegis Authenticator.
 Encryption and biometric unlock 
All of your one-time passwords are stored in a vault. If you choose to set a password (highly recommended), the vault will be encrypted using strong cryptography. If someone with malicious intent gets a hold of the vault file, it’s impossible for them to retrieve the contents without knowing the password. Entering your password each time you need access to a one-time password can be cumbersome. Fortunately, you can also enable biometric unlock if your device has a biometrics sensor (i.e. fingerprint or face unlock).
 Organization 
Over time, you'll likely accumulate tens of entries in your vault. Aegis Authenticator has lots of organization options to make finding the one you need at a particular moment easier. Set a custom icon for an entry to make it easier to find. Search by account name or service name. Have a lot of one-time passwords? Add them to custom groups for easier access. Personal, Work and Social can each get their own group.
 Backups 
To make sure you will never lose access to your online accounts, Aegis Authenticator can create automatic backups of the vault to a location of your choosing. If your cloud provider supports the Storage Access Framework of Android (like Nextcloud does), it can even create automatic backups to the cloud. Creating manual exports of the vault is also supported.
 Making the switch 
To make the switch easier, Aegis Authenticator can import the entries of lots of other authenticators, including: 2FAS Authenticator, Authenticator Plus, Authy, andOTP, FreeOTP, FreeOTP+, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Steam, TOTP Authenticator and WinAuth (root access is required for the apps that don't have an option to export).
 Feature overview 
 Free and open source
 Secure Encrypted, can be unlocked with a password or biometrics
 Screen capture prevention
 Tap to reveal
 Compatible with Google Authenticator
 Supports industry standard algorithms: HOTP and TOTP
 Lots of ways to add new entries Scan a QR code or an image of one
 Enter details manually
 Import from other popular authenticator apps
 Organization Alphabetic/custom sorting
 Custom or automatically generated icons
 Group entries together
 Advanced entry editing
 Search by name/issuer
 Material design with multiple themes: Light, Dark, AMOLED
 Export (plaintext or encrypted)
 Automatic backups of the vault to a location of your choosing
 Open source and license 
Aegis Authenticator is open source (licensed under GPL v3) and the source code can be found here: http://github.com/beemdevelopment/Aegis

fdroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugin.ck_.name: Cloak
fdroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugin.ck_.summary: A Shadowsocks plugin to enhance censorship circumvention
fdroid:com.github.shadowsocks.plugin.ck_.description:
A Cloak plugin for Shadowsocks .
Cloak is a universal pluggable transport that cryptographically obfuscates proxy traffic as legitimate HTTPS traffic, disguises the proxy server as a normal web server, multiplexes traffic through a fixed amount of TCP connections and provides multi-user usage control.
Cloak works fundamentally by masquerading proxy traffic as normal web browsing traffic. This increases the collateral damage to censorship actions and therefore make it very difficult, if not impossible, for censors to selectively block censorship evasion tools and proxy servers without affecting services that the state may also heavily rely on.
Details on how Cloak works can be found here .
Shadowsocks-android is required, as well as a Cloak-compatible proxy server.

What's Nonocross
Nonocross is a simple number puzzle game based around grids. The game is known by many names Nonograms, Picross, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Hanjie and various others.
- Modes
There are two game modes. You can either practice on a pre-made grid, or you can play a randomly generated grid with custom parameters.
- How to play
The game is relatively simple, the number in each row/column corresponds to the number of filled cells in that row/column. So '3 5' at the beginning of a column means there is a block of 3 cell and a block of 5 cell in that column which are not touching. Once you have the grid in front of you it will all make sense
- Notes
The camera permission is used to share puzzles using QR codes
Nonograms are also known by many other names, including Paint by Numbers, Griddlers, Pic-a-Pix, Picross, Picma, PrismaPixels, Pixel Puzzles, Crucipixel, Edel, FigurePic, Hanjie, HeroGlyphix, Illust-Logic, Japanese Crosswords, Japanese Puzzles, Kare Karala!, Logic Art, Logic Square, Logicolor, Logik-Puzzles, Logimage, Oekaki Logic, Oekaki-Mate, Paint Logic, Picture Logic, Tsunamii, Paint by Sudoku and Binary Coloring Books

Have you ever found yourself standing before a piece of outdoor art, curious about its story?
Or arrived in a new place wondering if there’s any outdoor artwork waiting to be discovered nearby?

PublicArtExplorer’s data is based on the open platforms OpenStreetMap and Wikipedia. Because these platforms are built and maintained by a global community of volunteers, anyone can contribute: if you notice missing details or discover new artworks, you’re encouraged to add or update information directly on OpenStreetMap or Wikipedia. This collective approach means that every contribution helps to improve the app for all users, fostering a shared, up-to-date resource that benefits everyone interested in public art.

Aimed at providing low barrier access to public art as well as instigiating people to add missing information to OSM and Wikipedia for the benefit of others.

fdroid:org.jsl.wfwt.name: WiFi Walkie Talkie
fdroid:org.jsl.wfwt.summary: Talk to other devices on your LAN
fdroid:org.jsl.wfwt.description:
This program transmits sound recorded from microphone to some other devices
running the same program on the same network segment, so works like Walkie
Talkie radio.
Devices find each other by Android NSD (aka Bonjour), no any configuration
required. Unfortunately Android NSD implementation is not stable enough, so
sometimes application can not establish connection properly. Application restart
or device reboot usually helps. Audio data is being transmitted by the unicast
channel, so each device works as a server and as a client at the same time.
Program was implemented as a demonstration of JS-Collider: Java high performance
scalable NIO framework, see https://github.com/js-labs/js-collider .

fdroid:org.ligi.passandroid.name: PassAndroid
fdroid:org.ligi.passandroid.description:
Displays Passbook (*.pkpass) files & shows the Barcode (QR, PDF417 and AZTEC
format). It can be used also when offline.
This app is a viewer for passes - a pass could be a e.g. boarding-pass for your
next flight, a coupon for a nice hot beverage on the destination, a movie
ticket, a membership card - there are a lot of possibilities. Basically it is a
replacement for a piece of paper or plastic you would normally have to carry
with you - so lets save some trees and reduce waste!
 How does it work? 
There are so called espass or pkpass files - you can open them with this app -
e.g. when you receive them via email or get an Download-option. The most
important content is the BarCode ( QR , AZTEC & PDF417which authorizes you most
of the time - but it also has other interesting content like a description -
often a time ( that you now can add to your calendar ) - often also locations (
to give you directions ) - just try It out! The app is offline usable once you
downloaded the pass!

fdroid:ru.wohlsoft.thextech.fdroid.name: TheXTech

This engine preserves full compatibility with levels and episodes made for the original SMBX game, including its repacks. And it's allowed to create brand-new Levels, Episodes, and content packs. **NOTE:** This is a runtime engine only. It requires game packages to be downloaded and unpacked properly. Please follow this instruction in order to get any game work:
https://github.com/TheXTech/TheXTech/wiki/Running-game-assets-on-Android

flathub:org.praat.Praat.name: Praat
flathub:org.praat.Praat.description:
Welcome to Praat! Praat is a speech analysis tool used for doing phonetics by computer. Praat
 can analyse, synthesize, and manipulate speech, and create high-quality pictures for your publications.
 Praat was created by Paul Boersma and David Weenink of the Institute of Phonetics Sciences of the
 University of Amsterdam.
 Some of Praat’s most prominent features are:
 Speech analysis 
 Praat allows you to analyze different aspects of speech including pitch, formant, intensity,
 and voice quality. You have access to spectrograms (a visual representation of sound changing over
 time) and cochleagrams (a specific type of spectrogram more closely resembling how the inner ear
 receives sound).
 Speech synthesis 
 Praat allows you to generate speech from a pitch curve and filters that you create (acoustic
 synthesis), or from muscle activities (articulatory synthesis).
 Speech manipulation 
 Praat gives you the ability to modify existing speech utterances. You can alter pitch, intensity,
 and duration of speech.
 Speech labelling 
 Praat allows you to custom-label your samples using the IPA (International Phonetics Alphabet),
 and annotate your sound segments based on the particular variables you are seeking to analyze.
 Multi-language text-to-speech facilities allow you to segment the sound into words and phonemes.
 Grammar models 
 With Praat, you can try out Optimality-Theoretic and Harmonic-Grammar learning, as well as several
 kinds of neural-network models.
 Statistical analysis 
 Praat allows you to perform several statistical techniques, among which multidimensional scaling,
 principal component analysis, and discriminant analysis.
 For more information, consult the extensive manual in Praat (under Help), and the website, which
 has Praat tutorials in several languages.

firefox-addons:3112982.name: Private WhatsApp – Visual Privacy
firefox-addons:3112982.summary: Protect your WhatsApp Web privacy with smart blur, screen lock, and customizable visual controls.
firefox-addons:3112982.description:
Private WhatsApp is a browser extension designed to give you more control over your visual privacy while using WhatsApp Web.
Whether you are working in a shared office, studying in a public place, or simply prefer a more discreet screen, Private WhatsApp provides customizable tools to help keep sensitive interface content less visible.
 Smart Visual Blur: Blur supported conversations and interface elements.
 Hover to Reveal: Temporarily reveal supported content when needed.
 Adjustable Blur Strength: Customize the intensity of visual effects.
 Sidebar Control: Hide the conversation sidebar for a cleaner screen.
 PIN Protection: Lock the extension interface using a configurable PIN.
 Automatic Lock: Automatically lock after a configured period of inactivity.
 Panic Lock: Quickly activate the lock using the Alt + Shift + P keyboard shortcut.
 Silent Mode: Additional privacy-focused interface behavior.
 Local Settings: Save your preferences using the browser's local extension storage.
 Dynamic Island: Access quick privacy controls directly from a floating toolbar.
Private WhatsApp is designed as a local visual privacy tool. Its settings are stored using the browser's extension storage.
Visual blur is intended to reduce casual visibility of sensitive content. It does not encrypt messages, prevent screenshots, or replace WhatsApp's own account security features.
Configure your preferred privacy settings through the extension popup and enjoy a more discreet WhatsApp Web experience.
Developed by Youssef Sabir .
GitHub: https://github.com/youssefsabir101 
Private WhatsApp is an independent third-party extension and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to WhatsApp or Meta Platforms, Inc.

firefox-addons:2801410.name: Downloader for Instagram™
firefox-addons:2801410.summary: Save photos, videos, reels, stories and highlights in their original quality with one click. Open any profile on the board to download its stories, posts and highlights one by one or all at once.
firefox-addons:2801410.description:
This extension saves photos, videos, reels, stories and highlights in their original quality with one click. Open any profile on the board and download its stories, posts and highlights one by one or all at once.
▣ Features at a glance
● One-click download button on posts, reels, stories and highlights
● The board: search any user and download their stories, posts and highlights, or all of them with Download All
● Pick the files you want, filter them, and see which ones you already downloaded
● Save the sound of a video as an audio file, or its cover as a picture
● Favorites: keep the users you download from most one click away, synced across your browsers
● Multi-picture posts: all of the pictures, or only the one you want
● Folders and file names you choose
● Download history with search and export
● Right-click menu and keyboard shortcuts
● Light and dark mode
● 19 languages
▣ What you can download
● Photos and videos, including every picture of a multi-picture post
● Reels
● Stories and highlights
● Profile pictures in full size
● The sound of a video or reel, as an audio file
● The cover of a video or reel
▣ The download button
The extension adds a download button right where you need it:
● Under each post in your feed and on a post page
● On the right side of reels
● In the top-right corner of stories and highlights
● On the thumbnails of a profile, when you hover them
On a multi-picture post you choose: all of the pictures, or only the one on screen.
▣ The board
Click the extension's icon and a panel opens on the right:
● Search any username, or open a profile and the board follows you there
● See their stories, posts, highlights and profile picture
● Tick the files you want (hold Shift to tick many at once), or download the whole list with Download All
● Filter the list: only photos or videos, only reels, multi-picture posts, or the files you have not downloaded yet
● Files you downloaded before carry a mark
● Click a file to see it large; right-click it to download it, its sound or its cover, or to copy its link
● Download All saves the files, the files with their covers, or only their sound
● Export a list as CSV or JSON, with the caption, date, likes and comments
● Make the board wider, or full screen, and pick small, medium or large tiles
● Add users to your favorites to come back to them quickly
▣ More ways to download
● Right-click a photo or video on the site: download it, the whole post, its sound or its cover, copy its link, or open its owner on the board
● Keyboard shortcut: Alt+Shift+D (Option+Shift+D on a Mac) downloads what is on screen, and Alt+Shift+B opens the board
▣ Your files, your way
● Folders and file names: build them from the username, the media type, the date and more, e.g. IMDownloader/{username}/{mediaType}/{code}
● Image size: the largest one available, or a smaller one
● Download history, kept only on your device (off unless you turn it on), with search and CSV / JSON export
● "Show in folder" right after a download
● Available in 19 languages
▣ Good to know
● No sign-up and no password: it works with the account you are already logged in with
● Private accounts you follow can be downloaded too; nothing you cannot see yourself can be
▣ Free and Pro
Downloading with the button, the right-click menu and the shortcuts is free and has no limit. Stories, profile pictures and screenshots on the board are free too.
On the free plan, some parts of the board have limits:
● Posts: the first page of a user's posts
● Highlights: the first 10 items of each
● Download All: 10 files a day (stories have no limit)
● Favorites: up to 2 users
● Download history: your last 10 downloads
Pro removes these limits, and adds two things the free plan does not have: saving the sound of a video, and exporting a list as CSV or JSON. It is one payment for a year and it does not renew by itself.
▣ Privacy and safety
● Your data stays with you: we never see your account, your password, the profiles you open or what you download
● Files go straight from the site to your computer and pass through no other server: we cannot see them, and we have no wish to
● Your settings, favorites and download history are kept in your browser, never on our servers. Settings and favorites go to your other computers only through your browser's own sync
● No personal data is collected. The most that is sent is anonymous usage statistics, to learn which features are used and where downloads fail
● Every update is reviewed by the browser's own store before it is published, and only then reaches you
▣ Permissions, and why
Only what it needs, nothing more:
● Storage: to keep your settings, favorites and download history in your browser
● Context menus: to add the extension's items to the right-click menu
● Downloads (optional): asked for only if you want your files saved into folders and "Show in folder"
● Access to the site and its image servers: to show the download button and fetch the files you download
▣ Getting started
After installing, reload the tabs you have open, and pin the extension to your toolbar to open the board with one click. The extension's settings and help page open from the board's header.
▣ Updates and support
● The site changes often, and the extension is updated quickly to keep up with it
● A problem or an idea? Write to us from the Contact tab on the settings page; we read every message
Photos and videos belong to the people who posted them. Download only what you have the right to use. This extension is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

bluejetty:00163766:ios.description:
Roamless is one Single Global eSIM™ for travel in 200+ destinations. Choose Unlimited Plans for plenty of data every day at one fixed price, Data Plans for a set amount, or Pay as You Go Credits that never expire. Add a Roamless Number for calls, SMS and 2FA codes.
Roamless gives you full control over your internet and calls with secure service while keeping your existing phone number.
What is Roamless?
Roamless is a travel internet app using a Single Global eSIM™ for reliable connectivity. No more expensive roaming charges, no more managing SIM cards, and no more confusing eSIM stores. Just install your Roamless eSIM once and get online with fast speeds from excellent networks anywhere.
Multiple Ways to Connect:
You can now choose between Pay as You Go, Prepaid Data Plans, or Unlimited Plans.
New: Unlimited Plans
Unlimited Plans are the easy way to stay connected abroad. Pick your destination, choose your days from 1 to 90, and pay one price you know up front. Plenty of data every day, so there are no gigabytes to compare before you buy and no wasted days at the end. Fair usage policy applies.
New: Roamless Numbers
Get a second number with a local US, UK, Canada or Australia prefix, without a physical SIM or even a data plan. Make and receive international calls and SMS, and get your OTP and 2FA codes on your Roamless Number, delivered inside the Roamless app. Messaging and calls to other Roamless users are free. It works independently of your data plans, so you stay reachable even without an eSIM.
New: Verify Number
Use your own Caller ID for all your calls and texts with Verify Number. By verifying your current number, you can make international calls and send SMS. This feature also unlocks free messaging and calls with other Roamless or Verified users (R2R). While your carrier still handles incoming calls and texts, Verify Number gives you the freedom to reach out to anyone using our affordable rates.
International In-App Voice Calls
Make in-app voice calls starting at $0.04/min directly from inside the app. Just open the app and call any phone number worldwide including Europe, North America, Asia, and more.
Why Choose Roamless?
Single Global eSIM: Works in 200+ destinations including the US, Canada, the UK, Turkey, Germany, Australia, Italy, France, Spain, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Japan, China, South Korea, Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
- Data + Voice in one app: Mobile internet and international in-app calling with a single Balance.
- Smart UI: Easily top up, track usage and manage your plans.
- Pay as You Go: Only pay for what you use, no wasted data, no expirations.
- Unlimited hotspot: Tethering allowed, your laptop and tablet share the same connection.
- Transparent pricing: Plans starting $2.45/GB, Pay as You Go starting from $1.95/GB.
- Referral bonuses: Invite friends, get rewarded.
- In-app support: Available to assist you on the go.
How Roamless Works
- Download the Roamless app.
- Set up your Single Global eSIM™ (one-time activation).
- Buy Credits, an Unlimited Plan or a Prepaid Data Plan.
- Start using data and in-app calls when you land.
- Top up anytime, from anywhere.
- Your Credits never expire.
Welcome Bonus
Try Roamless for free: Download now and get 500MB free credits for the free eSIM trial.
Special Offer: Add $20 to your account or buy a plan and get 20% off.
Referral Program
Invite friends and earn rewards:
They get $5 bonus credit.
You get $5 bonus credit, every time.
eSIM Device Compatibility
Roamless works with eSIM-compatible smartphones, tablets, IoT devices, routers and PCs.
Roamless also works with eSIM adapters such as 9esim, 5ber eSIM and esim.me.
See full eSIM compatibility on the Roamless website.

Have you ever gazed at a towering tree or admired a piece of wood, wondering about its story, species, or unique characteristics? With Wood Scanner AI, your curiosity becomes knowledge. Transform every walk in the park or woodworking project into an enlightening experience. Unveil the mysteries of trees and wood with a simple snap.
Your Personal Nature and Woodworking Expert
Effortless Identification: Capture or upload a photo of any tree or wood sample. Our cutting-edge AI analyzes it instantly, providing accurate identification and insightful details.

Unlock a world of discovery with our specialized modes:
Tree Mode: Dive into botany and explore the vast diversity of trees. Identify species by leaves, bark, or silhouette. Understand their ecological roles, growth habits, and contributions to the environment.
Wood Mode: Ideal for woodworkers, artisans, or enthusiasts. Identify wood types from samples or finished products. Gain insights into grain patterns, hardness, durability, and best uses in crafting and construction.

Enhanced Knowledge: Expand your understanding of nature and materials, whether for education, hobby, or professional purposes.
Practical Applications: Make informed decisions in woodworking, landscaping, or conservation efforts with precise information at your fingertips.
Deepen Your Connection with Nature: Cultivate a greater appreciation for the environment by learning about the trees and wood around you.
Convenience and Accessibility: Access a wealth of information anytime, anywhere, right from your phone.
Join a Community of Nature Enthusiasts

bluejetty:00061777:ios.summary: A smarter way to track expenses, book and manage business travel, and earn rewards. TravelBank is the last business travel and expense app you’ll ever need. Create and submit an expense report, book a flight, hotel, or car – all in minutes.
bluejetty:00061777:ios.description:
A smarter way to track expenses, book and manage business travel, and earn rewards. TravelBank is the last business travel and expense app you’ll ever need. Create and submit an expense report, book a flight, hotel, or car – all in minutes.
• Forbes: 6 Travel Apps to Help You Stay Organized While Traveling
• CNN: 15 Best Travel Apps
• Fast Company: 15 Apps to Help You Make and Save Money
• Yahoo Finance: A Better Way to Manage Spend
TravelBank is a free to use app that handles all your business expense and travel needs. Capture receipts on-the-go and we’ll automatically scan them into expenses. Invite your manager to automate approvals, or simply use as a business expense tracker for tax purposes. Find and book flights & hotels based on value, convenience, business amenities, and more. TravelBank is the smartest expense app because it predicts averages for business travel based on real-time data and pricing, while saving your company on travel & expenses costs at the same time.
• Dreading “Expense Report Friday,” spending hours painstakingly processing a stack of receipts into an expense report? Snap a picture of each receipt as you get it, then ditch the entire stack. We’ll scan them and automatically turn them into expenses. Turn a collection of expenses into an expense report and submit as often as you like.
• Automate expenses by syncing your credit card. Advanced machine learning magically pairs receipts with transactions.
• Receipts stuck in your email? Simply forward them to receipts@travelbank.com and we’ll create expenses out of those too.
• Find and book the perfect flights and hotels for your trip, knowing you’ll have access to wifi, power and other amenities you need to make your trip productive and comfortable. 
• See which flights your colleagues are on so you can book the same itinerary and save time.
• 24/7 customer support for travel bookings with US-based travel agents via phone, email and live chat so you can focus on taking care of business.
• Flexible policies and rewards for beating benchmarks incentivize better spending decisions.
The only mobile-first expense and travel manager. Get started in minutes for free today.

► THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX
If you’re the type who’s always watching DIY and home reno videos on social media, come immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Life Dream where you can unleash your creativity and design prowess to transform house
bluejetty:00035393:ios.description:
► THINK OUTSIDE THE BOX
If you’re the type who’s always watching DIY and home reno videos on social media, come immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Life Dream where you can unleash your creativity and design prowess to transform houses, blocks, and even cities. Enjoy captivating gameplay and a relaxing atmosphere as you clean, design, and upgrade to your heart’s content. Download now and embark on a journey of design and delight!
Your beginnings are humble: a rundown home of your own that’s in desperate need of a facelift. Get settled before diving headfirst into home renovations – everything must go in this ultimate dream makeover! From a single house you’ll be able to expand and keep trying your hand at different types of decorations as you expand your renovation and decoration empire.
► FLASHY FEATURES
Supreme customization – Every detail is yours to customize and perfect, down to the furniture, plants, and wallpaper. From tossing out old furniture to painting the walls to finding objects, the possibilities are endless. Plus there are tons of great features that mimic real life DIY like being able to remove stains or having all your dishes fall to the ground if you toss the cupboard for a truly immersive home design experience.
Endless expansions – the world map is your canvas, and your dream designs know no borders in this game! From cozy cottages to towering skyscrapers, decorate and renovate properties around the globe, letting your fashion senses and creativity take the wheel. With endless opportunities for expansion your decorating journey will never end, allowing you to continue dreaming, designing, and expanding.
Stress be gone – Real renovations are hard work, if only there were a way to get the joy from a home makeover but without the stress… Here you’ll be able to dive into a world of calming aesthetics and endless possibilities, where furnishing your dream home is a delightful journey rather than some daunting task. With soothing gameplay and no pressure to rush or beat the clock, you’ll keep coming back to enjoy a few peaceful moments of escape throughout your day.
► ADD A SPLASH OF PERSONALITY
So come indulge in the ultimate blend of fun, relaxation, and creativity with Life Dream, where every tap and swipe leads to great design. Build your dream home from the ground up, carefully transforming each space into a cozy oasis when your imagination reigns supreme, and every detail reflects your unique style. Download today and embark on an exciting journey to create the most stylish houses and cities imaginable!

bluejetty:00098512:ios.description:
Welcome to Tower Battle, the ultimate casual strategy game! 
Draw a line to the enemy base and conquer the tower to win. Guide your soldiers to the victory with simple casual tactics. Connect towers, defend your buildings and takeover the rival kingdom! Select your best units and use special powers to help your troops during the tower war.
Don't let the enemies defeat you! Create your tactics and deploy your troops in the best paths. Conquer towers using tanks, special units and commanders, the strongest allies in the battleground. Create a line through a portal to duplicate the number of troops you send to an enemy base!
Check out this unique features:
- Command your army of quirky characters in this addictive casual tower wargame. 
- Build your defenses, deploy your troops, and conquer enemy towers in epic battles across vibrant landscapes. 
- With intuitive controls and endless tactical possibilities, Tower Battle offers hours of thrilling gameplay for players of all skill levels. 
- Use special troops such as runners, engineers, bombers or mercenaries. Summon unique attacks to reduce enemy's tower attack.
- Think the best strategy to success in this tower game. Choose the correct path and face several enemies at the same time to win.
- Hundreds of symmetrical warfare levels, all of them challenging and full of surprises! Can you conquer all the towers?
Tower Battle is much more than a tower defense strategy game: choose your favorite troops, soldiers and tanks, level them, improve their stats and define the best tactics to win. There are many ways to solve this wargame!
Many levels are waiting for you. It's very easy to play but challenging: connect towers and don't forget to defend your conquered places! Skip obstacles, conquer bases, deploy tanks and change your tactics and strategy following your enemies' moves!
Are you ready to lead your troops to victory? 
Download now and dominate the battlefield!
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

Co-founded by Ma
bluejetty:00096496:ios.description:
Purpose 2.0 is your AI mentor for honest guidance, deeper self-understanding, and clear next steps. Now redesigned with a cleaner, more intuitive experience that makes reflection, insights, and progress easier to navigate.
Co-founded by Mark Manson, 3x New York Times bestselling author of The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck, Purpose helps you make sense of what you’re facing — without generic motivation or one-off answers.
Talk through a difficult decision. Work through a conflict. Understand why you keep repeating the same pattern. Set a goal and stay accountable. Purpose remembers what matters, connects the dots across conversations, and gives you guidance that becomes more personal over time.
HOW PURPOSE WORKS
• Chat anytime
Bring whatever is on your mind — work, relationships, habits, goals, stress, or the feeling that something is off.
• Get guidance built around you
Purpose learns your values, patterns, goals, and blind spots so its responses reflect your life, not a generic script.
• See what you may be missing
Receive personalized insights into your strengths, recurring patterns, growth opportunities, and next steps.
• Turn insight into momentum
Use guided Quests and your personalized growth Journey to reflect, take action, and keep moving forward.
WHY PURPOSE IS DIFFERENT
• Mentoring, not generic chatbot advice
Purpose is built for ongoing personal growth, not isolated questions.
• Honest, compassionate feedback
Get direct guidance that supports you, challenges you, and helps you think more clearly.
• A mentor that grows with you
The more you use Purpose, the better it understands the context behind your decisions and the kind of support that works for you.
• Built on evidence-backed psychological frameworks
Purpose turns reflection into practical guidance you can use in everyday life.
• Privacy and control
Your data is protected, and you can request deletion of your account and data at any time.
PURPOSE CAN HELP WITH
• Career decisions and growth
• Relationships and difficult conversations
• Habits, motivation, and accountability
• Overthinking and mental clutter
• Personal growth and self-reflection
• Goals, direction, and everyday decision-making
NOT THERAPY
Purpose is a personal-growth mentoring tool, not a medical, clinical, or mental health service. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or crisis support. If you are in danger or experiencing a crisis, contact your local emergency services or crisis hotline immediately.
SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS
Subscriptions can be managed or cancelled through your App Store account settings. For support with a web subscription, contact support@purpose.app.
Terms of Service: https://purpose.app/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://purpose.app/privacy-policy/

NEW: Discover "Insights," your next-generation AI assistant. Spark your intuition, delve deeper into your readings, and uncover the meaning of your cards. Ask questions and discover new perspectives.
Explore shamanic and spiritual traditio
bluejetty:00184752:ios.description:
NEW: Discover "Insights," your next-generation AI assistant. Spark your intuition, delve deeper into your readings, and uncover the meaning of your cards. Ask questions and discover new perspectives.
Explore shamanic and spiritual traditions, and use those three beautiful decks created by Frédéric Calendini for daily guidance.
The "Spirit Animal Oracle" is a beautifully illustrated 48-card deck that will help you reconnect with your benevolent and wise animal guides. Use this deck to get deep reflections and insights about your daily issues or long term projects. Let the animal spirits surprise you with their wisdom and compassion.
With the "Shamanic Journey Oracle", embark on a mysterious journey to discover the shamanic traditions of South America. Connect to these ancient cultures and rituals with this gorgeous 52-card oracle. Call upon the spirits of Teacher Plants for guidance and comfort.
And finally, the new "Lessons of the Soul Oracle" will allow you to step into the heart of your past lives — and uncover the timeless lessons they imprinted on your soul. This beautifully illustrated 50-card oracle deck invites you to explore the memories of your past incarnations, and allow them to speak again. Its themes are universal, echoing the cycles of life and helping you bring the best of your past learnings into the present.
Once the 7-day trial is over, you can still use this app as a full-featured, ad-free "Lite" version with a limited number of cards, or unlock each deck for accessing all cards. 
Key features:
– Three decks of 48, 52 and 50 cards, beautifully illustrated, covering many topics regarding daily issues.
– Three types of readings (1, 3 or 5-card readings).
– Save your readings to a journal for further reference.
– Share your readings with your friends, by email or on social networks.
About the author: Frédéric Calendini is a therapist, counselor, writer and entrepreneur. After a personal crisis, he started working with Amazonian shamanism in 2009, and has been following this healing path since then. As a former IT executive, he founded Indie Goes Software, an initiative to gather inspirational authors under the same banner, and share their positive energy and wisdom through mobile apps. Website : www.fredericcalendini.com

bluejetty:00069128:ios.name: Pregnancy Tracker・App by Moms
bluejetty:00069128:ios.summary: Follow your pregnancy week by week with a pregnancy tracker designed for expecting mothers. Monitor your baby’s development, understand changes in your body, calculate your due date, track important health information, and prepare for child
bluejetty:00069128:ios.description:
Follow your pregnancy week by week with a pregnancy tracker designed for expecting mothers. Monitor your baby’s development, understand changes in your body, calculate your due date, track important health information, and prepare for childbirth — all in one app.
PERSONALIZED PREGNANCY TRACKER
See how your baby grows during every week of pregnancy. Learn about fetal development, your baby’s size and milestones, and the physical and emotional changes you may experience in each trimester. Receive personalized pregnancy tips about nutrition, lifestyle, prenatal health, and preparing for birth.
PREGNANCY CALENDAR
Use the pregnancy calendar to follow your gestational age, current trimester, and estimated due date. Schedule prenatal appointments, doctor visits, screenings, ultrasound scans and tests. Timely reminders help you stay organized throughout your pregnancy journey.
PREGNANCY DIARY AND HEALTH TRACKER
Keep a personal pregnancy diary and record your daily symptoms, mood, weight, blood pressure, belly growth, physical activity, and other health information. Track changes over time and keep important details ready for your next prenatal appointment.
WEEK-BY-WEEK BABY DEVELOPMENT
Discover what happens with your baby each week — from early fetal development to the final stages before delivery. Compare your baby’s size with familiar fruits and objects.
BABY KICK COUNTER
Track your baby’s movements with a convenient kick counter. Record kicks and activity sessions to better understand your baby’s movement patterns during pregnancy.
CONTRACTION TIMER
Use the contraction timer and counter to record the duration, frequency, and intervals between contractions. Follow your contraction pattern and distinguish practice contractions from possible signs of labor as you prepare for childbirth.
DUE DATE AND GESTATIONAL AGE CALCULATOR
Calculate your estimated due date, gestational age, current pregnancy week, and trimester. The pregnancy calculator helps you understand how far along you are and follow the timeline leading up to your baby’s birth.
DAILY PREGNANCY ARTICLES
Explore helpful articles about pregnancy symptoms, baby development, prenatal care, nutrition, emotional well-being, relationships, labor, delivery, and postpartum preparation. New educational content provides practical support for expecting mothers.
DOCTOR REPORT
Combine your pregnancy diary, weight, blood pressure, symptoms, and other tracking data into a clear report. Save the report as a PDF or show it on your phone during a doctor visit to discuss your pregnancy progress.
CHECKLISTS AND TO-DO LISTS
Organize prenatal appointments, tests, essential purchases, hospital bag items, birth preparation, and other tasks before your baby arrives.
KEGEL EXERCISES
Practice guided Kegel exercises to support pelvic floor health during pregnancy and help your body prepare for childbirth.
HEALTH APP SYNCHRONIZATION
Securely synchronize compatible pregnancy and health tracking data so your important information stays organized and accessible.
Our goal is to support expecting mothers with useful pregnancy tools and educational content — from the first weeks of pregnancy to labor and delivery.
Have questions or feedback? Contact us at team@wachanga.com.

The subscription costs $1.99 per month.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://wachanga.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://wachanga.com/terms

bluejetty:00064029:ios.name: RunPee
bluejetty:00064029:ios.summary:
You know that feeling. You're watching an amazing movie, your drink kicks in, and you're stuck choosing between missing a key scene or suffering through the rest of the film.
RunPee solves this. We tell you the best times to take a bathroo
bluejetty:00064029:ios.description:
You know that feeling. You're watching an amazing movie, your drink kicks in, and you're stuck choosing between missing a key scene or suffering through the rest of the film.
RunPee solves this. We tell you the best times to take a bathroom break during a movie — without missing anything important. RunPee is 100% free and supported entirely by donations from our community — no paywall.
HOW IT WORKS
Before the movie starts, look up your film in RunPee. You'll see a list of Peetimes, each carefully chosen by our expertly trained staff. Peetimes are scenes in a movie, usually 3-4 minutes long, that are easy to summarize without missing anything important, like a dramatic scene, or funny moment, or exciting action. Each Peetime includes:
 • When to go (a cue so you know exactly when it starts)
 • How long the bathroom break lasts
 • A short summary (hidden unless you tap) of what happened, so you don't have to ask anyone, "What did I miss?"
Start the RunPee timer when the movie begins. The app will gently vibrate 30 seconds before each Peetime starts, so you're never caught off guard.
ANYTHING EXTRA AFTER THE CREDITS?
Wondering if there are post-credits scenes worth staying for? RunPee's "Anything Extra" feature tells you — without spoilers — whether there are mid-credit or end-credit scenes after the movie. No more sitting through 10 minutes of credits for nothing.
PEETIMES FOR EVERY NEW RELEASE
Our team watches every major release and hand-picks the best Peetimes. New movies are added weekly. We've covered over 1,900 movies and counting.
DESIGNED FOR THE THEATER
Dark theme, silent vibration alerts, minimal screen brightness. RunPee is designed to be invisible to everyone in the cinema except you.
NOW IN 42 LANGUAGES
Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and many more. Take RunPee to any movie theater in the world.
TRUSTED BY MOVIEGOERS FOR 18+ YEARS
RunPee was created by Dan Gardner, a moviegoer who had one too many badly-timed bathroom breaks. What started as a simple idea in 2008 has grown into the original movie bathroom break app, trusted by hundreds of thousands of movie fans worldwide.
WHY MOVIEGOERS LOVE RUNPEE
 • Never miss the best scenes during a movie
 • Know exactly when to take a bathroom break
 • Find out if there are post-credits scenes — for free
 • Human-curated Peetimes, not AI-generated
 • 100% free and donation supported — no paywall, no subscriptions required
 • Perfect for long movies, overactive bladders, or anyone who drinks too much soda at the theater
Download RunPee — your bladder will thank you.

Privacy Policy: https://www.runpee.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00039524:ios.summary: ElCoach is a fitness app for men and women that offers home and gym workouts designed for your fitness levels and daily schedule. It also provides a calorie-calculated nutrition plan containing healthy food tailored to your weight and fitne
bluejetty:00039524:ios.description:
ElCoach is a fitness app for men and women that offers home and gym workouts designed for your fitness levels and daily schedule. It also provides a calorie-calculated nutrition plan containing healthy food tailored to your weight and fitness goals, whether your plan is to lose weight, gain weight, or improve tone and fitness, with 24/7 support from fitness and nutrition experts.
How to use ElCoach?
Download the app.
Choose from weight loss or muscle building goals 
Personalize your workout preferences
Select your favorite foods and eliminate those you don’t like.
Get a detailed, tailored diet plan, workout plan, and supplement recommendations designed for your unique health goals.
What benefits do I get from ElCoach subscriptions?
1: Step-by-step exercises based on your goals, demonstrated in video tutorials to avoid mistakes.
2: Fitness programs for men and women to increase muscle mass or overall fitness, form, and tone.
3: Diverse fitness plans for weight loss, muscle mass increase, or overall toning using gym or home equipment or only body weight
4: Diet plans for weight loss, toning, or muscle building.
5: Tailor your number of meals per day. If you practice intermittent fasting, you can choose to have only two meals a day.
6: No need to download a separate step-tracking app; ElCoach allows you to track your steps and overall performance throughout the day by connecting to Apple Health.
7: Download workouts to continue performing them offline.
Types of Workouts on ElCoach:
1: Bodybuilding workouts that focus on using weights and resistance training at the gym. 
2: Weight loss workouts that focus on calorie burn and muscle toning.
3: Home workouts that can be performed anywhere without equipment or with equipment such as dumbbells or resistance bands. 
4: Home workouts for women that target toning the upper and lower body using effective exercises like squats, push-ups, and other form-focused workouts.
5: Fitness and strength workouts.
Benefits of ElCoach Diet:
1: Healthy, light food that is easy to prepare, with a specific calorie count depending on your goals (lose weight, gain weight, or maintain weight).
2: The ability to replace unfavorable ingredients with foods you love.
3: Hundreds of recipes for healthy foods, including ingredients, cooking guides, and delicious pictures.

bluejetty:00087821:ios.name: Memento Database
bluejetty:00087821:ios.summary: Your data. Your rules. Memento Database turns chaos into clarity by giving you full control over how information is stored, organized, and automated. Simple enough for personal lists, yet powerful enough for business and research, it adapts
bluejetty:00087821:ios.description:
Your data. Your rules. Memento Database turns chaos into clarity by giving you full control over how information is stored, organized, and automated. Simple enough for personal lists, yet powerful enough for business and research, it adapts to any workflow. More intuitive than spreadsheets and more flexible than specialized apps, Memento makes data management easy and powerful for everyone.
PERSONAL USE
Memento can replace dozens of apps, helping you organize your life and increasing your efficiency. 
○ Lists of tasks and goals
○ Personal finance and shopping
○ Contacts and events
○ Time management
○ Collections and hobbies - books, music, movies, games, board games, recipes, and more
○ Travel planning
○ Medical and sports records
○ Studying
○ Home inventory
See the use cases in the online catalog. It contains thousands of templates from our community that you can improve upon, or create your own.
BUSINESS USE
Memento allows building any business management system to meet your unique requirements. This could include:
○ Inventory
○ Project management
○ Personnel management
○ Production management
○ Assets management
○ Products catalog
○ CRM
○ Budget 
You can connect all the components of the application and build the logic of working with data in accordance with your business processes. The Memento cloud allows all of your employees to work with databases and provides a flexible system of access control. Small businesses with Memento get the opportunity to create an ERP at low cost. 
NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATIONS
In addition to businesses, Memento is successfully used by non-profit organizations, including schools, hospitals, rescue services, charity funds, and libraries.
TEAMWORK
Memento allows the synchronizing of data with the cloud and provides the following tools for teamwork:
• A flexible system of setting access rights up to the fields in the records
• Comments to records in the database
OFFLINE
Memento supports offline work. You can transfer data in offline mode and synchronize it with the cloud later when your devices connect to the Internet. 
MAC & PC
You can also work with your data on your Mac or PC. This is convenient, if you need to enter or analyze a large amount of information. In addition, the desktop version of the application provides a powerful reporting system based on Jasper Reports. 
AI ASSISTANT
Elevate data management with Memento Database's AI Assistant. This feature lets AI effortlessly create a database structure and entries based on user prompts. Instruct the AI for seamless organization, population, and management of your data. Input and retrieve data effortlessly, gaining insights or performing complex operations with the AI Assistant. Streamline your workflow and maximize efficiency.
KEY FEATURES
• Dozens of types of fields, including text, integer, real, boolean, date/time, rating, checkboxes, radio buttons, currency, image, signature, file, audio, contact, calculation, JavaScript, geolocations, and others.
* Performing Data analysis, including aggregation, sorting, charting, grouping, and filtering entries by any fields.
• Displaying data in the form of a list, a set of cards, a table, or on a map.
• Cloud storage and Teamwork.
• Offline data entry.
• Importing and exporting CSV files.
• Populating database entries at the touch of a button with data from Web services and other sources.
• Scripting in Javascript (fields, triggers, scripted data source).
• Searching entries in database by barcode.
• AI Assistant powered by ChatGPT.
• Reminders.
Privacy Policy: https://mementodatabase.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00128830:ios.name: ZoomNotes Lite
bluejetty:00128830:ios.summary: ZoomNotes Lite is an iPad/iPhone visual note-taking app. It lets you quickly make handwritten notes and sketches on virtual paper, on PDF files, on MS Word, Excel and Powerpoint docs (via GoogleDrive), and over images. Uniquely, it also let
bluejetty:00128830:ios.description:
ZoomNotes Lite is an iPad/iPhone visual note-taking app. It lets you quickly make handwritten notes and sketches on virtual paper, on PDF files, on MS Word, Excel and Powerpoint docs (via GoogleDrive), and over images. Uniquely, it also lets you zoom in and out without arbitrary limits, an invaluable feature for this type of app. It has a free fully functioning pen (although you will be able to try the pens too), and more available as in-app purchases. It has unlimited paper sizes/styles, unlimited colours and line thicknesses, and a large range of ways to share its documents making ZoomNotes the most versatile handwriting/drawing app. 
ZoomNotes Desktop for Mac now also available.
ZoomNotes is much more than a replacement for your trusted paper notebook! 
Compatible with any capacitive stylus pen (although fingers work well too). 
Here some reviews of the app store of the full version-
The best note taking app available! *****
by MarkNance – Version 7.1.4 – Jul 6, 2016
Don’t be put off by all its features! *****
by Stevearcher – Version 7.1.3 – May 24, 2016
Most complete Note app I’ve tried *****
by ItsDartstx – Version 7.1.3 – Apr 20, 2016
Most effective note taking app *****
by John25642 – Version 7.1.3 – Jul 7, 2016
Full featured and innovative *****
by music-major – Version 7.1.3 – May 15, 2016
Hands(writing)-down, best notepad replacement out there. *****
by Jed123zz – Version 7.1.3 – Mar 23, 2016
Free features include: 
-1 Pen type - Felt tip. 
-Huge Zoom Range and Whiteboard page style 
-Rotatable views
-Split screen mode (edit 2 documents at once)
-Digital planning with links, which can also show events and reminders from the Calendar and Reminder apps
-Write over PDF file 
-Write over MS Word, Powerpoint and Excel files (via GoogleDrive)
-Calendar events/reminders :add events linked to your documents, possibly with alarms. The URL in the event links back to the document in ZoomNotes.
-Typed text- limited to a single font, fills and borders 
-Regular shapes and arrows 
-Symbol library 
-Select, scale, rotate and shift 
-Cut, copy, paste (including between documents, pages and other apps) 
-Write over pdf files (markup) 
-Configurable paper types 
-Intuitive folder interface for documents 
-Sharing as PDF files, images, videos or ZoomNotes documents (via email, iTunes, clipboard, Dropbox, Twitter and Evernote) 
-In app printing 
-VGA compatible for use with projectors, monitors and AirPlay 
-Universal app - iPhone and iPad 
-iCloud support
-Geo-located documents; documents can be optionally geo-located and viewed as pins on a map.
-Layers let you control what is visible on a page, also options for 'master layers' which show on all pages.
In app purchases features include:
-7 extra Pen types, including Italic, Gel, Nib, Pencil and Watercolour. 
-Sub-pages (pages within pages within...) 
-Typed text- fully configurable fonts, colours, fills and borders 
-Unlimited colours and line styles 
-Bookmarks with animated playback 
-Insert images from camera or photo library 
-Insert web pages 
-Insert videos from camera or photo library 
-Edit inserted images, including masking and cropping
-Record and playback sounds, including import and export of caf files
- Handwriting recognition (14 different languages).
Please note that the full version of ZoomNotes is equivalent to the Lite version with all the in-app purchases.
There are lots more details including some videos of the app in action at www.zoom-notes.com 
Please remember to leave us a review. If you wish, you can send us feedback directly, we reply to every email sent to support@zoom-notes.com. 
If you experience any problems or bugs in the app, please email us your device information, which iOS version you are running to support@zoom-notes.com and we will fix it asap. 
Twitter - @zoomnotes

bluejetty:00160246:ios.description:
Are you ready to revolutionize your living space? Introducing AI Home, the go-to app for effortlessly visualizing and planning stunning home makeovers. Whether you’re aiming for a simple refresh or a complete transformation, our advanced AI technology makes it all possible with just a few taps on your iOS device.
Key Features:
Instant Transformation:
Capture any room with your smartphone camera and watch as AI House Remodel seamlessly transforms it. Our AI algorithms provide stunning visualizations, allowing you to see potential changes instantly.
Diverse Style Selection:
Explore a wide range of interior design styles, from modern to industrial, tropical, zen, and more. With over 10 unique styles to choose from, you can experiment and find the perfect aesthetic that matches your taste.
Detailed Recommendations:
Beyond simple style changes, our AI offers detailed recommendations on furniture, decor, color schemes, and more. These tailored suggestions help you create a cohesive and harmonious environment.
Real-Time Visualization:
Experience your vision come to life in real-time with our innovative virtual experience feature. See changes instantly and make adjustments on the fly, ensuring every detail is perfect.
Save and Share:
Capture your favorite designs and save them for future reference. Share your transformed spaces with friends, family, or interior designers for valuable feedback and inspiration.
Comprehensive Library:
Stay ahead of the curve with our extensive library of interior design trends and inspirations. Whether you’re looking for the latest styles or classic touches, our app has you covered.
Why AI House Remodel?
Effortless Transformation: Easily visualize and plan your interior design projects with our intuitive interface.
Personalization: Personalize every aspect of your interior design to match your unique style and preferences.
Latest Trends: Stay updated with the latest trends and design ideas.
User-Friendly: Enjoy a seamless and user-friendly experience, making home design accessible to everyone.
Get Started Today
Download AI House Remodel now and unlock a world of interior design possibilities at your fingertips. Redefine your spaces, reimagine your style, and create the home of your dreams with ease. Whether you’re looking to refresh a single room or embark on a complete home makeover, our AI-powered features will streamline the process and ignite your creative spark.
Transform your home today with AI House Remodel – where every space becomes a canvas for innovation and style.

bluejetty:00165011:ios.description:
Pure Ohio Wellness is an Ohio based company consisting of a Level 1 cultivation facility, two dispensaries and a processing facility founded by professional motorcycle rider, Larry Pegram. We are committed to growing,producing, and dispensing only the highest quality products at an affordable price. We believe in respecting and honoring our customers, our co-workers,the environment, and the communities in which we operate.
At our Pure Ohio Wellness cultivation facility, our do-unto-others philosophy dictates we use only natural ingredients in our cultivation,using integrated pest management and environmental controls to control pests. We strongly believe that what we do is superior due to the diligence,passion, integrity, and social consciousness we use during each step of production, from seed to sale. Our goal is to serve the people of Ohio safely and affordably, one flower at a time.
Pure Ohio Processing shares the commitment to quality and purity and processes all of our distillates and oils to the purest, clearest, most natural form we can achieve, while leaving in the natural terpenes and cannabinoids you need to achieve the medicinal quality you are looking for.This will give you a superior experience and eliminates the harsh qualities you find with other processed products.
At Pure Ohio Dispensaries, our customer service representatives are highly trained to assist you in choosing the right product and delivery method for your condition and comfort level. We provide high level security to keep the customers, the employees, and the surrounding community secure. We maintain clean, bright, well-maintained facilities and support the communities around us in charitable ways to ensure that we make better any community we are a part of. We are an Ohio based, Ohio operated, Ohio owned company, so you can rest assured your dollar stays in Ohio when you shop with Pure Ohio Wellness.
We believe that our commitment to each step of the process sets us apart from others. We strive to be a good employer, a good neighbor in the communities that we operate in, and an example to others by our charitable donations.

bluejetty:00130878:ios.description:
Darker is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.
It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Darker, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.
The main features are:
- apply dark mode to various web sites
- Enable night shift - yellow tint that helps your eyes
- Make web pages easier to read
- Read comfortable in night
- Save battery power
- Customizable background color
- Customizable background opacity with a slider
Privacy Policy:
• The Darker extension requires access to the websites you visit to analyze the existing style of the page and to override it with Darker's dark style.
• Darker never collects your browsing data. The only data Darker ‘collects’ are your settings, and those will never leave your device.
-- HOW TO SETUP --
1. Please open the app and click the button on the welcome screen. This will take you to the Settings screen. Then tap Safari (for iPad, check left pane) > Extensions > Darker, then tap the switch to turn it on.
2: On the same screen, tap All Websites > Allow to grant permission to run Darker's extension on Safari on all websites. Now you're all set!
Note: You can tap the "Manage Extensions" icon in your Safari address bar to access the Darker settings.
Note: Safari may display a notice saying that the extension can read your sensitive information and browsing history. This is a general reminder that appears with every extension. Darker will never read or collect any of your personal information such as passwords or credit card numbers. It's completely safe to use. You have my word!
The extension will work on Safari for iOS/iPadOS version 15.0 and above.

bluejetty:00043992:ios.description:
Is it your child’ internet safety that keeps you on your toes? Are you looking for a parental control app to limit the screen time of your child? Then SecureTeen is your all-in-one solution to protect your kids from dangers of the digital age. With SecureTeen Parental Control app, you can keep an eye on your child’s online activities, manage their screen time through device schedules and stay one step ahead of them through location alerts.
Adolescence is a time when kids first become obsessed with the virtual world and absorb almost all the things that they learn there instantaneously. If they’re not protected from the pitfalls of digital space, then it can lead to serious complications and huge problems.
SecureTeen web control filters all the bad content across Safari and all other major browsers so that your kids can absorb only the good content found online.
Using SecureTeen parental control app, parents can configure and set rules for child devices as well, in case their children are using them other than the iOS devices. 
This parenting app also lets parents set time limits the on-screen time of children so that they can develop social skills and pay attention to other important things like homework, sports, etc. 
Here’s how SecureTeen delivers such amazing results: -
-Stay in the know about your child’s online activities 24/7 through SecureTeen web control
- Easily set a device schedule to control screen time 
-- Use Secureteen time scheduling feature to set a timer that lets you set a daily time limit on mobile and tablet usage.
-SecureTeen parental control app allows parents to track their kids’ movements and remain aware of their whereabouts, thus being able to get to them immediately in emergency situations
- Track all Facebook activity and get alerts for suspicious friends & posts with SecureTeen
-Take advantage of SecureTeen’s built-in categories for an extra blanket of security against disgusting online content
-SecureTeen offers keyword-based blocking which can help you shut harmful online content out completely. Use this along with white/black lists to keep your child secure
-Web history logs are created constantly so that parents can keep an eye on what their child is doing online
-Parents can use remote control options to not only keep their child safe but also enhance their device’s protection
-Once you install SecureTeen on your child’s device you will never have to bother them for it ever again. All the information and details gathered by SecureTeen are available for your perusal through an online dashboard
SecureTeen aims to facilitate parents in keeping their children safe with minimal supervision. The internet is the way of the future, and this app is the best choice you have to tackle these dangers.
You can remotely manage SecureTeen at any time by logging into your online dashboard at http://www.secureteen.com/login
Need help? Please call our Toll Free number 1-310-409-0451 or visit the support page at http://support.secureteen.com/

bluejetty:00016358:ios.description:
Eventat is Kuwait's leading online platform for e-ticketing and event management solutions.
Kuwait has a unique social aspect; events, shows, and intellectual forums are held all year-round. These events witness tremendous participation of people from all parts of the country. Throughout the past years, we organized a great number of events and shows, and we noticed something missing. The traditional process of buying tickets and admitting attendees was always unorganized, resulted in long lines, and almost always ended with late admitting. Customers were unhappy.
This is where the idea behind Eventat was born. Our creative team worked hard to overcome this challenge and utilize modern technology to come up with an easy and fast solution for booking tickets and admitting attendees with the least amount of time and effort. Our web platform and mobile app are filled with innovative features that we specially designed with event organizers in mind, including seat selection, e-tickets generation, safe online payment, easy e-admitting solutions, and much more. Today, Eventat is Kuwait's leading online platform for e-ticketing and event management solutions.

bluejetty:00086957:ios.description:
YOUR SAVINGS SHOULD FEEL LIKE PROGRESS
Homes. Holidays. Rainy-day buffers. Futures still taking shape.
Whatever you’re saving for, Blossom is a purpose-built savings and investment app that gives your money a place to work while you’re getting there.
Blossom gives Australians and Kiwis access to professionally managed fixed income investments, with target returns, access options and progress you can see every day.
YOUR SAVINGS SWEET SPOT
Different savings have different jobs. Some need to be within easy reach. Some can be given a little more time to work.
That’s why Blossom gives you three ways to save - so you can find the sweet spot between the return you’re targeting and the access you need.
Blossom Save
For savings you want working harder but accessible when life changes plans.
 ●  Targeting 6.20% p.a.
 ●  Daily withdrawal requests
 ●  Start with just $50
 ●  No account fees
 ●  Earnings calculated daily
Blossom Plus
Give your savings more time to work.
 ●  Targeting 6.70% p.a.
 ●  Quarterly withdrawal requests
 ●  $5,000 minimum
 ●  No account fees
 ●  Earnings calculated daily and posted quarterly
Blossom Grow
Sometimes, progress needs a little space.
 ●  Targeting 7.20% p.a.
 ●  12-month minimum fixed term
 ●  $5,000 minimum
 ●  No account fees
BUILT AROUND WHAT YOU’RE SAVING FOR
Whether it’s a first home, a big trip, a rainy-day buffer or something you haven’t quite named yet, Blossom is designed to help your savings make progress.
Your money is invested in the  Blossom Fund, which invests in a professionally managed fixed income portfolio.
SAVING, YOUR WAY
Blossom is available for:
 ●  Individuals
 ●  Joint accounts (Savings partners)
 ●  Kids accounts (Blossom Kids)
 ●  Businesses & Trusts
 ●  Self-Managed Super Funds (SMSFs)
START IN MINUTES
Download Blossom, create your account and choose the product that suits your savings goals.
Because saving isn’t just about watching a number grow. It’s about getting closer to something.
SAVE WITH PURPOSE
We believe how your money is invested matters. That's why we've adopted an ESG policy that guides our approach to responsible investing. When you fund your account for the first time, we'll plant a tree in a bushfire-affected region.
You can read more about our approach in our ESG policy.
Blossom. Purpose-Built Saving.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Nothing contained in this page or in the Blossom app should be taken as personal financial advice. Any advice is general in nature and does not take into account your individual circumstances, objectives or needs. Consider whether this investment is appropriate for you and seek professional advice before investing.
An investment in the Blossom Fund is not the same as a deposit into a bank account and is subject to investment risk, including possible loss of capital. The targeted rate of return is not guaranteed and returns and distributions may be lower than targeted and may vary. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.

bluejetty:00075973:ios.description:
Total Files is the one stop file manager for iOS, with powerful PDF reader, cloud storage support and much more!
Total Files supports DropBox, Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud Files and offers iOS Files app integration to download and upload to any cloud from any app! 
You'll not need to install a separate app for each storage provider that you want to use from your device! Link all cloud accounts in Total Files and enjoy the full integration with iOS. For example, thanks to the iOS “Files” integration, you can directly save files to one of the cloud linked in Total, simply using the "Save in files” feature available in any apps on your device.
Virtual folders allows to group files that come from different sources (cloud or local). 
The Spotlight indexing of all local contents allows to immediately find and open the file you're looking for, without opening the app!
Our powerful PDF viewer offers annotation capabilities and automatically recognise common shapes and gestures to highlight paragraph 
Main features: 
- iOS 11 Files app integration for ALL clouds linked to the app in read write mode.
- Supports Dropbox, GDrive, OneDrive, iCloud services for remote file storage.
- Search between all contents in the app and in the linked cloud storages thanks to the advanced search 
- Compression and decompression features (zip)
- Spotlight indexing
- PDF editor with annotation, shape recognition 
- Simultaneous linking of multiple Cloud accounts and management of folders shared with other users. 
- Bookmarks and history management. 
- URL autocomplete
- Quick search bar, and enhanced search within all cloud and local files.
- PIN to hide and secure folders.
- Multi-tab browser
Terms of use (EULA) available at: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00034944:ios.description:
Shrink your photos and free up gigabytes of iPhone storage in seconds. Photo Compressor is the all-in-one media compressor that shrinks photos, videos, and audio without sacrificing quality — built for people who actually need the space back.
WHY PHOTO COMPRESSOR
• Compress photos, video, and audio in a single app — no need to juggle three tools
• Shrink photos and cut video file size by up to 90% without visible quality loss
• Built-in AI Cleaner finds big photos, large videos, and storage hogs automatically
• Batch compression: queue your whole camera roll at once and let the app handle the rest
• 100% on-device — your files are never uploaded to a server
• No watermarks. Ever.
PERFECT FOR
• Anyone seeing the "Storage Almost Full" warning on their iPhone
• Creators shrinking photos and videos for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reels
• Professionals sending media via email, WhatsApp, Slack, or Messages
• Anyone who wants to back up more before the next iOS update
PHOTO COMPRESSION
• Smart photo compression that reduces image size without visible quality loss
• Resize picture dimensions or compress in place
• Works with JPG, PNG, HEIC images and Photo Library imports
• Batch process and compress pictures across your entire camera roll
VIDEO COMPRESSION
• Quality presets and a percentage slider for fine control
• Resolution scaling: 4K → 1080p → 720p → 480p, or pick any custom size
• Frame rate adjustment (60 / 30 / 24 fps)
• Bitrate control via industry-standard libx264 CRF encoding
• Supports MP4, MOV, M4V, and other common iPhone formats
• Preview output before you commit
AUDIO COMPRESSION
• Shrink audio files for messaging and sharing
• Adjustable quality settings
• A feature most "video compressors" don't even offer
AI CLEANER — BUILT-IN STORAGE TOOL
• Smart Scan automatically finds your biggest photos, largest videos, and clutter
• Find and remove duplicate photos and junk files that quietly eat your storage
• Quick Clean by category: Large Photos, Large Videos, Screenshots, and more
• See exactly how much space you'll save before you delete anything
• Free, no extra app to install
WIFI TRANSFER
• Send compressed files straight to your Mac or PC over WiFi — no cables, no cloud
• Drag-and-drop simple, works in any browser
PRIVACY FIRST
• All compression happens on your device
• Nothing is uploaded, shared, or analyzed in the cloud
• No tracking your media, no selling your data
Upgrade to Premium:
• Subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchases within the app.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Let us know about any bugs, questions, feature requests or any other suggestions. Thank you!
For more information, please visit:

bluejetty:00062628:ios.description:
Rainbow Web is an unusual three in a row game
Realize your Match-3 player’s potential in a brand new way! You have definitely never seen such a game before!
Are you a three in a row games lover? Do you think you have tried them all and know everything about them? We are glad to present a fresh look at the classic gameplay on unique playing fields. Isn’t it fascinating?
Other amazing details:
- The Villain Spider is crafty: he has woven 12 types of sophisticated webs.
- Don’t lose focus: as soon as the web field is completed, The Wizard Spider spoils everything by tearing the web and freezing the beads.
- Exercise your brains and logic, stay one step ahead: supercombo’s not a panacea!
- Play together with your family: collect letters and combine them into the secret spells!
- Artful puzzles: the sewing machine has never been so complicated!
- Find the hidden objects: be attentive and keep a sharp look-out – magic doesn’t come that easy!
- Unspell the whole town: 10 enchanted workshops with antique interior are ruined.
- Secret levels in the caves: win against the Spider in his lair!
- Charming music and the cutest graphics create coziness and the atmosphere of quiet medieval times.
- Our game is free to download and play and in-app purchases of extra bonuses are available.
Why is the playing field so strange? Because it is the web that the Wizard Spider has entangled the Masters’ town with. The field’s shape will let you think outside the box and realize your three in a row player’s potential in a brand new way! The beads are rainbow colours, collect them all and breathe new life into the Rainbow Kingdom.
Town hall, Blacksmith, Carpenter’s and other workshops are ruined, abandoned and wait for their Hero! By the way, there’s no need to swing a sword, you should only need your brain to solve unusual match-3 puzzles.
The Rainbow Kingdom has no chance for salvation without your help!
We are using Apple Terms of Use (EULA) https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00145176:ios.name: UYGHUR MAN
bluejetty:00145176:ios.summary: Welcome to UYGHUR MAN, a groundbreaking app designed to uplift and connect Uyghurs living in diaspora. We understand the challenges of being far from your homeland, culture, and language. That's why we have created this powerful platform to
bluejetty:00145176:ios.description:
Welcome to UYGHUR MAN, a groundbreaking app designed to uplift and connect Uyghurs living in diaspora. We understand the challenges of being far from your homeland, culture, and language. That's why we have created this powerful platform to bring the beauty of Uyghur language, literature, and heritage right to your fingertips.
At UYGHUR MAN, we believe that language is not just a means of communication; it is the vessel that carries the soul of a culture. Our app opens doors to a world where Uyghur individuals can effortlessly immerse themselves in the richness of their mother tongue, fostering a deep connection to their roots.
Immerse yourself in the richness of Uyghur culture with UYGHUR MAN. Experience mesmerizing Uyghur folk music that transports you to the vibrant streets of our homeland. Explore a curated collection of audio-books, offering knowledge, inspiration, and thrilling adventures that nurture your mind and ignite your imagination. Break language barriers effortlessly with our cutting-edge Uyghur OCR technology, connecting you with Uyghur speakers worldwide. Access our inclusive multilingual dictionary for instant translations, fostering understanding and connection. UYGHUR MAN App celebrates our heritage, empowers your voice, and bridges distances within our global Uyghur community.
Join our vibrant global community of Uyghurs, as we rewrite the narrative, preserve our language, culture, and identity. Let UYGHUR MAN be your compass, uniting hearts worldwide.
ئامېرىكادىكى جەڭگىۋار ئۇيغۇر ياشلىرى ئايلاردىن بۇيان تىرىشچانلىق كۆرسىتىش ئارقىلىق نۆۋەتتە سىز كۆرىۋاتقان «ئۇيغۇرمەن» ئەپ دېتالىنى رويابقا چىقاردى.
مەزكۇر ئەپ دېتال نۆۋەتتە چەتئەلدە ياشاۋاتقان ئۇيغۇرلارنىڭ خىزمەت ۋە تۇرمۇش بېسىمى سەۋەبلىك ئۇيغۇر تىلىدىكى رومان-پوۋستلارنى ئوقۇش ئىمكانىيىتىگە ئىگە بولالمايۋاتقان ياكى شۇ خىلدىكى كىتاب-ماتېرىياللارنى تاپالمايۋاتقان بوشلۇقىنى تولۇقلاپ، يان تېلېفون ئارقىلىق ھەر قانداق ۋاقتتا ئۇيغۇر تىلى بىلەن ئۇچرىشىپ تۇرالايدىغان بىر سەھنىنى ھازىرلىغۇسى.
بۇ ئەپكە تۆۋەندىكىدەك ئىقتىدارلار مۇجەسسەملەنگەن:
1. ئاۋازلىق ئەسەرلەر: ئۇيغۇر تىلىدا يېزىلغان ھەرخىل ژانىرلاردىكى ئەسەرلەرنىڭ ئاۋازلىق نۇسخىسى.
2. ناخشا مۇزىكىلار: ئۇيغۇر ناخشىچىلار تەرىپىدىن ئورۇندالغان مىللىيچە ناخشا مۇزىكىلار.
3. ئېلكىتاپ: ئۇيغۇر تىلىدا يېزىلغان كىتابلارنى يان تېلېفوندا ئوقۇش نۇسخىسى.
4. قوللىنىشچان قوراللار: 
• ئۇيغۇرچە OCR : بۇ تېخنىكا رەسىم ھالىتىدىكى ئۇيغۇرچە خەتلەرنى سۈزۈپ ئېلىپ، نورمال يېزىق ھالىتىگە ئايلاندۇرىدۇ. توغرىلىق دەرىجىسى يۇقىرى. بۇ ھازىرغا قەدەر ئۇيغۇر تىلىدا ئىشلەنگەن ئەپ دېتاللارنىڭ تۈرلۈك ئىقتىدارلىرى ئىچىدىكى تۇنجى بولۇپ ئوتتۇرىغا چىققان يېڭى تېخنىكا ھېسابلىنىدۇ. 
• يېزىق ئايلاندۇرۇش: ئۇيغۇرچە كونا يېزىق، لاتىن يېزىقى ۋە سىلاۋىيەنچە يېزىقلارنى ئۆز-ئارا ئايلاندۇرىدۇ.
• كۆپ تىللىق لۇغەت: ئۇيغۇرچە-ئۇيغۇرچە، ئۇيغۇرچە-ئېنگىلىزچە، ئۇيغۇرچە-خەنزۇچە، ئېنگىلىزچە-ئۇيغۇرچە لۇغەتلەر.
مەزكۇر ئەپ دېتالدىكى بارلىق ئېلانلارنى ئۈچىنچى تەرەپ شېركەتلەر تەمىنلىگەن بولۇپ، بىز بىلەن بىۋاستە ئالاقىسى يوق. ئەگەر بىزگە ئېلان بېرىشنى ياكى ئەسەرلىرىڭىزنى ئېلان قىلىشنى خالىسىڭىز بىز بىلەن ئالاقىلشىڭ. ئېلاندىن كىرگەن كىرىمنى ئەپنىڭ كەلگۈسى راۋاجلىنىشى ئۈچۈن ئىشلىتىمىز.
ئېلخەت ئادىرسىمىز: uyghurmanteam@gmail.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://uyghurman.com/privacy
