bluejetty:00122975:ios.summary: Aplikace My Air přináší mobilní bankovnictví Air Bank a dělá život s penězi jednodušší. Ladíme a plníme ji chytrými funkcemi tak, aby vám peníze dělaly co nejméně starostí, a naopak přinášely radost. Možná zjistíte, že vás bankování s ní do
bluejetty:00122975:ios.description:
Aplikace My Air přináší mobilní bankovnictví Air Bank a dělá život s penězi jednodušší. Ladíme a plníme ji chytrými funkcemi tak, aby vám peníze dělaly co nejméně starostí, a naopak přinášely radost. Možná zjistíte, že vás bankování s ní dokonce baví. 
Už na úvodní obrazovce s Chytrým přehledem vidíte, kolik máte na účtech nebo jak to vypadá s vaší půjčkou. Nejpoužívanější funkce najdete rovnou pod palcem. 
Bezpečí vašich peněz je jasně na prvním místě. I proto máte svoje karty pěkně po ruce a vše, co se na nich šustne, jednoduše pod kontrolou. Třeba limity plateb změníte v mžiku i při čekání u pokladny. 
Jak se vám daří vyjít do příští výplaty? Z grafu rychle poznáte, zda se pochválit nebo je potřeba přibrzdit. 
Platit s námi se ale vyplatí. Můžeme vám totiž vrátit třeba 15 300 Kč za rok díky spoustě odměn a výhod. V aplikaci si jednoduše zapnete ty, které se vám hodí. Včetně exkluzivních výhod pro členy Unity. 
Přemýšlíte, co podniknout se svými úsporami? Klidně se s námi vydejte do světa investic, rádi vás provedeme klik za klikem. 
Učit se hospodařit u nás můžou i děti už od 8 let. S dětskou verzí aplikace to zvládnou hravě. A ta radost, když si naspoří na svoje sny. 
Mohli bychom psát dál a dál o spoustě vychytávek, které v aplikaci najdete. Ale tisíckrát lepší je si ji stáhnout a vyzkoušet. Ať se vám líbí.

bluejetty:00165177:ios.name: Cloaked: Protect your privacy
bluejetty:00165177:ios.summary:
Keep you and your family safe from spam, scams, identity theft, and financial fraud.
Spam can be more than an annoyance - it’s often a symptom of a bigger problem: exposed data that puts you at risk of identity theft and financial fraud. W
bluejetty:00165177:ios.description:
Keep you and your family safe from spam, scams, identity theft, and financial fraud.
Spam can be more than an annoyance - it’s often a symptom of a bigger problem: exposed data that puts you at risk of identity theft and financial fraud. With Cloaked, you gain full control over how, when, and where you share your information, stopping spammers and scammers before they can do serious harm. Stay one step ahead and protect yourself from the threats lurking behind every unwanted email, text, or call.
WHY CHOOSE CLOAKED?
GENERATE UNLIMITED EMAIL & PHONE ALIASES: Cloaked generates working phone numbers, email addresses, passwords, and soon virtual credit cards - so you can hide your real identity when you sign up or shop online. Using aliases for signup and replacing older credentials drastically cuts down spam and exposure.
REMOVE EXPOSED PERSONAL INFO FROM DATA BROKERS: Cloaked scans and removes your data (name, address, age, phone, email) from 140+ brokers, reducing unwanted spam and risk of fraud.
BLOCK SPAM CALLS WITH CALL GUARD: Our Call Guard feature proactively blocks scam, spam, and robocalls. It’s your first line of defense against phishing and fraud attempts via phone.
GET ALERTS WITH DARK WEB MONITORING: Cloaked continuously scans the dark web for your exposed personal info - including breached emails, passwords, and phone numbers - and alerts you instantly if any are found. So you can take action before criminals do.
GET $1 MILLION IDENTITY THEFT INSURANCE: Cloaked gives you peace of mind with $1 million in coverage - protecting you from the financial fallout of an identity theft.
SPAM IS A WARNING SIGN
Getting bombarded by spam emails, texts, and calls isn’t just annoying - it’s often a red flag that your personal data is floating around the internet. Spammers thrive on exposed information, using it to target you with scams that trick you into handing over even more data. But that’s just the beginning. When criminals gain access to enough of your personal details, they can commit identity theft, drain your finances, or even try to open new credit lines in your name.
WHY IT MATTERS
Data brokers collect, buy, and sell your information - everything from your phone number to your shopping habits. Once your details land in the wrong hands, you may start seeing a spike in spam. It’s like the smoke before the fire: while spam is a nuisance, the bigger risk is that the same exposed data could end up in a hacker’s playbook. Phishing links, fake customer support calls, and too-good-to-be-true offers are all designed to steal more of your identity. Before you know it, you could be dealing with fraudulent charges or loans taken out in your name.
HOW CLOAKED KEEPS YOU SAFE
Cloaked gives you working email addresses, phone numbers, and more - no need to share your real credentials. If a site or app experiences a breach, criminals only get your alias instead of your true data. Cloaked also automatically scans and removes your details (name, address, email, phone number) from over 120 data brokers. Less data “out there” means fewer opportunities for spammers and thieves.
With Call Guard, scam calls are blocked before they even reach you. And with Dark Web Monitoring, you’re the first to know if your data ever appears where it shouldn’t. Even if a scammer does slip through, Cloaked backs you with $1 million in identity theft coverage to help cover the financial fallout.
Got a question about Cloaked and what we do? Contact us at support@cloaked.com
Terms of Service
https://www.cloaked.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy
https://www.cloaked.com/privacy-policy

When criminals gain access to enough of your personal details, they can commit identity theft, drain your finances, or even try to open new credit lines in your name.

WHY IT MATTERS

Data brokers collect, buy, and sell your information - everything from your phone number to your shopping habits. Once your details land in the wrong hands, you may start seeing a spike in spam. It’s like the smoke before the fire: while spam is a nuisance, the bigger risk is that the same exposed data could end up in a hacker’s playbook. Phishing links, fake customer support calls, and too-good-to-be-true offers are all designed to steal more of your identity. Before you know it, you could be dealing with fraudulent charges or loans taken out in your name.

HOW CLOAKED KEEPS YOU SAFE

Cloaked gives you working email addresses, phone numbers, and more - no need to share your real credentials. If a site or app experiences a breach, criminals only get your alias instead of your true data. Cloaked also automatically scans and removes your details (name, address, email, phone number) from over 120 data brokers. Less data “out there” means fewer opportunities for spammers and thieves.

With Call Guard, scam calls are blocked before they even reach you. And with Dark Web Monitoring, you’re the first to know if your data ever appears where it shouldn’t. Even if a scammer does slip through, Cloaked backs you with $1 million in identity theft coverage to help cover the financial fallout.

bluejetty:00156339:ios.name: Schneider FreightPower®
bluejetty:00156339:ios.summary:
Schneider FreightPower® – Always delivering, always ahead.
The Schneider FreightPower® load board app for carriers, backed by one of the most trusted names in transportation, gives you access to reliable freight from quality blue-chip shi
bluejetty:00156339:ios.description:
Schneider FreightPower® – Always delivering, always ahead.
The Schneider FreightPower® load board app for carriers, backed by one of the most trusted names in transportation, gives you access to reliable freight from quality blue-chip shippers across the country.
With just one stop to find, book, and track truckloads from the load board instantly, the app is designed to make life easier for carrier owners, dispatchers, and drivers, allowing them to move freight seamlessly.
We’re more than just a load board; use our ‘Book Now’ button to schedule freight that’s worth your time, backed by Schneider’s unmatched reliability.
Schneider FreightPower® offers unprecedented access to a broad network of shippers and enhances payment processes, supported by one of the most seasoned and dependable carriers, Schneider. This makes Schneider FreightPower® your ideal load board and truckload app.
Key Features of the Schneider FreightPower® Load Board:
Get personalized truckload recommendations using our enhanced AI technology.
- Truckloads matches are based on posted trucks, preferred lanes, and favorite searches.
- Move more freight with tailored load suggestions based on watched loads and pending inbound capacity.
Instantly Book Truckloads
- Find loads at a trusted rate on Schneider’s proprietary load board marketplace and assign them instantly using the Book Now feature.
- Time is money – skip the bidding wars, avoid long waits, and secure the best loads with Schneider FreightPower’s load board.
Find and Assign Loads with Ease
- The load board offers enhanced search capabilities, enabling carriers to find more accurate truckloads.
- Use advanced search options to filter by geo-fenced radius, truck type, lanes, pickup/delivery destinations, and dates.
- The ‘Watch Loads’ feature lets you save preferred truckloads from the load board and access them quickly later.
- Carrier owners can manage the entire fleet by assigning drivers to loads and freight or inviting them to the app—all from one place.
- Dispatchers can unassign and reassign drivers with ease, streamlining operations through just a mobile number.
Seamless Freight Execution with ‘My Loads’
- Get detailed load information, including reference details, service requirements, trailer numbers, and appointments, all displayed with satellite views to reduce delays.
- Automated arrival and departure updates and estimated arrival times for the next stop are powered by Schneider ETAi™ technology, minimizing check-ins and letting drivers focus on the road.
- Drivers receive push notifications for new loads, allowing them to accept and track loads automatically.
Trust in Schneider’s Legacy
The Schneider FreightPower® load board app comes with 85 years of trusted experience in the carrier business. With access to one of the largest, highest-quality trailer pools in North America, Schneider gives you the confidence to transport freight safely and efficiently.
From finding truckloads to booking, tracking, and delivery, Schneider’s load board ensures smooth and reliable operations. The app also offers regular trailer maintenance and repair programs, backed by Schneider’s commitment to building strong relationships and offering personalized support throughout the user journey.
Exclusive Schneider Perks
Unlock valuable benefits within the app, including roadside assistance, fuel discounts, and more. These perks enhance your trucking journey, ensuring your fleet runs smoothly every step of the way.
Join forces with Schneider today. Partner with one of the most robust sales teams in the industry to help grow your business. Whether you're searching for reliable truckloads or need support managing your fleet, Schneider FreightPower’s load board is the partner you can trust to achieve your goals.
Questions?
Email: FreightPowerCarrier@schneider.com.

From the latest headlines to fast-loading email, the AOL app brings it all together on your mobile device. 
Stay on top of today’s top stories on a variety of topics from politics and finance to celebrity news. Turn on alerts for breaking news, important emails, and weather updates to help you stay informed and connected. Plus, check your AOL Mail, send messages, and access all of your AOL and phone contacts directly from the app.
Email
• Manage your AOL Mail from anywhere
• Access all of your AOL and phone contacts in a single location
• Quickly swipe to delete, move, mark, or flag emails
• Customize the left and right swipe gestures to assign specific actions you use the most
• Tap once to empty all trash and spam
• Enable Touch ID or Face ID for added security
News
• Get the latest news around the world and across the us on politics, sports, entertainment, finance, lifestyle, and more
• Pulled from reliable sites including TechCrunch, HuffPost, Engadget, AOL Finance, and AOL Sports
• Never miss a story with breaking news push notifications
• Share articles and videos via Facebook, Twitter, and email
Weather
• Check the weather in your location with a single tap
• Get hourly and daily forecasts
• Enable customized notifications
Do you have feedback on the app? Click here to let us know: https://aol.uservoice.com/forums/912865 We’d love to hear from you!
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which will allow you to contribute to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information. You may also visit Settings in the app to opt out of Nielsen measurement.

bluejetty:00015436:ios.name: MapleRead SE
bluejetty:00015436:ios.summary:
MapleRead is dedicated to enable unique audio-visual reading experience for everyone.
------------
Our MapleRead app family has 3 members, namely SE, CE and CX.
- SE is our flagship product with all features.
- CE is SE without PDF reader
bluejetty:00015436:ios.description:
MapleRead is dedicated to enable unique audio-visual reading experience for everyone.
------------
Our MapleRead app family has 3 members, namely SE, CE and CX.
- SE is our flagship product with all features.
- CE is SE without PDF reader and built-in Library Server.
- CX is CE with some limitation. Free to try.
- No recurring subscription fees. No ads. Just buy it once. Gratuity optional.
- Moreover, SE and CE can be run side-by-side via split-view multitasking.
- Recommend SE for use on multiple devices with easy and fast book sharing via Library Server.
- Recommend the SE-CE bundle for the best value.
------------
MapleRead includes a superb audio-visual EPUB e-book reader.
- It lets you easily modify publisher's original book style to better suit your aesthetic taste.
- It lets you instantly generate pseudo audiobooks with a choice of narrator voices over 40 languages.
- It enables immersion reading so that you may read and listen to the same book in sync.
- Background listening works well too. Compatible with Lock Screen Music Player and CarPlay.
MapleRead UI is friendly to users of all ages.
- Books can be read in regular and large print.
- A choice of UI text sizes makes reading in non-book views much more comfortable.
MapleRead is a great learning tool.
- It lets you look up words, translate sentences, search text, highlight text and write notes.
- It helps you collect vocabulary and organize notes with various priorities.
- It provides hooks to user-defined dictionaries, translators, and other tools.
- Immersion reading improves your comprehension, especially of foreign-language books.
MapleRead is an effective and fast library management tool.
- It is designed for you, a book lover, who may own a huge and/or growing book collection.
- It lets you keep all your books in one place and well-organized automatically.
- It lets you display your books elegantly in style.
- It lets you easily repair individual book metadata.
- If supports multiple book sets and multiple tags.
- It offers multiple ways to import and export books, and works well with Calibre.
MapleRead supports secure sync across devices via MapleRead Cloud and iCloud.
- It syncs reading positions, notes, vocab, bookmarks, and book set membership (but not the books).
- It syncs reading positions additionally via iCloud for even better user experience.
- It enables web access to synced data via web browsers from desktop and mobile devices.
MapleRead offers unprecedented user-defined customization options.
- They include unlimited user-defined fonts, book themes, cover images and library scenes.
- Each book theme includes various types of user-defined highlight colors.
- Each book can have its own theme, and each EPUB book can have its own style.
MapleRead SE includes also a great PDF e-book reader.
- The PDF reader looks very similar to the EPUB reader for a sense of unified UI.
MapleRead SE has a zero-configuration Library Server for easy book sharing.
- All books in Library can be shared.
- Smart batch download makes transferring of multiple books very convenient.
[For more technical details, screenshots, FAQ and reviews, please visit our website.]

bluejetty:00144694:ios.name: Bryton Active
bluejetty:00144694:ios.summary:
Bryton Active App store description:
Spend more time riding and less time worrying! The easy-to-use Bryton Active app allows you to track/plan workouts, customize your device, plan trips, sync to popular 3rd party platforms, and much more!
bluejetty:00144694:ios.description:
Bryton Active App store description:
Spend more time riding and less time worrying! The easy-to-use Bryton Active app allows you to track/plan workouts, customize your device, plan trips, sync to popular 3rd party platforms, and much more!
User-Friendly Interface
The new Active app offers a whole new experience with a more intuitive and easier-to-navigate user interface, a categorized app menu, and a more user-friendly design, all while incorporating powerful features and functions!
Zero-Touch Setup
Setup just became even easier! Conveniently customize almost any setting in REAL TIME with a simple click of a button without navigating through device menus! 
Upload Activities Conveniently
Cut the cord on PC uploads! With improved Bluetooth communication, it is easier than ever to sync your rides and view detailed ride overviews and analysis whenever and wherever you ride with Bryton Active! 
Plan Trips Simply and Easily
Easily plan trips on your trip-enabled Bryton computer! Either enter an address or point of interest and let the app automatically find the best route for you or define your own routes with touch-enabled points and multi-destination custom routes!
Auto Sync to 3rd Party Platforms
The Bryton Active app can automatically sync your workouts with your favorite 3rd party platforms such as Strava, TrainingPeaks, Komoot, and SelfLoops after simply setting up. You can share your rides with friends and family or prepare for events strategically!
Update Firmware/GPS Data Easily
After you pair the device with the Bryton Active app, the app will automatically check the device’s firmware version and current GPS data and then notify you when updates become available. You always have the newest updates and the best features.
New Bluetooth-Enabled Features
It is now possible to sync and plan workouts, download planned trips, view/upload ride logs, modify the device settings, calibrate the altitude, and much more all via Bluetooth with the Bryton Active app.
New Automatic Features
With the new app, it is now possible to automatically sync tracks from your device to the Active app, automatically calibrate altitude, and set up the auto pause feature of the Bryton device.

bluejetty:00114904:ios.summary:

Halloween Stories 9: The Death Card invites you into a chilling hidden objects puzzle adven
bluejetty:00114904:ios.description:
Can you escape the witch’s island and survive the night of the Death Card?
Play a new hidden object mystery game from the Halloween Stories series!
Halloween Stories 9: The Death Card invites you into a chilling hidden objects puzzle adventure full of dark secrets, eerie riddles, and supernatural forces!
Face your fate, uncover the mystery of the cursed tarot, and stop the evil before it claims another soul!
Note: This is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
FACE YOUR DESTINY ON THE CURSED ISLAND
Christine Harris and her husband return to the village where she spent her childhood to meet old friends and celebrate Halloween. But what begins as a joyful reunion quickly turns into a nightmare when a fortune teller’s reading reveals Christine’s death card. Soon, the prophecy begins to come true. Trapped on a remote island until morning, Christine and her friends must survive the witch’s domain—where illusion and reality blur, and one of them hides a deadly secret.
COLLECT THE WITCH CARDS AND UNLOCK THEIR POWER
Each mysterious card carries a warning… and a clue. Search haunted locations, find hidden objects, and piece together the meaning behind the witch’s deck. Can you tell who’s your ally and who’s your enemy before it’s too late?
STOP THE ONE WHO WANTS YOU DEAD
Explore eerie environments, solve clever puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the fortune that sealed your fate. Survive the night, expose the traitor, and confront the evil presence that haunts the island.
BONUS CHAPTER: THE FORTUNE TELLER’S SECRET
Play as Hilda on Halloween Eve, exploring hidden caves and forgotten shrines to uncover the origins of the cursed tarot. Solve spectral puzzles, summon lost spirits, and decide who will inherit your power — and your revenge.
Halloween Stories 9: The Death Card is a must-play for fans of supernatural mysteries, spooky adventures, and hidden objects games with a Halloween twist.
Test your detective skills, solve puzzles, and face your destiny in this thrilling hidden object puzzle adventure!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use hints if you get stuck.
Discover more from Elephant Games!

- Beautiful, full-resolution graphics and design
- Ability to save your game across all devices

All idle clicker and medieval games fans - Sit back and ENJOY!

bluejetty:00096117:ios.summary: Discover movies, TV shows, and actors in a whole new way. Actor Roulette is not just another entertainment tracker — it’s a unique app that combines personalized discovery with the excitement of chance. With our exclusive Actor Roulette fea
bluejetty:00096117:ios.description:
Discover movies, TV shows, and actors in a whole new way. Actor Roulette is not just another entertainment tracker — it’s a unique app that combines personalized discovery with the excitement of chance. With our exclusive Actor Roulette feature, you can spin the wheels of genre, era, and popularity to reveal fresh faces, legendary stars, and unforgettable performances. Each spin opens up a new list of actors and their movies, giving you endless inspiration for your next watch.
Stay on top of your favorite shows with powerful tracking tools. Easily browse seasons, follow upcoming episodes, and set reminders so you never miss a release. Actor Roulette makes sure you always know when new episodes drop, so your watchlist is always up to date.
Get all the details you need in one place. From cast and crew information to ratings and reviews, our app gives you a complete picture of every title. You can also enjoy official movie trailers directly within the app, so you can preview the story, mood, and style before you decide what to watch. Whether it’s a blockbuster or a hidden gem, you’ll have everything you need to make the perfect choice.
Personalized discovery is at the core of Actor Roulette. Explore trending films, browse by popular genres, or let destiny decide with a roulette spin. Build your own watchlists, keep track of your favorite stars, and uncover movies you might never have found otherwise. Actor Roulette transforms browsing into an experience — one that’s fun, surprising, and made just for you.
Whether you’re planning tonight’s movie marathon, looking for your next binge-worthy series, or simply curious about new actors on the rise, Actor Roulette makes discovering entertainment exciting again. Spin, discover, and dive into a universe of movies and shows, all just a tap away.
Note:
-All movie details, artwork, and metadata are provided by TMDB.org and are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0
-This application uses the TMDB API, but it is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. For more information, see TMDB’s API Terms of Use
-Our app does not stream or play movies/TV shows. It is designed to help you discover, organize, and explore content more easily.

bluejetty:00082377:ios.name: Zombiepunk: Fight & Survive
bluejetty:00082377:ios.summary:
Welcome to the world of zombie tower defense, where you can test your skills in strategy games and survival crafting games.
Zombiepunk :Fight & Survive is an exciting journey through an apocalyptic wasteland with elements of turret defence
bluejetty:00082377:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of zombie tower defense, where you can test your skills in strategy games and survival crafting games.
Zombiepunk :Fight & Survive is an exciting journey through an apocalyptic wasteland with elements of turret defence and zombieland adventure where you have to extract resources from all around and destroy hordes of undead.
According to the classics of the genre of survival crafting games, the extracted resource should be used for level up and upgrading of weapons, buildings and armor. But in Zombiepunk: Wasteland Survival you have the opportunity to try yourself in zombie idle strategy games with elements of turret defence.
Unleash your inner survivor and, taking powerful self-made weapons and the help of turrets built by you, fight to the last against hordes of undead in the lifeless desert of the post-apocalyptic future.
Download Zombiepunk: Zombie Strategy for free and start your story today!
Unique Clear Gameplay
Get caught up in the unusual combination of survival strategy and zombie tower defense and apocalypse craft that will keep you engaged for a long time in this exciting story. Smash everything around, mine resources, upgrade your weapons and build defenses to become the king of the wasteland.
Crafting and Upgrading
So that your brains are not eaten by hordes of zombies, you will have to demonstrate tactics & strategy with smart extraction and use of resources. As expected in the genre of survival crafting games - build turrets, craft guns, upgrade other weapons and equipment, you will need everything in the fight against waves of undead!
Eye-Pleasing 3D Graphics
A beautiful and bright visualization of the post-apocalyptic world with cel-shading technology that adds a comic style and reminds Borderlands.
Completely Offline Fun
To get the thrill of building fortifications and smashing everything around, you don't need the Internet, you can play Zombiepunk: Build Empire anywhere and anytime.
Ready for a breathtaking adventure in a post-apocalyptic wasteland in zombie tycoon strategy? Build, manage, develop, expand, defend your base and find vital resources in the desert. So don't delay and start destroying the undead together with other desperadoes in this epic story Zombiepunk: Survival Crafting Games

bluejetty:00146735:ios.name: HamHub - Your Personal Cinema
bluejetty:00146735:ios.summary:
HamHub - Your Personal Cinema
Bring your cloud drives and media servers together in one organized library. Turn folders of videos into a collection of movies and shows, and enjoy it on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.
SMART MEDIA LIBRARY
bluejetty:00146735:ios.description:
HamHub - Your Personal Cinema
Bring your cloud drives and media servers together in one organized library. Turn folders of videos into a collection of movies and shows, and enjoy it on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.
SMART MEDIA LIBRARY
HamHub scans your cloud and server files, identifies movies and episodes, and organizes them into a clear library. Automatic posters and media details make your collection easy to explore.
- Identify and organize movies and shows
- Browse folders and keep new content up to date
- Bring multiple sources into one library
CLOUD DRIVES AND MEDIA SERVERS
Browse, search, and play your collection in one place. Connect Aliyun Drive, Baidu Netdisk, Google Drive, WebDAV, and SMB, or access Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and IPTV sources.
EPISODES AND WATCH PROGRESS
Browse shows by season, choose an episode, and pick up where you left off. Keep your library, preferences, watch history, and playback progress in sync across your devices.
POWERFUL PLAYBACK
- 4K video playback
- Stream videos from a Mac, PC, or NAS
- Multiple audio tracks
- Gesture controls and flexible video scaling
- Continuous episode playback
- Video deinterlacing
SUPPORTED FORMATS
Video: 3GP, AVI, AV1, ASF, BDMV, DIVX, DVDMEDIA, DVR-MS, FLV, H.264 (AVC), H.265 (HEVC), ISO/IMG, M4V, MKV, MOV, MP4, MPEG, MTS/M2TS, MXF, OGM, OGV, RMVB, TS, VC1, VIDEO_TS, VOB, VP9, WEBM, WMV, WTV.
Audio: AAC, AC3/E-AC3, Dolby TrueHD, DTS, DTS-HD MA, FLAC, MP3, OGG, PCM, WMA.
Subtitles: DVB, DVDSUB, MICRODVD, MPL2, PGS, SMI, SSA/ASS, SRT, SUB, Timed Text, TMP, TXT, VOBSUB, VTT, XSUB.
HAMHUB PRO
Pro features require an in-app purchase:
- Playback on Apple TV, Mac, and iPad, with synced watch progress
- Automatic matching and organization of cloud video files
- Direct streaming from supported cloud drives, including Aliyun Drive, Baidu Netdisk, and Google Drive
- Broad format support and 4K playback
- Ongoing Pro feature updates
From movies and series to documentaries, keep your collection organized and ready to watch.
Download HamHub and build your personal cinema.
Privacy Policy: https://hamhub.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://hamhub.app/term

Stack players from the same team, division, or draft class to create chemistry and unlock scoring boosts. Griddy's proprietary grading system scores your lineup in real-time-making every draft a new puzzle in a game you can play 365 days a year.

-1v1 Versus mode to play against friends
-Griddy Leagues with full standings, stats, and season history
-Highly strategic gameplay that changes every single draft
-Badges and achievements to unlock as you improve

Your subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple ID Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00119832:ios.name: IMAIOS vet-Anatomy
bluejetty:00119832:ios.summary: vet-Anatomy is an atlas of veterinary anatomy based on medical imaging examinations and illustrations. This atlas was created on the same framework as e-Anatomy which is one of the most popular human anatomy atlases, particularly in the rad
bluejetty:00119832:ios.description:
vet-Anatomy is an atlas of veterinary anatomy based on medical imaging examinations and illustrations. This atlas was created on the same framework as e-Anatomy which is one of the most popular human anatomy atlases, particularly in the radiology field. This atlas is intended for veterinary students, veterinary surgeons and veterinary radiologists.
vet-Anatomy focuses entirely on animal anatomy. Designed in partnership with Dr. Susanne AEB Boroffka, ECVDI graduate, PhD, vet-Anatomy includes interactive and detailed radiological anatomy modules containing veterinary medical images from X-rays, CT and MRI. It covers multiple species: dogs, cats, horses, cattle and mice. The images are labeled in 12 languages, including the Latin Nomina Anatomica Veterinaria.
(More details on: https://www.imaios.com/en/vet-Anatomy).
Learn anatomy and radiological anatomy and enhance your knowledge.
Studies have shown that learning is more effective with interactive and easily accessible tools. However, atlases are still often in book format. Aware of this shortcoming, we have created an interactive atlas covering several species and based on normal anatomy.
Features:
- Scroll through image sets by dragging your finger
- Zoom in and out
- Tap labels to display anatomical structures
- Select anatomical labels by category
- Easily locate anatomical structures thanks to the index search
- Multiple screen orientations
- Use the training mode to review
This subscription also gives you access to vet-Anatomy on IMAIOS website.
You will enjoy all updates and new modules of different species during your subscription period.
Additional downloads are required for full use of the application.
About module activation.
IMAIOS vet-Anatomy has two methods of activation for our different users:
1) IMAIOS members who have vet-Anatomy access provided by their university or library may use their user account to enjoy full access to all modules. However, an internet connection is periodically required to verify their user account.
2) New users are invited to subscribe to vet-Anatomy. All modules and features will be active for a limited period of time. Subscriptions will be automatically renewed so that they can enjoy continuous access to vet-Anatomy.
Additional auto-renewable subscription Information:
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's account settings on App Store after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
The screenshots are part of the full vet-Anatomy application with all modules enabled.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use 
- https://www.imaios.com/en/privacy-policy
- https://www.imaios.com/en/conditions-of-access-and-use

bluejetty:00141849:ios.name: Mixology - Pocket Bartender
bluejetty:00141849:ios.summary: Whether you are making a drink for the first time or you are an experienced mixologist, Pocket Bartender turns your phone into a complete drink-making assistant. Designed with a clean layout and powerful tools, the app takes the guesswork o
bluejetty:00141849:ios.description:
Whether you are making a drink for the first time or you are an experienced mixologist, Pocket Bartender turns your phone into a complete drink-making assistant. Designed with a clean layout and powerful tools, the app takes the guesswork out of cocktail preparation so you can focus on making and enjoying great drinks.
Key Features
* Designed for All Skill Levels
Beginners get clear step-by-step instructions and automatic measurement conversions to build confidence without technical jargon.
Seasoned pros can build custom recipes from scratch, use advanced ingredient substitution options, and batch cocktails for large gatherings.
* Vast Library of High-Quality Recipes
Access thousands of classic, modern, signature, and seasonal recipes for holidays like Halloween and Valentine's Day.
Explore a wide variety of both alcoholic drinks and zero-proof mocktails, smoothies, and party punches.
* AI-Powered Photo Recognition
Snap a photo of any cocktail to instantly view its name, history, and detailed step-by-step recipe.
Take a picture of your available ingredients, and the app will immediately show you every drink you can create with them.
* Smart Inventory & "What Can I Make?"
Input your home bar stock to see every cocktail you can make right now without extra store trips.
View exact missing ingredient counts for drinks you want to try, making shopping quick and focused.
Manage your home bar inventory by listing ingredients and available quantities for automated daily suggestions.
* Smart Substitutions & Precision Scaling
Get instant ingredient swap suggestions—like substituting light rum for gin—with notes on how flavor profiles change.
Scale any recipe instantly by number of servings or liquid volume so your proportions remain accurate for any crowd size.
* Custom Recipe Builder & Shared Shopping Lists
Create your own unique recipes or tweak existing classics to match your personal taste.
Add missing items directly from recipe cards to an in-app shopping list and share it instantly with friends or family.
* Smart Search, Folders & Discovery
Search easily by drink name, specific spirit, or style categories like tiki, punch, or highball.
Organize your favorite cocktails into custom folders like Date Night or Summer Party.
Use the Random Cocktail Generator to discover new flavors, explore popular trending drinks, or browse similar cocktail recommendations.
View curated food and snack pairings designed to complement the flavor profile of your selected drink.
Privacy Policy: https://pocketbartender.app/privacypolicy/
Terms of Use: https://pocketbartender.app/tos/

bluejetty:00039668:ios.description:
Record multiple children's weight, height, and head circumference measurements and use them to generate growth charts from birth to age 20. 
Predict growth with the free growth projection feature. All percentiles and Z-scores are calculated using the highly accurate LMS method.
Contains WHO, CDC, Preterm, and combination charts (WHO-CDC, Preterm-WHO), as well as dozens of country-specific charts available with the Pro Version upgrade.
Easily export and import data with CSV files, or use the built-in cloud backup to sync data between devices and share with other users.
Visit our web page for FAQ, video user guide, details about percentiles and CSV imports/exports, and more.
Features:
* Supports mixing lb, oz, ft, in, g, kg, and cm measurement units
* Record measurements for an unlimited number of children (local storage) or up to four children with cloud backup
* Optional cloud backup to syncs between devices or lets you share with other users
* Age-vs-weight, Age-vs-Height, Age-vs-Head Circumference, Age-vs-BMI, and Weight-vs-Height Charts
* Show percentiles or Z-scores in charts and tables
* Customize the chart with different line colors
* Combination charts let you use a single chart across common transition points (Preterm-WHO, WHO-CDC)
* Project children's growth out to the full curve
* Show percentiles using either real age (based on birth date) or corrected age (based on due date) for premature babies
* Compare multiple children on the same plot
* Click points on the charts see exact percentiles, or easily generate a table of percentiles for all measurements
* Easily share or save chart images or PDF reports (PDFs in Pro Version only)
* Export and import measurements to CSV files
* Customize the child list with a photo of each child
This app does not provide a medical diagnosis, and is not a substitute for consultation with a trained medical professional. If you have medical concerns about your child do not disregard or delay discussing them with a qualified medical professional.

bluejetty:00115423:ios.name: Color Sort: Stack Sorting Game
bluejetty:00115423:ios.summary:
Color Sort is a turn-based sorting game that challenges your problem-solving skills and keeps your mind active. Take turns placing color stacks and outscore your opponent to win!
Why You'll Love Color Sort
• Turn-Based Sorting Battles
Com
bluejetty:00115423:ios.description:
Color Sort is a turn-based sorting game that challenges your problem-solving skills and keeps your mind active. Take turns placing color stacks and outscore your opponent to win!
Why You'll Love Color Sort
• Turn-Based Sorting Battles
Compete in head-to-head matches, taking turns placing stacks. The first player to reach the target wins, so plan ahead and outscore your opponent.
• Simple, Intuitive Gameplay
Just tap, place stacks, and watch your score grow. No complicated controls or stressful time limits! It's easy to pick up, whether you have a few minutes or a few hours.
• Challenging Yet Relaxing
Test your focus and strategy without the stress. Each turn is a fresh puzzle, keeping your mind engaged while letting you enjoy a calm, turn-based flow.
How to Play:
* Be the first to reach the target score by matching and merging color stacks.
* On your turn, place three stacks on the board. Each stack may have one color or a mix.
* Match stacks of the same color side by side to merge them and create bigger stacks.
* When a stack reaches 10 tiles of the same color, it disappears and earns you points.
* After you place your stacks, your opponent takes their turn.
* Plan moves in advance to set up merges, block your opponent, and keep the board clear.
How do you become a Color Sort master?
In this turn-based battle, every move shapes the board for both you and your opponent. Place stacks to trigger merges and score points, but also block your rival's opportunities. Keep enough open space for your next turn while limiting theirs. The key is to balance short-term gains with long-term control, setting up moves that help you score big and stay one step ahead.
Outsmart opponents while you relax and recharge. Start winning in Color Sort today!

bluejetty:00085960:ios.description:
PXPlay – Performance eXtended Play
Experience your console games like never before. PXPlay lets you take full control of your console remotely, without limits. Whether you’re away from home or just in another room, enjoy smooth, low-latency streaming with high-quality visuals, great audio, and full controller support.
PXPlay is engineered for performance and designed to provide the best remote play experience possible, with advanced features like 4K / 2K upscaling. Every detail is fine-tuned to deliver the lowest possible latency and the highest possible quality, so it feels like you’re right in front of your console, even over mobile data.
Why PXPlay?
With PXPlay, you can stream and play any of your console’s games remotely, titles like GTA V, Fortnite, The Last of Us, FIFA, Crash Bandicoot, and more, directly on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV. You can even use PXPlay as a virtual gamepad with advanced touch controls and gesture support.
Main Features
• HDR visuals and real-time 4K / 2K “Super Resolution” upscaling
• Spatial Audio (3D Audio)
• Custom bitrate and video frame pacing
• Low-latency streaming optimized for responsiveness
• Button mapping, hotkeys, and touchpad gesture emulation
• Register and switch between multiple consoles
• Third-party controller support
• Works over Wi-Fi or mobile data*
Learn more: https://streamingdv.github.io/pxplay/index.html
*To play over the internet, follow these setup instructions:
https://streamingdv.github.io/pxplay/index#line5
Registration must be performed on the same network as your console.

Based on your birth chart, Moyra answers all your questions with its deep astrology knowledg
bluejetty:00083352:ios.description:
Discover your true self with Moyra! Get personalized content about your birth chart, unlock the mystery of numerology, and stay at Moyra for more.
Based on your birth chart, Moyra answers all your questions with its deep astrology knowledge.
Daily horoscopes on Moyra are interpreted individually based on your birth chart and are free of charge!
Every individual has a birth chart created by calculating the day, time, and place of birth. Moyra prepares daily sign interpretations based on your horoscope.
Moon Phase Compatibility
Moon phases add a touch of mystery to our lives. With our new Moon Phase Compatibility feature, discover how the moon phase you were born under influences your personality and relationships. Find out which moon phase you were born in and analyze your compatibility with your loved ones. Add a new dimension to your life with the energy of the Moon!
Find out your Ascendant and Moon sign from Moyra!
You may know your zodiac sign but not your ascendant or moon sign. However, they are as influential on your personality as your zodiac sign.
Sign Compatibility
You can look for compatibility with your friends and find out if they are kindred spirits. You can also get a sense of someone you’ve just met and learn about areas of compatibility and conflict.
Numerology
In the fascinating world of mysterious numbers, numerology is a unique method to help us understand the energies that guide our lives and to be in more harmony with these energies in our lives. Used by many great thinkers from the past to the present, this key to wisdom is a unique gift to help us discover the meaning of our lives and unlock our potential.
Ancient Zodiac Signs
Ancient zodiac signs have influenced many areas, from mythology to daily life and agriculture to travel, and have shaped people’s lives. Each zodiac sign gives us clues about our lives with its unique characteristics and symbolic meanings.
Smart Assistant
Our expert, Ishil, and her team modeled this AI-powered chatbot. It recognizes you based on the information you provide and chats only about astrology. You can treat it like a genuine astrologer and ask questions by selecting a suggested question or typing your own.
Special Days of The Year
This Year's Special Days: This feature will guide you through the magical world of astrology by presenting the planetary movements, eclipses, and other celestial events occurring this year, along with their dates. With the guidance of the sky, know in advance the significant moments you will experience throughout the year and make the most of these special day.
Follow Moyra on social media!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/askmoyra_en/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/askmoyra
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ask_moyra
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MoyraAstroloji
Pinterest: https://tr.pinterest.com/askmoyra/
Moyra Premium offers weekly, monthly, and annual subscriptions. The premium version allows you to access features such as birth chart, numerology analysis, and prediction content. We recommend using the annual plan to benefit from Moyra Premium’s advantageous subscription opportunities. The payment is charged to your iTunes account, and prices vary by country. You can see the total amount before you complete the payment. In-app purchases will renew depending on your plan. To prevent renewal, you must turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before your subscription expires. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time in your iTunes account settings. To access the settings, please go to https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039.
Terms of Use: https://cdn.askmoyra.com/terms-of-services-en.html
Privacy policy: https://cdn.askmoyra.com/privacy-policy-en.html

bluejetty:00180044:ios.description:
Unlock a World of Learning with Learning Games for Kids – The Ultimate Vocabulary-Building Adventure for Toddlers and Preschoolers!
Help your child learn, explore, and grow with Learning Games for Kids, the fun and interactive educational app designed to boost early learning. With over 900 essential words across 36 popular topics, your child will embark on a journey of discovery through engaging activities that nurture both cognitive and motor skills.
From animals to colors, shapes, numbers, and more, Learning Games for Kids transforms education into a playful experience, where learning feels like playtime! Whether your child is just starting to talk or preparing for kindergarten, this app provides the perfect foundation for vocabulary building and skill development.
EXPLORE A VARIETY OF LEARNING TOPICS:
► Colors
► Shapes
► Family Members
► Animals (Wild, Farm, Pet)
► Fruits & Vegetables
► Vehicles
► ABC Alphabets & Numbers
► Body Parts
► And 28 more exciting topics to enrich your child's vocabulary!
FUN GAMES TO KEEP KIDS ENGAGED:
► Flashcards: Visual learning through interactive flashcards, perfect for word recognition and pronunciation.
► Matching Games: Strengthen memory and improve problem-solving skills.
► Shadow Puzzles: Boost critical thinking by matching shadows with correct objects.
► Balloon Pop: Develop word recognition in a playful, stress-free way.
► Memory Matching: Enhance memory with fun pair-matching activities.
► Spelling Games: Build early literacy skills by learning to spell simple words.
► Brain Teasers: Engage your child’s curiosity and cognitive development through challenging games.
► Quiz Mode: Test knowledge and reinforce learning with interactive quizzes.
WHY PARENTS LOVE LEARNING GAMES FOR KIDS:
► 900+ Essential Words: An extensive collection of words covering important early-learning topics.
► 36 Engaging Topics: Tailored to ensure your child learns crucial concepts in a fun, interactive way.
► Over 1500 Game Activities: From quizzes to flashcards, every game is crafted to make learning enjoyable.
► Kid-Friendly Design: Bright, colorful, and intuitive—perfect for young children to navigate independently.
► Offline Play: No internet? No problem! Play anytime, anywhere, without the need for Wi-Fi.
► Ad-Free: A safe, worry-free environment with no third-party ads.
► Parental Insights: Track your child’s progress with detailed performance reports and celebrate milestones together!
DEVELOP CRITICAL SKILLS: 
Learning Games for Kids helps your child develop key skills that form the foundation of early learning.
► Vocabulary Expansion
► Memory & Concentration
► Problem-Solving
► Fine Motor Skills
► Listening & Pronunciation
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Try Learning Games for Kids with a free 7-day trial, giving your child unlimited access to the full range of games and activities. Cancel anytime through your iTunes settings.
For support or inquiries, contact us at iosdev.sumon@gmail.com.
Terms of Use
http://preschoolgamesforkids.com/tos/
Privacy Policy
http://preschoolgamesforkids.com/privacy-policy/
Download Learning Games for Kids today and give your child the head start they deserve!

Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Food 4 Less app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Food 4 Less grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Rewards Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Food 4 Less store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.food4less.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.food4less.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Food 4 Less app, you need a Food 4 Less digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Food 4 Less Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Food 4 Less' Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.food4less.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

bluejetty:00018874:ios.description:
"Time to put metal to the pedal and use those shooting skills to do some wrecking! Autobirds and Deceptihogs ROLL OUT! Angry Birds and Transformers collide in this action-packed, 3D shoot ‘em up adventure! The EggSpark has transformed the eggs into crazed robots who are destroying Piggy Island, but who can stop them?! Autobirds, ROLL OUT!
The Autobirds have some tough bots on their team – Red as Optimus Prime, Chuck as Bumblebee, and the rest of the transformerized flock! But the courageous Autobirds can’t save Piggy Island on their own – to stop the EggBots they’ll need to join forces with their arch rivals the DECEPTIHOGS (like Decepticons only smellier). Can these bitter enemies team up and put aside their differences? Yeah right…
- COLLECT! Unlock a roster of heroes (and villains) with unique attacks and abilities!
- DESTROY! No need for slingshots when you have LASERS!
- VEHICLES! Oh, yes! Cars, trucks, tank or planes – transform to dodge falling hazards!
- UPGRADES! Get stronger weapons and new abilities for every Transformer!
- TAG TEAM! Borrow a friend’s character to unleash a devastating two-bot assault!
- ENERGONICONS! Take smaller robots to support you smashing blocks!
- EVENTS! Weekly events allow you to compete to win prizes!
- ACCESSORIES! Customise and enhance your Transformers with iconic items!
- CRATES! Earn prizes by opening crates full of resources, accessories and even characters!
- SPARK RUN! Test your metal on 160 levels of increasing difficulty!
- QUESTS! Complete daily challenges for rewards!
--------------
“Oh so fun...I was hooked on the new shoot-'em-up gameplay.” – Jason Cipriani, CNET
“Angry Birds Transformers captures the thrills robots in disguise held for the young me, while also introducing a bold new gameplay mechanic to Angry Birds.” – Stuart Dredge, The Guardian
“Enjoyable to play and its sense of humor is in exactly the right place.” – Shaun Musgrave, TouchArcade
“This is one game in the Angry Birds stable that you're not going to want to miss.” – Brittany Vincent, Modojo
--------------

bluejetty:00019209:ios.description:
Over 2,000 puzzles, all guaranteed solvable – a true classic Mahjong Solitaire!
With no time limit, unlimited retries, and a relaxing pace, it’s perfect for brain training or casual play.
Carefully selected layouts ensure a smooth and satisfying experience for beginners and experts alike.
Play offline anytime, and enjoy all puzzles completely free.
The only in-app purchase is a one-time option to remove ads – the full game content is always free.
How to Play
- Match identical tiles to remove them in pairs.
- A tile is playable only if it is free on at least one side and has no tile on top.
- “Season” and “Flower” tiles can be matched with others of the same group, even if the pictures differ.
- Clear all tiles to win!
Features
- Every stage is solvable – no impossible layouts
- No shuffle needed, every puzzle has a solution
- Minimal ads / no time limits / unlimited retries
- Works offline
- Wide range of difficulty levels for all players
- Only purchase available is ad removal (one-time)
Enjoy the ultimate Mahjong Solitaire experience – simple, relaxing, and endlessly satisfying!

bluejetty:00177526:ios.name: Bio inc. Redemption
bluejetty:00177526:ios.summary: Bio Inc.: Redemption is a complex biomedical simulator in which you make life or death decisions. Create the ultimate illness to infect and torment your victim or play as the head of a medical team and hopefully find a cure to save your pat
bluejetty:00177526:ios.description:
Bio Inc.: Redemption is a complex biomedical simulator in which you make life or death decisions. Create the ultimate illness to infect and torment your victim or play as the head of a medical team and hopefully find a cure to save your patient. Will you be the plague or preserve humanity?
Including over 600 actual diseases, virus, symptoms, diagnostic tests, treatments and other medical conditions, Bio Inc.: Redemption is frighteningly realistic. It will captivate you for hours, bringing you into a microscopic world of epic plague proportions!
As the sequel to the worldwide mobile hit Bio Inc. (enjoyed by over 15 million players), Bio Inc.: Redemption was rebuilt from the ground up to make it the most realistic and visually stunning medical condition simulator available.
CHOOSE YOUR SIDE
Bio Inc.: Redemption includes two all-new campaigns!
Choose Death and explore your dark side by wrathfully terminating victims using an agonizing combination of diseases and medical conditions. Be the Plague!
Choose Life and you heroically play as a medical diagnostician to identify and cure diseases before it is too late for your patient. Save the human race one human at a time!
Each campaign consists of nine cases with four different difficulty levels and the new adaptive AI system provides hours of gameplay with great replay value.
NEW SKILLS SYSTEM
The all new skills system enables players to earn skills point and spend those towards upgrading skills that best fits their gameplay. Upgraded skills are persistent through all game modes.
SIDE QUESTS
While playing the campaign mode, players can decide to alter their strategy to complete one or many of the 41 included side quests. Completing side quest entitle players to hefty rewards!
WORLD TOURNAMENTS
Each week, the game will unveil a new world map to conquer with cases for Death and Life to be completed. Accumulate a winning streak, use your skills carefully and contest the title of best Doctor of Medicine. In exchange for you hard work, you will be compensated with rewards and pride.
BUILDING DEEP STRATEGIES
The mechanics of Bio Inc.: Redemption are simple to grasp yet extremely deep. Casual players will appreciate a quick and exciting challenge. Advanced players will have to elaborate complex strategies to solve high difficulty cases. It's all about combos and timing!
18 DIVERSIFIED CHALLENGING CASES
Each unique scenarios comes with its unique twists and specific objectives, gradually building your skills and expanding your toolset to evermore demanding intricate cases.
UNFORGIVING, WICKED AND STRANGELY COMPELLING
Whether you wish to cure an innocent patient's sickness or torment a poor soul through an unlikely disease and infection combination, the Bio Inc. universe will not leave you cold. Deviously realistic, even educational, balanced with a good amount of humor, the Bio Inc.: Redemption experience will take you on one heck of a thrill ride.

bluejetty:00137075:ios.description:
When the first satellite passes through the atmosphere, we believe we shall conquer the universe someday. Now I realized, humans are solely extending the boundaries of the earth left the kaleidoscopic world behind.
Investigator.
Have you ever thought that the mourning sea in front of you has lost its warmth?
We are struggling in the shallow waters when tides over the shore. We are stranded on the sandbank when waves recede.
Every single star shall rejoice and lament.
"Go through the storm and transcend eternity. Bon voyage."
Game Features:
Ex Astris is a semi-real-time, turn-based 3D RPG. As an investigator, you will delve into the world of Allindo and embark on a wondrous interstellar adventure.
#WorldExploration
Explore a planet in a tidally locked orbit, a realm where the sun never sets. Split into two distinct hemispheres by massive ring-shaped storms, this planet is home to bizarre creatures and intelligent beings remarkably similar to humans. On an RV journey, you will explore foreign lands with diverse local cultures, collect memories of extraordinary encounters, and unravel the mystery behind a looming storm.
#ObscuranManeuvers
A cool blend of turn-based gameplay and fast-paced action: Make the most of our innovative Obscuran Maneuver system and time your responses to perfectly counter enemy attacks. You can also pull off powerful team combos and joint attacks with your allies for strategic advantages.
#ProgressionExperience
Assemble a team of vibrant companions, each with their own motives and stories. Their powers and strength will depend on your knowledge of their traits. Scour Allindo for various materials to concoct special dishes and craft all sorts of Laylah-Keys to empower your team. Solve intricate puzzles in strongholds, defeat challenging foes that stand in your way, and unveil the mysteries of Allindo.

bluejetty:00162390:ios.description:
"Amazing, I got a loving sitter who could board my pet in moments after I made a request" - Charlene W
PetBacker connects loving pet sitters, groomers, dog walkers with pet owners just like you. PetBacker is a platform that lets you hire trusted Pet Sitter, dog walkers and pet care providers securely. You can use Petbacker to get people to take care of your pet, or you can use Petbacker to help earn extra money with your love for pet. You can use pet backer to show the world about your pet too!
If you have a pet before and are good in taking care of pets, Petbacker lets you get a pet sitting jobs without revealing personal contact information until you are hired. It's safe too with the Pet owners identities verified, weeding out shady characters. You can choose to get Pet owners to pay Petbacker in advance so that your hard work is guaranteed and we will release the payment within 7 days after your work. 
For Pet Owners
---- Find Pet Sitter, Dog walker, Groomers and Boarding---
• If you don’t know which pet sitter or home to look for, Petbacker will find the Pet sitter, dog walker and pet care providers with the right skills for you instantly. You can now get them at a click of a button, anywhere, any time, and the potential Pet Sitter will apply for your job instantly via chat.
---- Smart Search---
• Petbacker takes your "Request" and sends it as an opportunity to these Pet Sitter, Dog walker and pet care providers who meet your criteria and could possibly work on your request, and only Pet Sitter, dog walkers or pet care providers who are interested to work on your project will reply you, saving time from searching and filtering.
---Compare the Pet Sitter and Pet Service Providers---

Funds are FDIC insured, subject to applicable limitations and restrictions, when we receive the funds deposited to your account. bluejetty:00015770:ios.description:
Meet Marshmallow - a super cute alpaca girl who's new in town! Uh, and new ice cream types and flavors arrived! Try them all!
Summer has come and it’s so hot outside! Travel around the pet city with Blush the Bunny in his colorful ice cream truck and create the craziest ice pops and surprise frozen treats for his fluffy friends! Select among dozens of flavors, shapes, toppings and sprinkles!
Bagel the Bear loves seafood! Let’s prepare frozen fish ice cream for him! Choose among fun sprinkles and decorate it with shrimps, snowflakes and more crazy things. So refreshing!
Let’s make a yummy sundae for Puff the Puppy! Scoop his favorite peanut butter ice cream and add crazy toppings: berry, coconut or maybe cheese? Decorate it with popcorn, sausages and Puff’s favorite dog treats!
Fluff the Fox wants her ice cream to be tasty, but also super pretty! Choose a rainbow, pink or pitch black cone, add colorful ice cream scoops and fruit, chocolate or even rose topping! Decorate it with the cutest rainbow, unicorn or star cookies!
Prepare a unique ice lolly for Crisp the Camel! Mix different juicy fruits and berries, pour into a form, freeze it and choose the coolest ice cream stick! Wow, so colorful!
Pear the Parrot wants Blush’s famous mango slushie! Prepare this yummy frozen dessert, add colored or rainbow whipped cream and decorate it with bizarre sprinkles!
Let’s make a delicious chocolate ice cream milkshake for Squish the Squirrel and her cute baby! Choose among yummy syrups and decorate it with nuts and candies!

bluejetty:00071614:ios.description:
Sleep Tracker: White Noise - Fall Asleep Faster & Wake Up Refreshed
Transform your nights with Sleep Tracker: White Noise, the all-in-one solution for better rest, healthier habits, and peaceful sleep. Designed to help you understand your sleep patterns, track snoring, and build the perfect nighttime atmosphere, this app offers an immersive experience that supports deep relaxation and optimal recovery.
Whether you want to unwind instantly, monitor your sleep quality, or wake up gently, Sleep Tracker brings science-based tools directly to your bedside.
Advanced Sleep Tracking
Sleep Tracker analyzes your sleep through your device’s microphone and smart algorithms - no wearable needed. Each night, it monitors your movements, breathing patterns, and environmental noise to generate a detailed sleep analysis.
Your morning report includes:
- Total sleep duration
- Time spent in light sleep, deep sleep, and REM
- Sleep interruptions and noise disturbances
- Trends over time to help you improve your nightly routine
By understanding your sleep cycles, you can adjust your habits, create healthier rhythms, and enjoy more restorative rest.
Snore Recording & Detection
Snoring can disrupt deep sleep without you even realizing it. Sleep Tracker automatically detects, records, and categorizes snoring episodes throughout the night.
You’ll receive insights such as:
- Total snoring time
- Snoring intensity and frequency
- Audio clips you can replay
- Patterns that might affect breathing quality
These insights help you understand how snoring may be impacting your sleep and guide you toward more restful, uninterrupted nights.
Fall Asleep in Seconds
Let your mind drift instantly with calming melodies, nature sounds, and soothing frequencies designed to help you relax naturally and quickly.
Create Your Own Sound Mix
Mix 100+ natural sounds and white noise to craft your ideal sleep atmosphere. Choose from rainstorms, forest ambience, ocean waves, soft winds, zen chants, instruments, and more.
Hypnotic Soundscapes with Immersive Video
Enhance your relaxation with beautifully animated visuals paired with deep, hypnotic soundscapes. Perfect for meditation, stress relief, or winding down after a long day.
Wake Up Refreshed
Start your morning gently with pleasant alarm tones designed to wake you gradually instead of abruptly - supporting a smoother, healthier transition into your day.
Reduce Stress Anytime
Use the app’s calming audio, slow-wave sounds, and peaceful environments to reduce anxiety, regain focus, and help your mind reset whenever you need it.
Your Perfect Atmosphere Awaits
Create a calming place for sleep, meditation, or focus. Build your own sound world, track your nightly progress, and wake up feeling renewed - every day.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Sleep Tracker offers our most immersive experience with unlimited access to our entire content library with gentle alarm, the greatest science-based soundscapes and all different sounds to create your own calming place for sleep.
Our subscription options include:
Monthly subscription: $21.81/month
Yearly subscription: $96.35/year
Please note: monthly and yearly subscriptions will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Terms of use: https://sleepsounds.club/termsofuse/
Privacy policy: https://sleepsounds.club/privacy/
For quality sleep.

Drag the slider from 1832 to the present day to see who the leaders were in that year. Or just spin the wheel and see what happens. Or tap the "forwards" and "backwards" buttons to step through history, seeing the exact dates that changes were made in the quorums.

First Presidency chronology data based on http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chronology_of_the_First_Presidency_(LDS_Church) 

Quorum chronology data based on http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chronology_of_the_Quorum_of_the_Twelve_Apostles_(LDS_Church)#Chart

We have made every effort to be accurate.  If you find any errors in the dates or names or pictures of the apostles, please let us know and we will fix it ASAP.

General Authority portraits are copyrighted by Intellectual Reserve, Inc., and are used here by permission.

This app is a research project funded by Brigham Young University Hawaii, however the contents are the responsibility of its developers.  This app is not an "official" publication of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

bluejetty:00184154:ios.description:
CUSB Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CUSB Banking:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CUSB Banking app, you must be enrolled as a CUSB Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00131660:ios.name: Detecht - Motorcycle App & GPS
bluejetty:00131660:ios.summary: Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a ra
bluejetty:00131660:ios.description:
Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.
The #1 app for people who love riding.
Safety Comes First
One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.
Plan Your Next Adventure
With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 
Connect with Other Riders
Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.
Other Handy Features
In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.
In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.
Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by entering the user settings in your App Store account after the purchase.
Terms of use: https://detechtapp.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://detechtapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00114927:ios.description:
Use magical yarn to weave a warm companion that belongs only to you.
First, choose a silhouette you love—perhaps one that is round and small, or one with a playful shape? Then, give it a unique soul. Select your own colors and watch as soft strands of yarn gradually wrap around the form. It's like personally breathing life into silence and lighting up emptiness with your own hands.
This is a gentle ritual.
Mindful Wrapping:
With just a light touch of your fingertips, you can guide the yarn as it travels back and forth between the spools. The repetitive rhythm is like meditation, settling your mind and helping you find a moment of calm amidst a busy day.
Soft Color Sorting:
Enjoy the quiet time of sorting colors into place. It's like solving a gentle puzzle—no need to rush, no right or wrong, just finding your own order within the colorful gradients.
Heartwarming Creation:
As the spool grows fuller, the yarn will gently envelop the base, clothing it in unique color and warmth. In that moment, you witness the magic of creation from nothing.
Cherish Your Creation:
Every finished piece is a crystallization of your time and heart. Build your own collection of yarn companions, where each one is a unique existence.
Every effort is worth cherishing,
Every act of weaving is a warm conversation with yourself.
Set aside a quiet moment just for you,
And let the winding of the yarn weave strands of warmth and light into your daily life.

bluejetty:00068992:ios.description:

With its intuitive and advanced glucose monitor interface, you can quickly input your blood sugar readings and effortlessly monitor your glucose levels anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:

 • Quick Recording: Instantly enter and manage your blood sugar measurements for efficient glucose monitoring.
 • Advanced Tracking: Detailed blood sugar tracking capabilities to analyze your historical glucose data.
 • Insulin Reminder: Set personalized insulin reminders to maintain effective glucose management and blood sugar control.
 • Note Taking: Easily add notes to your blood sugar measurements to track and recall important details.
 • Apple Health Integration: Synchronize your glucose data seamlessly with the Apple Health app, enhancing compatibility with other health applications.
 • Data Export: Export your blood sugar and glucose monitoring data in PDF and CSV formats for sharing with your healthcare provider or for personal tracking purposes.

bluejetty:00166057:ios.description:
MyStory.today lets you write short stories, novels and screenplays on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. Write whenever you want, wherever you are.
Trusted by over 2 million writers.
Take your book with you everywhere you go. Write on the couch at home, on the train, or out in the countryside, and pick up exactly where you left off on any device.
Features overview:
• Story management with chapters and scenes
• Interactive corkboard with smart scene summaries
• Timeline management for multi-storyline novels
• Character Moods: see how your characters feel in each scene
• Characters and locations with auto-updating links
• Assistant features (tone detection, text transformation, summaries)
• Writing goals and progress tracking
• Tasks and labels to organize your work
• Scene images: illustrations, mood images, custom scene breakers
• Rich text editor with spell and grammar check
• Automatic, end-to-end encrypted sync across your Apple devices
• Export to MS Word and LibreOffice Writer
Organize your book with chapters and scenes
Break your book into chapters and scenes for a clear overview. Scribble ideas on the built-in corkboard, drag cards around, and let the assistant add scene summaries.
• Dynamic story corkboard with cards
• Drag and drop to reorder
• Add scenes and chapters on the fly
• Smart scene summaries
Timeline management for complex stories
Plan novels with several plot threads. Create multiple timelines, assign scenes with times or ranges, and view everything chronologically.
• Multiple storylines for plot threads
• Assign scenes to timelines
• Chronological timeline view
Character Moods: bring your characters to life
MyStory.today analyzes your scenes and detects the mood of each character. Lock moods you want to keep and read smart explanations for each suggestion.
• Mood detection per scene
• Lock moods to protect them
• Smart explanations for each suggestion
• Quick cleanup of unused characters
Characters and locations with smart linking
Create characters and locations and drop them into your text. Rename one and every reference updates automatically.
• Simple character and location profiles
• Auto-updating links in your text
Assistant features
Detect and adjust tone, transform text, and generate summaries for your corkboard. Turn all assistant features off in settings if you'd rather rely on your own creativity.
• Tone detection and analysis
• Intelligent text transformation
• Scene summaries for the corkboard
• Switch all assistant features off anytime
Writing goals, tasks and labels
Set daily or project goals and watch your progress grow. Use tasks and labels to keep chapters, scenes and ideas organized.
Rich text editor with spell check
Write distraction-free with bold, italic and indented text, full-screen mode, and built-in spelling and grammar checking.
Scene images
Extend your novel with illustrations, mood images or custom scene breakers. Upload from your device and keep writing across iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Export your book
Export all chapters and scenes to MS Word or LibreOffice Writer, for sharing or as a backup.
Synchronize across your Apple devices
With your free account, your work is available on iPhone, iPad and Mac, automatically and end-to-end encrypted.
Download the free app today and start your book.

Download SunSafe & Stay Protected
