bluejetty:00077501:ios.name: Home Assistant
bluejetty:00077501:ios.summary: The Home Assistant Companion app allows you to access your Home Assistant instance on the go. Home Assistant is the smart home solution focused on privacy, choice, and sustainability. It runs locally in your home via a device like the Home
bluejetty:00077501:ios.description:
The Home Assistant Companion app allows you to access your Home Assistant instance on the go. Home Assistant is the smart home solution focused on privacy, choice, and sustainability. It runs locally in your home via a device like the Home Assistant Green or Raspberry Pi.
This app connects to all the most powerful features of Home Assistant,
- One app to control the whole home - Home Assistant is compatible with the biggest brands in the smart home, connecting to thousands of smart devices and services.
- Discover automatically and quickly configure new devices - such as Philips Hue, Sonos, and IKEA Tradfri.
- Automate everything - Make all the devices in your home work in harmony - have your lights dim when you start watching a movie, or turn off your heat when you’re away from home.
- Keep your home’s data in the home - use it privately to see past trends and averages.
- Connect to open standards with hardware add-ons - including Z-Wave, Zigbee, Matter, Thread, and Bluetooth.
- Connect anywhere - If you would like to access this app while away from home, the most secure and simple way to get started is Home Assistant Cloud.
The app unlocks your smartphone or tablet as a home automation tool.
- Securely share your location, using it to automate heating, security, and so much more.
- Get notifications on what's happening in your home, from detecting leaks to doors left open, you have full control over what it tells you.
- Carplay functionality lets you open a garage or disable the security system from the dash of your car.
- Build your own widgets to control any device in your home with a tap.
- Integrate Home Assistant's functionality into Shortcuts, for example have your phone’s morning alarm turn on the coffee machine.
- Apple Watch compatibility can show your home's temperature on a watch face or quickly activate devices.
- Text or talk to your local voice assistant on your device.
- Mac compatibility allows you to control your home from your desktop, but also to share data to build automation, like having your streaming lights turn on when your camera is active.
Join the over 1 million users and empower your home with better privacy, choice and sustainability.

Whether you like sports or not, don't hesitate, your favourite application is here! Why will Squad
bluejetty:00090477:ios.description:
Does sitting in front of your computer all day make you feel restless? Do you like new challenges, team spirit and thinking outside the box?
Whether you like sports or not, don't hesitate, your favourite application is here! Why will Squadeasy become your best friend? Simply because it will make you a new person, you will be able to move like never before, have fun and give meaning to your actions!
How is this possible?
You earn points for yourself and your team by practicing a physical activity (cycling, walking, running, ...), by winning individual or team missions, by answering health and well-being quizzes and many other fun and responsible features. Yoga and other surprise activities are coming in a few weeks!
I'm sure you're already wondering how your points will be counted? Easy, Squadeasy has its own internal tracker, no need to download another app! You can also connect your favourite tracking app if you prefer!
As an added bonus, you have magic powers that you can use to boost your teammates. All this to earn even more points and show who's the boss!
For companies, Squadeasy is the solution to improve your QWL and boost your CSR. It is also a great opportunity to mobilize all the company's employees around a solidarity cause!
If you've read this far, you're already a champion haha: all that's left is for you to join the 400,000 users already registered on Squadeasy: weekend athletes as well as Olympic athletes, non-digital natives as well as geeks, people with disabilities... In short, come as you are!
Squadeasy uses HealthKit to export your Squadeasy activities to the Health app and to read biometric data.

bluejetty:00114310:ios.name: Infinity Coloring Book: Infini
bluejetty:00114310:ios.summary: Dive into endless cozy illustrations with Infini, the coloring book where every zoom reveals a new, peaceful world. Explore hidden details, discover tiny surprises, and unlock new scenes at every level — an immersive, infinite creative jour
bluejetty:00114310:ios.description:
Dive into endless cozy illustrations with Infini, the coloring book where every zoom reveals a new, peaceful world. Explore hidden details, discover tiny surprises, and unlock new scenes at every level — an immersive, infinite creative journey for kids, teens, and adults alike.
Relax, Create, and Enjoy
Infini is more than just a coloring book — it’s a gentle escape that helps you unwind, reduce stress, and enjoy your own pace. With soft color-therapy–inspired visuals, calming sounds, and endless zoom scenes, every session becomes immersive and soothing.
Whether you have 10 minutes or a full evening, Infini is perfect for:
Relaxing after a busy day — recharge and calm your mind.
Creative breaks on the go — while commuting, waiting, or traveling.
Fun time with kids — cozy illustrations everyone can enjoy.
Mindful focus and concentration — a calming activity to center your thoughts.
Enjoy coloring freely without skills — anyone can join in.
Discover new cozy worlds for every season — special scenes for holidays and occasions.
Beautiful, Cozy, and Fun for Everyone
Adults seeking relaxation, teens exploring creativity, and children who love cute animals, cozy rooms, and simple objects — everyone can enjoy this coloring book.
Key Features
INFINITE ZOOM WORLDS
Zoom endlessly and explore every scene — each level reveals new cozy illustrations, hidden details, and tiny surprises that keep you engaged.
COZY & CUTE ART
Color adorable animals, warm interiors, mandalas, patterns, and pixel-style scenes in a friendly coloring book style for all ages.
SMART COLORING TOOLS
Brushes, pencils, fill, and eraser — adjust stroke size, undo actions, and explore beautiful palettes in your coloring book.
COLOR YOUR WAY
Stay inside clean outlines or freely paint the whole scene — create exactly the way you want in this versatile coloring book.
RELAXING ASMR SOUNDS
Every tap and stroke is accompanied by calming, realistic sounds for a fully immersive coloring experience.
BONUS CONTENT
Unlock special zoom scenes and seasonal cozy worlds to keep your coloring fresh, fun, and engaging.
How It Works
1. Open the coloring book.
2. Pick a cozy scene.
3. Add color with simple taps or strokes.
4. Zoom in to discover hidden details and new scenes.
5. Experience soothing color and sound as your scene comes to life.
6. Save and enjoy your artwork.
Download Infini Now
Enjoy a gentle, immersive coloring book experience — your cozy escape, relaxing hobby, and creative playground all in one app.
FAQ
Is this coloring book free?
Yes! Start using Infini for free and enjoy several cozy scenes without a subscription.
Is it safe for kids?
Absolutely. Infini is designed for all ages, with gentle, cute, and cozy illustrations.
Can I use it offline?
Yes! Selected scenes work without an internet connection, so you can relax anywhere.
Do I need any artistic skills?
No! Infini is perfect for everyone — enjoy coloring without any experience.
What does Premium unlock?
Premium unlocks unlimited scenes, exclusive content, tools, and palettes in your coloring book.
Subscription & Privacy
Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off in your account settings
Privacy Policy: https://infinitefy.pro/infini/Privacy-Policy_Infini.pdf
Terms of Use: https://infinitefy.pro/infini/Terms-and-Conditions_Infini.pdf

bluejetty:00023335:ios.summary: WCC3 is a next-gen sequel to the World’s No. 1 mobile cricket game - World Cricket Championship 2 (WCC2), the most downloaded & awarded game. WCC3 takes the excitement of realism in mobile cricket a notch higher with cutting-edge gameplay f
bluejetty:00023335:ios.description:
WCC3 is a next-gen sequel to the World’s No. 1 mobile cricket game - World Cricket Championship 2 (WCC2), the most downloaded & awarded game. WCC3 takes the excitement of realism in mobile cricket a notch higher with cutting-edge gameplay features, brand new controls, multiplayer, professional commentary, exciting animations, real-time motion capture of professional cricketers, & advanced AI. The most realistic cricket game on a phone! WCC3 is a game by cricket lovers for cricket lovers!
Download and play FREE Online Cricket Game.
Get immersed fully into the spirit of cricket!
• Hundreds of full motion-captured batting, bowling & fielding actions.
• Professional realistic commentary from cricket legends Matthew Hayden,Isa Guha, Aakash Chopra, Anjum Chopra, Abhinav Mukund, Venkatapathi Raju, Vijay Bharadwaj, Deep Das Gupta, and Tariq Saeed.
•Customize your commentary experience with choices in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, and Urdu 
• Brand new hand-crafted Stadiums, lighting & pitches.
• Immerse yourself in thrilling cricket tournaments like World Cup, 20- 20, Tri Series, ODIs, Ashes, Test Cricket, World Tour, Hot Events, and many more exciting formats!
• All new NPL 25 (National Premier League), with auctions & realistic gameplay
• Dynamic AI that scales according to your skill level.
• Cricket grounds of different dimensions.
• The 20 - 20 World Cup 2024 mode with New Cricket playing countries.
All-new Career Mode!
• Advance your cricket journey through domestic, league & international matches.
• Play over 400 matches, spanning 25 series across 3 brackets in various formats. 
• Enjoy stunning visual cutscenes that convey your story contextually at every stage.
• Make tactical decisions in match selection, gear choices, & ability upgrades.
Build & manage your own team!
• Form your ultimate team as a cricket team captain, manager, player, and coach.
• Player Upgrade Cards improve your individual Squad members across 18 disciplines.
• Create & customize your Squad with specialist batsmen, devastating bowlers & versatile all-rounders.
Exhilarating batting, bowling & fielding simulation!
• All new intuitive & fluid controls.
• All new batting shots and exciting new mechanics.
• Brand new Run, Sprint & Dive mechanics.
• Special deliveries that can devastate the batting side.
• Fielder controls for the first time! Make unbelievable dive stops, direct hits & athletic throws. 
• Multiple camera & control options.
Compete & rise in the ranks!
• The League of Champs will test your skills & pit you against other players for supremacy.
• Rise & conquer an all-new hypercompetitive leaderboard to claim greater rewards.
• Seasonal challenges & regular contests push you to greater heights of glory & give you stunningly entertaining gaming sessions.
• All new progression through 50 epic Badges of merit from “Vulnerable” to “Godly” that showcase your prowess to other players.
• Earn Platinum from challenging new Daily Missions that push you to the limits.
• Win exciting drops and loot in Kits graded through Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic & Legendary!
• Face off against other players in gritty multiplayer modes for the ultimate test of skill.
Get right into the action for a holistic mobile cricketing experience.
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
By subscribing to the Pro VIP Pass for Rs.99 a month, you get:
1. Stadiums, Series, Test Matches, Advanced Customization
2. 2x Platinum Rewards (without ads)
3. Ad-free game
Subscriptions will auto-renew every month unless you turn them off. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your account settings. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. Any matches in progress during the subscription period will be forfeited, and VIP Pack content will be rescinded if the subscription is not renewed. 
Terms of use: https://www.cricketbuddies.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.cricketbuddies.com/privacy-policy
#thebestneverrest

bluejetty:00165808:ios.description:
Step into the magical world of "Connected Hearts: Hour of the Witch", a gripping blend of puzzle adventure games and casual games, where you’ll experience a heartwarming love story caught in a web of dark sorcery. In this epic find missing object game, join Princess Aurora as she battles to break free from a forced marriage and reclaim her true love. Your journey through the cursed kingdom of Aradon will test your skills in brain teasers and logical thinking, as you face challenging puzzles, explore enchanted locations, and uncover secrets that could change their fate. Can Aurora and Adrian’s love conquer the curse, or will the evil witch Selena destroy their future?
The kingdom of Aradon has long suffered beneath the shadow of dark sorcery. Salvation requires an alliance, sealed by Princess Aurora’s marriage to a cruel prince. Yet Aurora’s heart belongs to another — a once-proud knight named Adrian, now cursed into a monstrous form. Beneath his terrifying appearance lies a heart of gold. Can Aurora break free from the chains of duty? Can Adrian lift the curse and reclaim his true self? And will their love be strong enough to defeat the vengeful witch Selena, whose thirst for revenge threatens to destroy them all?
Embark on a magical adventure!
Guide Princess Aurora, torn between love and duty, and Adrian, a once-proud knight cursed into a monstrous form, as they navigate the perils of dark magic, object finding games, brain teasers and logical thinking!
Solve challenging puzzles!
Test your skills with a variety of find missing object games and casual games, intricate mini-games, and find objects in a picture that are woven into the story. Every puzzle you solve brings Aurora and Adrian one step closer to breaking the curse and reclaiming their happiness!
Shape your destiny!
Your decisions hold the power to change the course of the point and click adventure games story. Choose carefully in key moments, as your choices will determine whether Aurora and Adrian can triumph over evil, or whether they will be separated forever by fate!
Explore the enchanted kingdom!
Venture across the richly detailed kingdom of Aradon, from haunted forests to majestic castles, uncovering hidden objects and secrets. Unlock achievements that reward your exploration and showcase your mastery over the mystery hidden object games challenges that lie in wait!
Prepare for a magical journey where love, destiny, and puzzles intertwine in "Connected Hearts: Hour of the Witch"!

bluejetty:00146887:ios.description:
Want to increase views and engagement on Stories, Reels, and posts? Easy!
Leto is not just a subtitle creation app. It’s a full editor for creative formatting of all types of content!
Main features of the "Leto" app:
• Over 500 stylish unique fonts, including calligraphic, animated, print, and other font types.
• Photo and video editor: A complete set of tools for creating stylish stories, posts, Reels, and any other visual content.
• Ready-made templates and collages: Pre-installed templates for Stories, posts, and Reels to help you quickly create professional-looking content.
• Subtitles: Add subtitles to videos with one click. Customize the style, color, and animation to make the content more dynamic.
• Layer blending: 17 blending modes allow you to experiment with effects and create unique compositions.
• Background removal: Remove backgrounds with one tap to create collages or highlight necessary elements.
• Augmented Reality (AR): Add fonts and stickers to real environments for photos and videos, creating impressive content.
• Outline for text and stickers: Add outlines to highlight important elements and make them more expressive.
• Effects and filters: Apply effects like blur, “Poster” filter, and “Glass” effect to create stylish visual content.
What you'll find in "Leto":
• Over 200 bright fonts: Trendy blogger fonts, including animated ones that can be exported with a transparent background for use in other apps.
• Over 300 calligraphic fonts: Including handwritten styles to add personality to your content.
• Over 1500 stickers: Conveniently categorized to enhance videos and Stories.
• Over 2000 backgrounds: For creating a unique style.
New content — fonts, stickers, and backgrounds — is added every week so you’re always one step ahead.
If you choose to use premium features (optional), payment will be charged to your iTunes account. You can turn off the subscription in Apple account settings at any time after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://letofonts.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://letofonts.com/en/terms-conditions/

View your medical records, plan a visit, contact your care team, find a doctor, and more with the new Riverside Healthcare app for Apple devices. The free myRiverside health app offers an array of tools and resources for both Riverside Healthcare patients and visitors.
Manage Your Health:
myRiverside is the secure patient app for Riverside Healthcare featuring MyChart integration. With myRiverside, you can:
• Access your health information and lab results
• Securely message your physician via MyChart
• Schedule new appointments
• Request prescription refills
• View statements and pay your bill
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs
• Login using your existing Riverside MyChart credentials
Find Doctors and Locations:
We know how important it is to find the right healthcare provider. Whether you’re an existing Riverside Healthcare patient searching for a specialist or a prospective patient hoping to find a doctor in the south suburbs of Chicago, we’re here to help.
• Search doctors by specialty, insurance carrier, language preferences, and more
• View detailed profiles for over 150 Riverside Healthcare providers: locations, practice focus area, availability, and board certifications
• Quickly and easily locate nearby Riverside Healthcare locations, including Emergency Care and Immediate Care clinics
Access Visitor Resources:
• View parking and transportation options
• Access hospital maps and view on-site amenities
• View nearby hotels and lodging
The free myRiverside app provides detailed information for Riverside Healthcare’s locations, services, immediate care wait times, directions and more.

bluejetty:00066247:ios.summary:

Road to Valor: World War II is a real-time PVP strategy game where you can compete with global players around the world as a General of World War II, the biggest war
bluejetty:00066247:ios.description:
"Dive into the battlefield of World War II! General, give us an order!"
Road to Valor: World War II is a real-time PVP strategy game where you can compete with global players around the world as a General of World War II, the biggest war in history.
Select “Command” that suits your own strategy style and collect various units to build the strongest troops. Fight against swarms of enemies in the realistically presented battlefield. Destroy enemy Headquarter and bunkers to get medals as well as the most glorious victory!
Please note! Road to Valor: World War II is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased in cash. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. You need an Internet connection to play the game.
[Features]
● Compete with global players in real time. Start a challenge to be a ruler of the world!
● You can select factions from among the Allied and Axis powers!
● Select a specific command strategy, such as Support Ops, Airborne Ops, Fortification Doctrine, Blitzkrieg Doctrine and more. Combine them with powerful Active Skills! The strategy is the key to win!
● Collect different type of history-based units such as Infantry, Vehicles, Tanks, and Buildings. Build the strongest troop and gain the victory. Also, there are some heroes who motivated by real war heroes.
● Get rewards from Crates to collect new powerful units or Upgrade remaining units.
● Destroy the enemy headquarter and bunkers to receive medals and Reward Crates. Don’t forget to open Free Crates given every day!
● Gain Rank Points to enter the higher Battlefield to unlock new and more powerful Units to use. Try until you reach the highest Battlefield!
● You can gain or lose Rank Points by each Battle Victory or Defeat. Dive into a global competition with players around the world to become the greatest General in the world! 
● Create a community, “Corps”. Share units with Corps members from the same Faction and have a debate on winning strategies to enjoy the game even more!
If you need any help, send us an email at the below address.
[Support]
support@dreamotion-help.freshdesk.com
For the latest updates, visit the below link. 
[Official Facebook]
https://www.facebook.com/RoadtoValorWWII
[Terms of Service]
http://dreamotion.us/termsofservice
[Privacy Policy]
http://dreamotion.us/privacy-policy

Lungs capacity & strengthening | Immunity & Endurance | Pulmonary breathing help etc
•Control body’s subtle energy balance like:-
Lowering blood pressure | Balancing the nervous system
•Habits and addictions programs:-
Reduce anxiety and stress | Reduce Caffeine | Sleep aid | Concentration and productivity
•HRV Heart rate monitor | True Heart rate variability :-
Breathe by observing breath-cardio relation to gain insights and improve your breathing in day to day life.
•Advanced HRV analysis for health monitoring:-
HRV is a non-invasive measure of the autonomic nervous system and is used as an indicator for various aspects related to health, performance & well-being.
Measurements indicate -
-General health
-Stress and energy level
-Your performance capacity
HRV Metrics:-
SDNN, Rmssd, Sdsd, pNN20, pNN50
High frequency HF, Low frequency LF
Breathwork | Salient points:-
-Adjust breathing intensity on the fly (selected techniques only)
-Description and science behind a breathing exercise
-Guided breathing with animated instructions
-Search relevant breathing exercise
-Progress tracker
•The basics of breathing:-
Get started with simple deep breathing, accompanied visualizations will help you get used to the basics.
•Pranayama course:-
The de-facto work from the Indian tradition which covers every intricate detail concerning breath-work, we have included a stepwise program to increase your breathing capabilities including lung capacity and overall Immunity.
•Kundalini meditation series:-
A vast and intricate system of awakening our internal energies has been developed over thousands of years, these include a combination of postures, movements, and breathwork. We have included a few exercises which are simple, work instantly and deliver results.
•Tibetan breathing meditation:-
We have included some beautiful techniques from their tradition, including the Tibetan fire breath (Tummo) and Tibetan body Detox technique.
Mindbreath-
-Manage stress, stay focused, energetic & sleep better

-Gain insights into your health

bluejetty:00088257:ios.description:
AssetDash - Track Everything. Trade Solana. Stay Ahead.
AssetDash is your real-time dashboard for tracking tokens, NFTs, and stocks — all in one app.
Basic Portfolio Tracking (Free Tier)
Get started with free tracking for Solana network tokens and NFTs. Includes:
- Portfolio syncing for up to 3 Solana wallets
- Net worth and allocation breakdowns for Solana-based assets
- Categorized views for Solana tokens and NFTs
- To track other chains, exchanges, or brokerages, upgrade to AssetDash Premium.
Instant Solana Trading with Ultra Swap (Free)
Trade Solana tokens directly in the app with lightning speed and confidence.
Features include best route execution, MEV protection, dynamic routing, quick buy buttons, and fast transaction confirmation.
Unlock More with AssetDash Premium (Subscription Required)
AssetDash Premium is an optional monthly subscription that unlocks full portfolio tracking and analytics. Features include:
- Tracking for unlimited wallets, tokens, DeFi, NFTs, and stocks
- Support for major chains like Ethereum, Base, Hyperliquid, and Bitcoin
- Integration with top exchanges and brokerages including Robinhood, Coinbase, Binance, WeBull, and more
- Real-time updates and deeper analytics across all asset classes
Subscription Details:
$4.99/month (price may vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings. Access remains active through the end of the current billing period.
Privacy First
No KYC required. Secure, read-only access. Never exposes keys or personal data. Reads blockchain data directly from public addresses.
How It Works
- Create an account with your email
- Add your Solana wallets (up to 3 for free)
- Upgrade to unlock full portfolio tracking
AssetDash is built for the next generation of investors.
Track smart. Trade fast. Stay in control.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.assetdash.com/privacy

Pick a ring and put on stack which contain same color ring on the top, or empty tube.

Don't forget to share your experience with us. We always try to improve the game better. Thank you so much.

bluejetty:00115683:ios.description:
Welcome to Aisle Secrets: Merge the Drama — where mystery meets healing.
After a messy divorce, Ellie thought her life couldn’t get worse—until she was told the only way to uncover the truth was to run a shop in a quiet little town with more secrets than people. Now stuck in Love Town, she’s handed the keys to a rundown pharmacy and told to make it work.
What starts as survival becomes something more. As Ellie merges items, revives the store, and meets eccentric townsfolk, she begins to uncover the tangled web of secrets hidden in plain sight！
Merge, Build, and Discover
 Combine everyday items to renovate and expand your pharmacy. From dusty shelves to modern wellness counters, it's up to you to transform this place into a thriving shop！
Story-Rich Drama
 Every customer has a story. Some are heartwarming, others heartbreaking—and a few are downright suspicious. Follow Ellie’s journey as she regains control of her life and untangles the truth behind her arrival！
Customize & Create
 Upgrade the pharmacy, decorate the town square, and give Ellie a fresh new life as she grows from reluctant outsider to determined entrepreneur！
Romance, Rivalries & Secrets
 Love Town may look quiet, but beneath its charming surface are old flames, nosy neighbors, and hidden enemies. Who can Ellie trust—and what will she do when the past catches up?
Play Aisle Secrets: Merge the Drama today and start your journey of healing, discovery, and maybe a little revenge！

bluejetty:00015303:ios.description:
Get your little one preschool ready with the award-winning Hopster! 
Hopster is expertly designed with kids early learning years in mind. Parents gain access to the best curated kids learning content needed to shape their child's early development curriculum. 
Hopster fully supports formal early childhood curriculums from around the world, with the best preschool kids TV shows & educational games. 
Hopster is also 100% ad-free. Packed with learning games for kids, as well as great preschool books and fun music. 
Your little one can be ahead of the class before they even go to school, with our phonics shows, maths games for kids, and more. 
We can help keep your kids busy with lots of fun, creative & educational content - and you can relax knowing they’re continuing to learn in a safe child-friendly environment.
Your little one can learn phonics, enjoy maths games for kids, and watch family friendly preschool shows – all in a safe and ad-free digital environment trusted by over 2 million families.
Top reasons to download Hopster:
1. Handpicked educational kids TV shows
2. Learning games for kids
3. A safe digital world for little ones to explore
4. Watch shows offline, perfect for travelling
5. 100% ad-free
6. Use on iPad, iPhone and Apple TV with just one subscription
Children can explore the award-winning kids app Hopster with a free trial of our premium subscription. See how your little one engages with our preschool learning games for kids - including phonics and maths games for kids.
All your kids’ favorite shows, including:
• Fireman Sam
• Sesame Street
• Pingu
• StoryBots
• Messy Goes to Okido
• Bob the Builder
• Earth to Luna
• ...and many more!
Available shows may vary by region.
Even with all these amazing educational TV shows for kids on Hopster we do believe that there is such a thing as too much TV. If your kid watches three episodes in a row, we will suggest that they try another activity instead.
Made in partnership with some of the UK's brainiest academics, our app includes fun educational games that engage toddlers & preschoolers in phonics and creativity, plus they will get a head start with numeracy using our maths games for kids.
Award-winning developmental shows and learning games for kids focusing on:
• Maths games for kids with counting, numerals and sequences
• Alphabet and phonics
• Empathy, caring, communication and decision making
Awards & certifications:
• KidScreen Award 2019, 2018, and 2016
• App Store’s Best of 2016, 2015 & 2014
• Best Channel BAFTA Children's Award nomination
Hopster is a popular choice for parents wanting a safe digital environment for their kids to explore.
Hopster is available in English (UK/US), French, Icelandic, Serbian, Bosnian, Slovenian.
Hopster Subscription
• Subscription length will vary from Monthly, Quarterly, 6 Months, and Yearly
• Price of subscription will vary depending on plan selected, and region
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s
• Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy & Safety
Your child’s privacy and safety is our top priority. We will never share your personal information with 3rd parties or sell it on. And there are no ads in our toddler & pre school kids’ TV app. Ever. No really, we mean it.
Privacy Policy: www.hopster.tv/cookies-and-privacy-policy
T&Cs: www.hopster.tv/terms-and-conditions

Whether you follow a few favorite stocks or manage multiple portfolios, Stock Master helps you watch what matters and act on it.
REAL-TIME QUOTES & WATCHLISTS
Follow live prices with streaming quotes, pre-market and after-hours data, key stats (market cap, open, high, low, volume, P/E, EPS), and company news. Organize symbols into multiple watchlists. (Real-time quotes for US markets; some exchanges may be delayed.)
PORTFOLIO TRACKER
Track your investments with full transaction history: open and closed positions, FIFO cost basis, stock splits, dividends, cash, and multi-currency holdings. Export to CSV, PDF, Excel, or plain text. Sign in free to back up and sync your data.
ALERTS THAT WATCH THE MARKET FOR YOU
Set it and step away — our servers monitor your alerts around the clock and send a push notification the moment a trigger hits. Alert on price, daily change or percent, volume, change from entry, trailing stops, and even technical-indicator trends. Choose from 18 alert sounds. No account required.
AI ANALYSIS
Generate on-demand AI analysis for any stock — or your whole portfolio — in plain English, and ask follow-up questions with Finabase AI chat. AI content is informational only, not investment advice.
ADVANCED CHARTS & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Line, candlestick, and OHLC charts with 45+ technical indicators (MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, ADX, ATR, and more) plus 60+ automatic candlestick-pattern overlays. Draw trend lines, Fibonacci retracements and fans, channels, and more with 14 drawing tools. Replay past price action bar by bar.
STOCK SCREENER
Scan NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, TSX, LSE, ASX, NSE, NZX, and more with 100+ fundamental and technical criteria. Save your screens and rerun them anytime.
TREND SCORE & BACKTESTING
Rank stocks by trend strength with Trend Score, built on backtested technical strategies — then test your own trading strategies against historical data.
BEYOND STOCKS
Futures on major world indexes, live forex rates, US Treasury yields, commodities, ETFs, options chains, an earnings calendar, and top cryptocurrencies.
MARKET NEWS
Business and finance headlines from leading sources including CNBC, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, Forbes, Business Insider, and more.
HOME-SCREEN WIDGETS
Six widgets keep the market on your home screen: single stock, watchlist, portfolio summary, portfolio list, market heat map, and index comparison.
PRACTICE & COMMUNITY
Sharpen your skills with virtual trading on real-time quotes, climb the leaderboard, and see what other investors are discussing.
Stock Master is a market tracking and research tool, not a brokerage — no real trades are placed through the app, and nothing in it is personalized investment advice. Investing involves risk.
GO PREMIUM

bluejetty:00186117:ios.description:
Fall in love with Torah
If you love learning Torah, or if you want to love learning Torah, you’ve come to the right place. Whether you’ve been learning in yeshiva for years or you’re just beginning your Torah journey, you’re sure to find something meaningful and surprising waiting for you here.
Aleph Beta is a unique kind of Torah library. Led by our founder, Rabbi David Fohrman, we are dedicated to high-level, textual Torah learning for adults that is intellectually and spiritually sophisticated, that enlivens your Jewish practice and helps you forge a deeper connection to God. Browse our library of over 1,000 beautifully produced videos, podcasts, deep dive courses, and printable guides, and fall in love with Torah — for the first time, or all over again.
With our stunning video animations and expertly-produced podcasts, learning Torah is engaging and meaningful at the same time. Have something to say at the Shabbos table that will amaze your family and guests and bring deep meaning into their lives.
Dive deep into these topics:
Weekly Parsha｜Jewish Holidays & Fast Days｜Laws & Mitzvot｜Prayer｜Tanakh Stories｜Difficult Questions｜Personal Growth｜& much more.
Enjoy top-of-the-line features:
Watch or listen, with convenient background play｜Adjust playback speed｜Gather round the whole family in front of the big screen with our “casting” feature｜Downloadable for offline use｜and much more
About Aleph Beta:
We are a nonprofit organization that is dedicated to learning Torah in a way that is deep and serious, fun and playful, relevant and mysterious. Our hard-working team includes scholars, editors, producers, animators, and website developers, all of whom are passionate about Aleph Beta’s mission: giving people the tools to fall in love with the Torah. Our organization is funded entirely by our subscribers - people like you. Our content is made available with a paid subscription. We offer a 14 day free trial to see the magic for yourself, before you need to subscribe. We’re hoping you don’t look at us like any other app that you pay for — but rather as a cause that you’d be proud to support.
Contact support directly by emailing info@alephbeta.org

The flagship podcast the Sports Gambling Podcast is hosted by Sean Green, a Philly area native and Ryan Kramer a New Jersey native who bring over 50 years of sports gambling experience to the airwaves each and every week.

The guys cover the full spectrum of the sports gambling universe including the biggest sports and gambling news stories, fantasy sports previews, handicapping strategy, big game previews, line movement analysis and free picks for the NFL, college football, NBA, NCAAB, MLB, UFC, boxing, soccer and more.

If you’re looking to learn more about sports betting, the Sports Gambling Podcast Network app is the perfect app. It gives users free sports gambling tips, sports betting strategies and of course sports gambling picks. If you’re a seasoned sports bettor or a novice sports gambler the Sports Gambling Podcast Network app has helpful sports handicapping information and content.

You can access all the free sports gambling picks via the SGPN app. Plus you can listen to the Sports Gambling Podcast™, the Sport Gambling Podcast Network™, the NBA Gambling Podcast, the Golf Gambling Podcast, the MMA Gambling Podcast, the College Football Experience, the College Basketball Experience, the SGPN Fantasy Football Podcast, the MLB Gambling Podcast and more!

The Sports Gambling Podcast was first launched in 2011 and has grown in success over the years amassing millions of downloads. The Sports Gambling Podcast Network was launched in 2018 and is the home. to over 15 sports betting podcast feeds. In addition the SGPN app gives you free access to their entire offering of free sports betting picks, including free NFL picks, free college football picks, free NBA picks, free NHL picks, free MMA picks and free golf picks. If there is sports betting happening on a particular sport you can be sure SGPN, the Sports Gambling Podcast Network is covering it.

The true separating factor from the Sports Gambling Podcast Network app and other sports gambling apps is the entertainment value. The SGPN hosts and writers that make up the Sports Gambling Podcast Network excel at providing entertaining sports gambling content which makes it truly a must have sports betting app.

The Sports Gambling Podcast doesn't sell picks, they make picks. Download the app today to start being a better sports bettor and have fun doing it.

bluejetty:00153249:ios.description:
Stick and puck become a joystick in the Dangleverse! Rush down an endless frozen river in Dangleverse's premiere game... Odd Man Rush! 
◉ REAL DANGLES
Move the puck sideways to go left and right, move the puck forward to jump or toe drag to slide.
◉ FUN COLLECTIBLES
Collect coins, gems, balloons, and slides while avoiding the obstacles that come your way.
◉ FOR ALL SKILL LEVELS
For kids, beer leaguers, or elite prospects... we've got a level for you.
◉ OBSTACLES
Each level includes dozens of obstacle configurations which test your skill and promote rapid improvement.
◉ TUTORIAL LEVEL
A tutorial shows you the ropes so you'll be chasing high scores in no time. 
◉ PLAY ANYWHERE
Play on any surface: synthetic tiles, asphalt, concrete, carpet... or even straight on your new hardwood floors!
◉ PUCKS OR BALLS
You can use a regular puck, Xenopuck, Green Biscuit or any training/street hockey ball. Regular pucks and Xenopucks work best with a white surface and white tape on your stick blade.
◉ DEVICES
Make sure to install the Dangleverse app on two devices:
1. iPhone (A13 chip or newer), iPad (A12X chip or newer) for puck tracking
2. iPad, iPhone, Apple TV streaming box, Mac (M1 chip or newer) for gameplay screen
◉ TRACKING
Tracking device should be positioned 36-48" (0.9-1.2m) above the ground with rear cameras facing down at your stick handling area.
◉ FINE PRINT
→ Dangleverse is free to download, but access to games requires a purchase
→ For support please email us at support@dangleverse.com
→ Links to our terms of service and privacy policy can be found at https://dangleverse.com

bluejetty:00024929:ios.summary: TaskieHusky is a gamified To-do & Productivity App for parents that helps motivate their kids to do daily chores, acquire positive habits, get self-organization skills, do their homework, and take responsibility. Give your child tasks and c
bluejetty:00024929:ios.description:
TaskieHusky is a gamified To-do & Productivity App for parents that helps motivate their kids to do daily chores, acquire positive habits, get self-organization skills, do their homework, and take responsibility. Give your child tasks and choose rewards. 
The app will do the rest. 
Now, experience all these features with our 7-day free trial. After the trial period, subscribe to continue enjoying the full benefits of TaskieHusky.
HOW IT WORKS
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
 • You choose tasks to focus on. 
Create your own tasks or choose a few focus areas for TaskieHusky to recommend exciting activities.
 • Your child starts playing. 
They’ll earn points and achievements for completing tasks and chores.
 • You keep track of their progress. 
Every time they claim a task is completed, you’ll receive a notification to approve it.
 • You choose exciting rewards. 
Encourage and reward your child for completing chores and tasks. 
 • Your child builds habits while having fun. 
Celebrate their progress and receive detailed weekly reports.
YOUR CHILD = YOUR TEAMMATE
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Get to know your child better: after all, you’re on the same team. Share daily tasks, achieve common goals, and help each other grow.
Draw on your child’s love for gadgets and video games to engage them with no hassle. Family routine can and should be fun for everyone.
ROUTINE BUILDING STARTS EARLY
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Daily routine, including habits and chores, is unlikely to ever change after the age of 9. As researchers from Brown University have recently discovered, it takes firm root by the third grade and remains the same up to high school graduation. If you want to teach your child responsibility, it’s best to start early.
BACKED BY SCIENCE
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
• Creates a habit loop. 
For our brain, habit building as a loop that consists of three elements: a cue, routine, and reward. Choose habits, establish a schedule, and decide on rewards. TaskieHusky will help your child have fun at each step of the loop and build healthy habits.
• Gamifies chores and tasks. 
Teaching your child responsibility and helping them build healthy habits don’t need to be boring. In fact, science says the best way to learn is to have fun along the way. Video games are so addictive for children and adults alike for a good reason: they’re fun, engaging, and give a sense of progress. Learning, too, can be all that and even more. Gamification does magic for education, as numerous studies have shown. 
• Uses gadgets to help built healthy habits. 
Children love their gadgets, which can be a problem at times. Why ban them, though, when you can harness their power to help your child build a healthy routine? With TaskieHusky, you can turn your child’s gadgets into powerful tools for habit building. Household chores, homework, and other parts of their routine will become an engaging mobile game.
Get in Touch:
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
• Shoot us an email: hello@taskiehusky.com
• Read our Privacy Policy: https://taskiehusky.com/privacy_policy
• Read our Terms of Use: https://taskiehusky.com/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00068762:ios.description:
Discover what to see, plan a day around your interests, and explore on foot with walking itineraries and an interactive city map. Less time planning. More time enjoying the trip.
- Personalized day plans based on your interests and available time.
- Walking itineraries with clear stops and estimated walking times.
- An interactive map to explore places and see where to go next.
- Sights, history, art, architecture, parks and more to match your mood.
- Useful place details to help you decide what to visit.
- My Day to bring your chosen places together in one plan.
YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY
A few hours to spare or a full day to explore? Choose what you feel like doing and how much time you have. Get a suggested plan, review the stops, and adapt it to the day you want. Spend more time on the things that interest you, whether that means a museum visit, remarkable architecture or a walk through green spaces.
TURN IDEAS INTO A DAY OUT
Browse places by interest, take a closer look at what catches your eye, and add your choices to My Day. Bring together the sights you came to see and places you might otherwise have walked past.
EXPLORE ONE STOP AT A TIME
Pick a walking itinerary, preview its stops and walking times, and see how it fits into your day. Use the map to put each place in context and find your next stop as you explore.
KNOW MORE BEFORE YOU GO
Find out what makes each place worth a visit, check practical details and estimated visit times, and decide where to spend your time.
Download your travel companion and make your next day out your own.

bluejetty:00149633:ios.name: Pivot Journey
bluejetty:00149633:ios.summary: Quitting smoking is really hard - and like anything really hard you’ll be more successful going into it with a plan, skills, confidence and support. Pivot is here to support you on your journey to become smoke free. Quit now or start reduci
bluejetty:00149633:ios.description:
Quitting smoking is really hard - and like anything really hard you’ll be more successful going into it with a plan, skills, confidence and support. Pivot is here to support you on your journey to become smoke free. Quit now or start reducing and quit for good at your own pace – with Pivot you quit your way.
Small Steps to Success: Pivot helps you understand how quitting smoking can positively affect your health and life and gives you motivation for change. Activities and educational resources help you learn your personal smoking habits, develop personal strategies to overcome your triggers and stressors, build skills to quit, practice quitting and gain confidence in your ability to control your urges and stay quit. Break up quitting into small steps to make it easy for you to stop smoking.
Stay Quit: Quitting smoking for good takes time, the journey doesn’t end the second you stop. Daily check-ins from Pivot help keep you accountable. Educational resources for after you quit help you learn how to deal with tough situations. Pivot supports you long-term to maintain your smoke free lifestyle. Whether you’re ready to quit now or thinking about quitting, Pivot can help.
Your Pivot Journey to Quitting:
-Learn. Increase your motivation and interest in quitting before you quit smoking, learn quit skills and build confidence. Coaches provide you support along the way
-Reduce. If you’re not ready to quit right away, reduce your smoking and practice coping with triggers and habits. Keep reducing and you can eventually quit
-Prepare to Quit. If you’re ready to quit, use Pivot to build your quit plan right away. You’ll explore your triggers, build strategies to fight cravings and have a plan to deal with tough situations
-Quit. When your quit date comes, put your quit plan into action. Don’t worry if you slip up, Pivot can help you get back on track. Your coach will rally behind you to give you support throughout your smoking cessation process
- Maintain. Sustaining change after a long time with any habit takes time and effort. Pivot can support you and help you keep learning to make sure your quit is stable.
Daily Tracker for Progress:
-Pivot has an FDA cleared smart sensor that measures carbon monoxide in your breath from smoking. The sensor gives you immediate feedback for how smoking affects your carbon monoxide levels, and increases your motivation to reduce and quit cigarettes. 
-The breath sensor provides a reading of your carbon monoxide levels: green (non-smoker), yellow (on the way to smoke-free) or red (smoking)
-Use the sensor to challenge yourself: reduce or quit smoking to get to green levels
-Every day is an opportunity to improve and reduce your levels of carbon monoxide
Build Motivation:
-Explore your reasons for smoking and quitting, build knowledge, and develop coping skills to increase motivation
-See your progress by tracking cigarettes and skipped cigarettes 
Life Coaches:
-Trained smoking cessation coaches know the unique challenges smokers face
-Get paired with a coach to guide you with expert advice and no-stress support
Based on science and rooted in empathy, let Pivot Journey be your guide to quitting smoking. We would be honored to help you achieve your goal.
Join our community & follow us on social media. 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pivotjourney
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pivotjourney/
For information about our Privacy Policy, click here: https://pivot.co/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00179314:ios.description:
Be it at airports, inside trains, at convenience stores or cafes, this app connects you to public Wi-Fi all over Japan.
All you need to do is download the app and register once. No need configure for any Wi-Fi spots!
If it is a Wi-Fi you have connected to even once, then no configuring is required in that Wi-Fi spot! As soon as you get to the Wi-Fi spot, you can use the Internet.
Notifies you via a pop-up message as soon as you are connected to Wi-Fi.
It is lightweight in performance and conserves more battery power compared to our previous apps. You can use public Wi-Fi more easily, comfortably, and with peace of mind.
[Features of Japan Wi-Fi Auto-connect]
The corresponding Wi-Fi service is available at the likes of public transit and facilities at stations, airports, etc., and at trade outlets of convenience and department stores, etc. offering highly reliable public Wi-Fi service. The service will automatically connect you only to those access points that are secure, trustworthy, and from reliable providers. 
Does not connect to the so-called "spoofing access points". These Wi-Fi points are disguised as legitimate access points, making it hard for customers using Wi-Fi to detect. 
You can view sightseeing information, information regarding shop services, disaster information, etc. relevant to the Wi-Fi service coverage area.
The app now automatically connects to Wi-Fi that supports OpenRoaming.
Supported languages:
Japanese・English・Korean・Chinese (simplified, traditional)・Taiwanese・ Vietnamese・Indonesian・Malay・Tagalog・French・Spanish・German・Italian・Russian・Portuguese
Supported Wi-Fi services：
http://www.ntt-bp.net/jw-auto/ja/list/index.html
Wi-Fi spot map：
https://jw2.cdn.wifi-cloud.jp/map/ja/index.html

bluejetty:00126581:ios.name: QR Code Reader: Quick Scan
bluejetty:00126581:ios.summary: QR Code Reader is a fast, free QR code scanner for iPhone. Simple and easy to use: open the app, point your camera at a code and it reads instantly, with no buttons to press and no photos to take. The scanned content is recognized automatic
bluejetty:00126581:ios.description:
QR Code Reader is a fast, free QR code scanner for iPhone. Simple and easy to use: open the app, point your camera at a code and it reads instantly, with no buttons to press and no photos to take. The scanned content is recognized automatically, so URLs and text are ready to open, copy or share in seconds. Barcode scanning is supported too.
■ Scan QR codes in seconds
The camera starts as soon as you open the app. Aim it at a QR code and it is detected automatically, so you can scan the moment you need to. The app recognizes what the code contains: open the link, copy the text or share it, without typing web addresses by hand.
■ Scan QR codes from images
Got a QR code in a screenshot or a photo? The app reads QR codes directly from images in your photo library. When a code appears on your own iPhone screen, you don't need a second device: take a screenshot and read it right away. It also works for QR code images sent by email or chat.
■ Scan history always at hand
Every scan is saved to your history automatically, so you can reopen links, websites and text anytime. You can also share the whole history list at once: scan many QR codes or barcodes in a row, then send them all together. Your history is stored locally on your device.
■ Scan barcodes to look up products
Point the camera at a product barcode and jump straight to a product search: compare prices and check details while shopping.
■ Main features
- Automatic scanning — point the camera at a code and scanning starts on its own
- QR code & barcode scanner — reads both QR codes and barcodes
- Scan from image — detect codes in photos and screenshots
- Scan history — reopen any past scan with one tap
- Share in bulk — send your scan history list in one go
- Flashlight — scan even in the dark or in low light
- Copy, open or share — open results in Safari or Chrome, copy them or send them to friends
- Private — scan history stays on your device
- No account — no sign-up, no registration
- Free — all features are free to use
■ One scanner for many codes
- QR codes — open websites, read text, view details
- Restaurant menus — scan the code on the table to see the menu
- Coupons & promos — scan discount codes from your favorite brands
- Food packages — open product pages from QR codes on the label
- Posters, flyers & ads — jump to campaigns and event pages
- Product barcodes — scan an item and jump to a product search to compare prices
■ Simple, fast and easy to use
QR codes are everywhere these days: menus, ads, posters, packages and tickets. With a simple QR scanner on your iPhone, you can check any code the moment you see it. The design is clean, there are no complicated settings, and the app is made for everyday use. If you are new to the iPhone, or you simply want a scanner that just works, this app is for you.
■ Good to know
This app is a scanner only: it does not create or generate QR codes. Your scan history is stored locally on your device, and no account is needed at any point.
■ Pricing
All features are free to use. The app shows ads, and there are no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no paid plans.
■ Download QR Code Reader today
Scan, save and share QR codes and barcodes with one simple app. Download now and read your first code just seconds after opening the app!

bluejetty:00062875:ios.summary: Teachers can grade multiple choice tests, quizzes, and assessments instantly in the classroom by using their iPhone or iPad's camera as a scanner. It is the most cost effective, fastest, and most accurate way to grade tests in the classroo
bluejetty:00062875:ios.description:
Teachers can grade multiple choice tests, quizzes, and assessments instantly in the classroom by using their iPhone or iPad's camera as a scanner. It is the most cost effective, fastest, and most accurate way to grade tests in the classroom or where ever you are. 
-------------------------------------------------------- 
* Free answer sheets available in several formats and sizes up to 100 questions (including custom form wizard)
* Organizes results for reporting and exporting via PDF and Excel-readable format
* Uses student ID numbers or written name of student for reporting.
* Use companion website (www.zipgrade.com) to manage your data and upload student lists and review results in dozens of reports and exports.
--------------------------------------------------------
Use for exit tickets, formative assessments, or regular quizzes. Stores results by students, subject, and quiz. 
By giving teachers the flexibility to grade papers instantly anywhere, ZipGrade provides immediate feedback on current knowledge and can be used to better focus lessons and assignments. 
Download ZipGrade free with access to all features and website, but limited to 100 scans per month. After you've used it for a class or two, use the in-app purchase a non-recurring subscription with unlimited scanning.

bluejetty:00177730:ios.name: CamCarDer
bluejetty:00177730:ios.summary: Turn your iPhone into a smart dashcam. CamCarDer (say "Cam-Car-Der") records every drive in sharp video with GPS location and speed, reads speed limit signs, guides you turn by turn, and keeps the clips that matter safe. Mount your iPhone o
bluejetty:00177730:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a smart dashcam. CamCarDer (say "Cam-Car-Der") records every drive in sharp video with GPS location and speed, reads speed limit signs, guides you turn by turn, and keeps the clips that matter safe. Mount your iPhone on the dash, tap Start Recording, and drive.
Why drivers choose CamCarDer:
• Proof when you need it. After a fender bender, show your insurer exactly what happened: video stamped with date, time, speed and a live map of where you were.
• Catch the unexpected. Wildlife, wild drivers, a meteor across the sky: if it happens on the road, you have it.
• Built for the car. A dark, glanceable interface designed to be read at a glance, day or night.
ALL-NEW DESIGN
A completely redesigned app with a modern glass look. Big, clear speed numbers, a real-looking speed limit sign, one-tap controls and a dark interface that's easy on the eyes at night.
SPEED LIMIT SIGN DETECTION
• Reads speed limit signs while you record, right on your iPhone
• Works in the US and Canada (rectangular signs) and in Europe and the UK (round red-ring signs)
• Picks the right sign type and units automatically from your location, with nothing to set up
• Shows the current limit on screen and warns you, with an optional voice alert, when you go over
NAVIGATION WHILE YOU RECORD
• Turn-by-turn directions on a floating map card
• Clear arrows, distance to the next turn and arrival time
• Hide the map and the next turn stays visible in a compact banner
RECORDING
• Four quality levels from Low to Ultra, with optional audio and image stabilization
• Records with front and back cameras at once on supported iPhones
• Automatic clips of 1 or 5 minutes
• GPS location, speed and g-force recorded with every frame
• Take photo snapshots without stopping the recording
• Protect important clips with one tap so they're never deleted
• Optional automatic recycling keeps only your latest clips (5 to 500)
• Option to start recording as soon as the app opens, or from a Home Screen quick action
• Dim the screen to reduce heat and save power
HISTORY AND PLAYBACK
• Every drive organized by day, with thumbnails, place names and daily totals
• Ride details with your route colored by speed, distance, top speed and average speed
• Browse all your drives on an interactive map
• Play back video next to a map that follows your position, with speed and coordinates
• Export to Photos with date, time, speed and an animated map built into the video
GOOD TO KNOW
• Continuous GPS use drains the battery quickly. We recommend keeping your iPhone connected to power while recording. Details: https://oxigenator.com/products/camcarder/

listings.name: CamCarDer
listings.description:
Turn your iPhone into a smart dashcam. CamCarDer (say "Cam-Car-Der") records every drive in sharp video with GPS location and speed, reads speed limit signs, guides you turn by turn, and keeps the clips that matter safe. Mount your iPhone on the dash, tap Start Recording, and drive.

Why drivers choose CamCarDer:
• Proof when you need it. After a fender bender, show your insurer exactly what happened: video stamped with date, time, speed and a live map of where you were.
• Catch the unexpected. Wildlife, wild drivers, a meteor across the sky: if it happens on the road, you have it.
• Built for the car. A dark, glanceable interface designed to be read at a glance, day or night.

ALL-NEW DESIGN
A completely redesigned app with a modern glass look. Big, clear speed numbers, a real-looking speed limit sign, one-tap controls and a dark interface that's easy on the eyes at night.

SPEED LIMIT SIGN DETECTION
• Reads speed limit signs while you record, right on your iPhone
• Works in the US and Canada (rectangular signs) and in Europe and the UK (round red-ring signs)
• Picks the right sign type and units automatically from your location, with nothing to set up
• Shows the current limit on screen and warns you, with an optional voice alert, when you go over

NAVIGATION WHILE YOU RECORD
• Turn-by-turn directions on a floating map card
• Clear arrows, distance to the next turn and arrival time
• Hide the map and the next turn stays visible in a compact banner

RECORDING
• Four quality levels from Low to Ultra, with optional audio and image stabilization
• Records with front and back cameras at once on supported iPhones
• Automatic clips of 1 or 5 minutes
• GPS location, speed and g-force recorded with every frame
• Take photo snapshots without stopping the recording
• Protect important clips with one tap so they're never deleted
• Optional automatic recycling keeps only your latest clips (5 to 500)
• Option to start recording as soon as the app opens, or from a Home Screen quick action
• Dim the screen to reduce heat and save power

HISTORY AND PLAYBACK
• Every drive organized by day, with thumbnails, place names and daily totals
• Ride details with your route colored by speed, distance, top speed and average speed
• Browse all your drives on an interactive map
• Play back video next to a map that follows your position, with speed and coordinates
• Export to Photos with date, time, speed and an animated map built into the video

GOOD TO KNOW
• Continuous GPS use drains the battery quickly. We recommend keeping your iPhone connected to power while recording. Details: https://oxigenator.com/products/camcarder/
• If a call comes in or you switch apps, CamCarDer saves the current clip. Start a new one with a tap, or let the app resume recording automatically when you return.
• Speed limit detection is a driving aid. Always follow the actual road signs and traffic laws.

bluejetty:00167843:ios.description:
Welcome to Code Busters: Word Puzzle Game
Challenge your mind with Code Busters: Word Puzzle Game, an exciting puzzle adventure where logic, deduction, and word-solving skills come together. Decode hidden messages, connect numbers to letters, and uncover meaningful phrases as you work through hundreds of engaging challenges.
Discover Hidden Messages
Every puzzle is a unique challenge waiting to be solved. Use logic, recognize patterns, and follow clues to reveal secret messages and complete missing words. As you progress, puzzles become more complex, rewarding careful thinking and attention to detail.
Train Your Brain with Logic Puzzles
Designed for players of all skill levels, Code Busters: Word Puzzle Game combines word puzzles, brain teasers, and reasoning challenges into one enjoyable experience. Improve your vocabulary, strengthen your problem-solving abilities, and sharpen your critical thinking skills while having fun.
Hundreds of Levels to Explore
Enjoy hundreds of carefully crafted levels filled with clues, hidden phrases, and mind-bending challenges. Whether you enjoy word games, logic puzzles, riddles, or deduction-based gameplay, there is always a new puzzle ready to test your skills.
A Fun and Rewarding Learning Experience
Every puzzle encourages logical thinking and mental focus. Connect letters, solve patterns, and uncover complete messages using the information provided. With intuitive gameplay and satisfying progression, every solved puzzle feels rewarding.
Features
• Hundreds of challenging levels
• Hidden messages and secret phrases to uncover
• Logic puzzles, riddles, and brain teasers
• Number and letter-based challenges
• Helpful hints when you need assistance
• Vocabulary and reasoning skill development
• Suitable for beginners and puzzle experts alike
If you enjoy word games, logic puzzles, hidden messages, and brain-training challenges, Code Busters: Word Puzzle Game is the perfect adventure for you. Follow the clues, solve the puzzles, and discover the satisfaction of cracking every challenge.

bluejetty:00014960:ios.name: Advanced Comprehension Therapy
bluejetty:00014960:ios.summary: Train your brain to listen carefully with this professional speech therapy app. Three activities help you to understand sentences, follow directions, and improve language processing. If you’re looking for a speech therapy app for adults and
bluejetty:00014960:ios.description:
Train your brain to listen carefully with this professional speech therapy app. Three activities help you to understand sentences, follow directions, and improve language processing. If you’re looking for a speech therapy app for adults and older children with communication and cognitive impairments that takes understanding beyond single words, this app is for you. 
** Try for FREE by downloading Advanced Language Therapy Lite **
Advanced Comprehension Therapy will help you find where comprehension breaks down, then help you build it back up with 3 classic speech therapy activities targeting sentence-level listening and reading comprehension.
1) IDENTIFY the picture that matches the sentence, increasing in syntactic complexity. Start by finding the picture that matches a sentence like “The baby sleeps.” Work up to finding “The grandparent is told a secret by the child” from closely related pictures.
* 11 levels of difficulty for understanding sentences with nearly 700 unique trials
* Listen, Read, & Both modes to focus on auditory, reading, or total comprehension
* Includes up to 3 nouns, indirect objects, reversible sentences, & passives
2) BUILD a sentence by focusing on each word & how they all fit together. Arrange the words one-by-one to match the pictured sentence you hear. Start with 3 words and work up to 9.
* 20 sentence types in nearly 1200 unique trials
* Add up to 3 extra words for an added challenge
* Tricky "little words" like articles, pronouns, and prepositions
* Hear each word as you touch it
3) FOLLOW directions of increasing difficulty in 1-, 2-, & 3-step commands. Start with exercises like “Touch the pencil.” Work up to brain-bending challenges like “Before you touch the large yellow striped circle, touch the small blue solid star.” 
* 16 levels of difficulty for following directions
* Listen, Read, & Both modes to focus on auditory, reading, or total comprehension
* Includes basic, temporal, & conditional commands in a hierarchy of 1-, 2-, & 3-step directions
In All Activities:
* Enjoy 1000’s of unique stimuli with hundreds of photos
* Use hints when you get stuck so you always finish successfully
* Track progress with detailed e-mail reports 
* Record yourself on-screen and send it when you’re finished
* Repeat audio at any time, or repeat slowly for easier understanding
* Designed with adults in mind but easy enough for children to use 
* No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
-------------------------------------------------
Who is Advanced Comprehension Therapy For?
* Speech-Language Pathologists
* Adults with Aphasia (mild-moderate)
* Stroke & TBI Survivors
* Children with Autism or Language Learning Difficulties
* Anyone who has mastered the single words in Comprehension Therapy or Language 4-in-1 & wants to take their therapy to the next level!
-------------------------------------------------
Which Skills Does This App Target?
* Auditory Comprehension (listening)
* Reading Comprehension 
* Attention to Detail
* Working Memory (holding information)
* Nouns & Pronouns (he/she/it/they)
* Adjectives (colors, size, shading)
* Syntactic Processing (understanding grammar)
* Temporal Concepts (before/after)
* Conditional Directions (if/then)
* Problem Solving (using hint/repeat or fixing errors)
-------------------------------------------------
Download now to get started – or try it for FREE with Advanced Language Therapy Lite!
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00023282:ios.description:
Train Coaster - High-speed Bullet Train is a train app that's really easy to use!
Anyone can use the app intuitively without any instructions and feel as if they were driving a bullet train.
Complete different stages and scenarios by driving the bullet train and navigating the train tracks that branch out like a maze.
●Realistic sense of speed!
The speed of the bullet train changes as it travels up and down the winding slopes! You can even reach speeds as high as ●●●km/h!!
●Use the master controller to freely control the bullet train!
Experience what it feels like to drive a bullet train by reversing up slopes, using emergency brakes, and so on!
●Enjoy thrilling roller coaster-like courses with ups and downs!
After making your way uphill, the train will pick up speed as you drive downhill! You can even go round a full loop!
●Choose from different stages and paths to enjoy a wide range of scenarios!
The bullet train runs through stages such as an urban city, a peaceful mountain, and an amusement park! You will find different places such as railway bridges, tunnels, and rail yards at the end of different paths!
How to play the game
 - Choose your favorite stage where you will drive the train.
 - The train that you drive is random.
 - Change the speed of the train using the up and down controls of the master controller.
 - Change the destination of the train using the path button.
 - Sound the train whistle using the whistle button.
 - You can stop the train at stations, chase other trains around, and enjoy the drive in your favorite way!

bluejetty:00187477:ios.description:
Connect to hundreds of brokers and trade on currency markets from the MetaTrader 4 for iPhone or iPad!
The mobile trading platform allows you to perform trading operations and analyze currency quotes using technical indicators and graphical objects.
Risk Warning: Our programs may involve real trading with a high risk of losing money rapidly. Most retail investor accounts lose money when trading financial products. You should consider whether you understand how various financial products work and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing money.
TRADING
• Real-time quotes of financial instruments
• Full set of trade orders, including pending orders
• Trading from charts in iPad
• All types of trade execution
• Complete trading history
ADVANCED FUNCTIONALITY
• High-performance charts
• Customizable chart color scheme
• Configuring properties of graphical objects and indicators
• Display of four charts in one window available on iPad
• Trade levels visualizing the prices of pending order, as well as SL and TP values on the chart
• Information window that displays orders, trading history, emails, news, and logs on iPad
• Sound notifications
• Financial news — dozens of materials daily
• Secure and fast chats with other traders, creation of group chats and channels
• Support for push-notifications from the desktop platform and MQL5.community services
TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
• Interactive real-time price charts with zoom and scroll options
• 30 most popular technical indicators
• 24 analytical objects: lines, channels, geometric shapes, as well as Gann, Fibonacci and Elliott tools
• 9 timeframes: M1, M5, M15, M30, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN
• 3 types of charts: bars, Japanese candlesticks and broken line
Download MetaTrader 4 and trade on currency markets!
To trade using real money, you need to open a real trading account by entering into a separate agreement with a financial company (broker), which has installed the server component of the MetaTrader 4 trading platform and has the appropriate permissions to provide financial trading service in their respective country. MetaQuotes is a software company and does not provide financial services, nor it has access to MetaTrader 4 platform servers and databases managed by financial companies.

bluejetty:00113626:ios.name: Soccer Questions Quiz
bluejetty:00113626:ios.summary: Football Quiz is a fun trivia game for football fans who want to challenge their knowledge of players, clubs, tournaments, records, and unforgettable moments from the world of football. Answer football trivia questions, learn interesting fa
bluejetty:00113626:ios.description:
Football Quiz is a fun trivia game for football fans who want to challenge their knowledge of players, clubs, tournaments, records, and unforgettable moments from the world of football. Answer football trivia questions, learn interesting facts, and see how far you can go before losing all your lives.
Whether you follow international tournaments, European leagues, legendary players, or modern football stars, Football Quiz gives you a simple and entertaining way to test what you really know about the game.
Football Trivia Questions
Play through football quiz questions covering major competitions, famous players, historic matches, club records, national teams, and surprising football facts. From the Champions League and World Cup to the Euro Cup, Copa America, Premier League, Bundesliga, Primera, and more, the app brings together a wide range of football topics in one quiz experience.
Each question is designed to be quick, interesting, and challenging. Some answers may be easy for true fans, while others will test even experienced football followers.
Key Features:
• Football trivia questions and answers
• Fun facts connected to quiz questions
• Questions about players, clubs, leagues, and tournaments
• Topics from the World Cup, Champions League, Euro Cup, Copa America, Premier League, Bundesliga, Primera, and more
• Available in 14 different languages
• Helpful hints when you get stuck
• Option to skip a difficult question
• Hearts system that works as your lives
• Ask a friend for help when needed
• Certificate after completing the quiz
Play In Multiple Languages
Football Quiz is available in 14 languages, making it easy to enjoy football trivia in the language you prefer. Supported languages include Arabic, Bulgarian, Chinese, Croatian, English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, and Thai.
This makes the quiz enjoyable for football fans from different countries and gives you a great way to play, learn, and test football knowledge across languages.
Hints, Skips, And Hearts
If a question feels too difficult, you can use a hint to help you move closer to the right answer. You can also skip a question, but skipping costs one heart. Each incorrect answer takes away one heart, so think carefully before choosing your answer.
Learn While You Play
Football Quiz is not only about guessing answers. The app also includes fun facts that help you learn more about football history, famous players, competitions, records, and memorable moments. It is a great way to enjoy a quick quiz while discovering something new about the sport.
Legal Info
Images used in Football Quiz are under Public Domain or Creative Commons License. For more information, please visit the About App section inside the app.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/footbaltriviaios/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://zipoapps.com/footbaltriviaios/terms/

bluejetty:00017316:ios.description:

TriPeaks is a variant of Golf and Black Hole Solitaire and is also known as Tri Towers, Three Peaks and Triple Peaks. Tri Peaks Solitaire is a simple and addictive game, that everyone can master. • 6 game layouts to play with

• 9 beautiful card backs
• 5 game tables to play on

• Casino quality random shuffle

Ce service est disponible à partir de tout type de téléphone quel que soit votre opérateur de téléphonie.
Masrvi dispose d’un large réseau d’agences, d’agents distributeurs agréés et de commerces partenaires.

bluejetty:00114743:android.description:
ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets – Redefine Your Phone Style!
ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets helps you create a personalized phone experience with beautiful themes, widgets, wallpapers, and icon packs. Turn your device into a true work of art — effortlessly and instantly.
From minimalist and modern to anime, cute, aesthetic, or K-pop styles, ThemeKit offers hundreds of trendy looks for every mood and personality. Personalize your phone every day with just one tap!
🌈 Main Features of ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets
💜 Trendy & Stylish Themes
Explore a vast collection of popular designs — anime, cute, vintage, minimal, and more. Instantly refresh your entire home screen with one click.
💜 Creative & Customizable Widgets
Choose from 100+ unique widgets such as clocks, calendars, notes, and photos. Select images from your gallery to design widgets that truly reflect your style.
💜 Custom App Icons & Icon Packs
Redesign your app icons — Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and more — with hundreds of stunning icon packs.
Mix and match themes, wallpapers, and icons to create your one-of-a-kind home screen layout.
💜 Smart Control Center – Faster Access
Swipe to instantly access Wi-Fi, volume, flashlight, and more.
Enjoy a stylish yet practical experience, making your phone both smarter and more convenient.
💜 Daily Updated 4K Wallpapers
Discover an ever-growing library of anime, aesthetic, abstract, and holiday wallpapers.
Easily change your wallpaper with one tap and refresh your screen every day!
🌟 Why Choose ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets?
✅ Massive library of themes, widgets, wallpapers & icon packs
✅ Clean, intuitive interface for easy customization
✅ Frequently updated with new styles
✅ One-tap setup and replacement
✅ No personal data collected or stored
The FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permission ensures the appropriate use of user-facing foreground services. The FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION permission ensures the appropriate use of user-facing foreground services.
To display the Control Center overlay on your screen, the app uses Accessibility Service permission. This permission allows convenient access to functions like adjusting volume, toggling do-not-disturb mode, or displaying quick tools — without collecting or storing any personal data. Themes - Widgets, Icon Changer does not disclose any user information in connection with ACCESSIBLE SERVICES, and the application in connection with this access stores no user data.
Disclaimer:
The Control Center feature is a customization tool designed to enhance user convenience. It does not modify the device’s original system settings or interface, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any operating system or manufacturer.
⭕️ NOTE ABOUT APPLICATION ACCESS
To display the control center view on your Android screen, ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets requires Accessibility Service permissions. This access enables system modification capabilities for features like do-not-disturb mode, audio recording/screen capture, and music/volume controls. ThemeKit does not disclose any user information in connection with ACCESSIBLE SERVICES, and the application in connection with this access stores no user data.
Note: This app requires Query All Packages permission. For apps targeting Android 14, you must specify a valid foreground service type for each foreground service used in my app.
✨ Customize your phone screen today with ThemeKit: Icons Pack & Widgets!
Create your own unique, stylish, and inspiring mobile experience.

bluejetty:00121525:ios.summary:
