bluejetty:00121525:ios.description:
UNITE HUMANS AND DRAGONS IN AN EPIC FANTASY ADVENTURE!
The prophecy has come true. Mighty dragons have arrived in search of new lands, and the kingdom faces an uncertain future. Only a wise and courageous leader can unite humans and dragons, rebuild the kingdom, and bring peace to the land.
Kingdom Tales is a charming time-management and strategy adventure where you gather resources, rebuild settlements, help your people thrive, and forge friendships with magical creatures.
Explore colorful fantasy lands, meet dragons, druids, fairies, and trolls, complete challenging objectives, and prove that you have what it takes to become the kingdom's greatest ruler!
BUILD, MANAGE & EXPAND
Gather wood, food, gold, and other valuable resources. Build and upgrade houses, workshops, and community structures. Assign workers wisely, manage your resources, and complete objectives before time runs out.
A KINGDOM OF DRAGONS & MAGIC
Travel through enchanted lands and meet a memorable cast of dragons, forest fairies, druids, trolls, and other magical creatures. Build prosperous communities and help create a lasting alliance between humans and dragons.
PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose the challenge that suits you:
• Relaxed – take your time and enjoy the adventure.
• Timed – race against the clock and test your skills.
• Extreme – master demanding challenges for the ultimate test.
MASTER THE KINGDOM
Complete challenging objectives, unlock achievements, and improve your strategy as you progress. Can you master every level and become the greatest ruler in the kingdom?
MADE FOR ALL DEVICES
Enjoy the full adventure on your smartphone, tablet or computer, with intuitive controls designed for touch-screen play. Build, manage, and explore wherever you go.
FEATURES
• Fantasy time-management and strategy adventure
• City building and resource management
• Dragons and magical creatures
• 45 challenging levels
• Multiple difficulty modes
• Achievements to unlock
• Colorful fantasy environments
• Easy to learn, challenging to master
• Play completely offline
PREMIUM GAMING EXPERIENCE
Try the game for free, then unlock the full adventure with a single purchase.
• No Ads • No Micro-transactions • No Subscriptions • No Data Collected • No Internet Required • Play Completely Offline

bluejetty:00068591:ios.description:
SugarWOD is the #1 workout app for athletes, coaches and affiliates.
Over 500,000 affiliate athletes use SugarWOD to track their workouts and PRs! With commenting, photo sharing and community scoreboards, you can connect with friends and coaches, inside and outside the gym. Athletes have even given each other more than 35 million fist bumps! The app also creates a better WOD experience with performance tracking, movement prep videos, and a way for your friends to support you when you get that back squat PR.
CompTrain by Ben Bergeron is exclusively available on SugarWOD.
2900+ boxes use SugarWOD to grow their community and manage their programming. For affiliate owners and coaches, SugarWOD simplifies program management, with a library of over 1000 WODs and an easy-to-use programming tool. It also provides a powerful tool that supports the community at your gym—with the ability to encourage and connect with athletes inside and outside the box and analytics to make sure coaches can monitor the performance and participation of their members.
With the SugarWOD mobile app athletes can:
• Receive alerts when your box’s WOD is posted
• Prepare for the WOD with prep videos and your personal performance history
• Record your WOD results
• Track your PRs and progress
• Connect with affiliate athletes all over the world
• See how your friends did on your daily leaderboard
• Support your friends with comments and fist bumps
• Record workouts done outside the gym—choose from 1000s of built-in workouts
• Create and record custom workouts
With the SugarWOD mobile app coaches can:
• Do everything listed above and more…
• Publish to a mobile Whiteboard and connect with your athletes inside and outside the box
• Monitor member’s performance and participation to improve your coaching
• Connect with and encourage your athletes as they publish their workout results
• Access the coach’s prep planner for a consistent WOD experience for your athletes
More info can be found at www.sugarwod.com
-----------------
"Great app, I love it! I'm just starting out in CrossFit and I'm not sure if I'd like it as much if I didn't have SugarWOD."
-----------------
"It's so easy to use, both as a coach and a user. Awesome interface, tap friendly and very intuitive."
-----------------
"SugarWOD has provided there so much more cross communication between the athletes from the different classes, it's actually amazing. Fist bumps are flying all over the place!"
-----------------
"I worked in the Tech industry for 16 years before starting up the Box and I know when I come across some good tech, so well done!"
-----------------
"SugarWOD has been a great success, members love it and its sparked some friendly banter and fierce competition amongst everyone."
-----------------

bluejetty:00019198:ios.name: LUDO‎
bluejetty:00019198:ios.summary: Ludo is fun to play a multiplayer board game that can be played between 2, 3 or 4 players. It is the most popular and fun game to play with family and friends. Ludo is a mind refreshing game with its lucky dice rolls and strategical gamepla
bluejetty:00019198:ios.description:
Ludo is fun to play a multiplayer board game that can be played between 2, 3 or 4 players. It is the most popular and fun game to play with family and friends. Ludo is a mind refreshing game with its lucky dice rolls and strategical gameplay. This interesting 2D Ludo game has been around us for a long time as the best game to play in our spare time.
How the Ludo game works:
Ludo game starts with four tokens placed in each player's starting box. A dice is rolled in turns by each player during the game. The player's token will be placed on the starting point when a 6 is rolled on the dice. The main goal of the game is to take all 4 tokens inside the HOME area before the other opponents.
Basic rules of Ludo game:
- A token can start to move only if the dice rolled is a 6.
- Each player gets a turn wise chance to roll the dice. And if the player rolls a 6, they will get another chance to roll the dice again.
- All the tokens must reach the center of the board to win the game.
- The token move clock-wise according to the number of rolled dice.
- Knocking out other's token will give you an extra chance to roll the dice again.
Game features:
Single Player - Play against the computer.
Local Multiplayer - Play with friends and family offline.
Play 2 to 4 players.
You can continue your game anytime.
Multi-colored dice for each player.
Real Ludo dice roll animation.
View the progress of each player in percentage.
Throw dice or roll instantly.
Shake your phone to roll the dice option.
Customize game speed yourself.
Easy single menu player selection.
Play the Ludo game in your native languages.
English, Hindi, Nepali, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic, Turkish, Russian, German, Italian, Thai, Vietnamese & Indonesian languages are supported in this Ludo game.
Enjoy playing the best offline version of the Ludo game anytime anywhere with your friends and family. The multiplayer version of this game is coming soon, so stay tuned.
Some of the people misspell "Ludo" as Lodo, Ledo, Lido, Loodo, Loado, Ludu, Lodu.
We hope you enjoy playing this Ludo (or, Fia, Fia-spel, Chevaux, Cờ cá ngựa, Le Jeu de Dada, Non t'arrabbiare, Petits Chevaux, Ki nevet a végén, लूडो ) whatever you call it in your language.
Please send us your feedback, and we'll try to improve the game performance as per your requirements.
Thank you for playing Ludo and do check out our other games.

GolfN turns every round of golf into real rewards. Play your game, earn points, and redeem them for premium equipment, travel, and unforgettable experiences.
How It Works
Play golf anywhere in the world. GolfN tracks your rounds automatically with 3D GPS on courses globally. Every swing, every milestone earns you points. Complete challenges off the course to stack your rewards even faster.
Turn those points into something real. Our marketplace features premium equipment and gear from brands like LAB Golf, Miura, Srixon, Cobra, Bettinardi, Holderness & Bourne, Red Stakes, Hyperice, and more. Plus exclusive travel and experiences you can't buy anywhere else.
Everything You Need to Play Better
See every shot with pro-level 3D GPS. Accurate distances, flyover hole previews, and smart recommendations on courses worldwide. Track every round and watch the patterns in your game emerge.
Your official handicap lives here. Link your GHIN account and watch your index update alongside detailed stats and round history. Everything you need to prove you're getting better (or at least more consistent).

Redeem points for gear you actually want. High-end putters, premium travel experiences, the latest tech from brands golfers trust. These are rewards worth earning.
Golf is better with your crew. Create groups, follow friends, celebrate their rounds, and see who's stacking points.
Trusted by the Pros
GolfN is the official app of PGA TOUR Champions player Emiliano Grillo, 2-time PGA Tour winner and 2016 PGA Tour Rookie of the Year. Join thousands of golfers who are already earning rewards for the game they love.
Download Free. Start Earning Today.
Every round you play without GolfN is leaving points on the table. Download now and make your next round worth more.

bluejetty:00024288:ios.description:
Are you a board game fanatic? Then get ready for an awesome island adventure of board games! A perfect fun pack of family board games. Roll dice with "Family Board Games All in One Offline". Explore the Kings of board games world with the best 2 & 4 player board games for adults and kids. With the most unique variations of the classic board games kings like Snakes and Ladder, Ludo, checkers, and more. Roll the dice and get started!
Relive your childhood nostalgia with "Family Board Games All In One Offline". It includes both strategy board games and classic family board games. Download "Family Board Games All In One Offline" now and invite your family and friends to play.
Current trending kings of family board games inside:
Play the ultimate Ludo Battle King
Now play your childhood favorite ludo board game in battleground style. If you want to become the ludo master then you must beat your opponents! Enjoy battle ludo king up to 4 players with local multiplayer mode.
Snakes & ladders like never before
Try snakes & ladders board games in a platformer style if you are tired of the classic board game. We have added many power-ups and fun obstacles to make the snakes & ladders game interesting.
Ludo with a twist of snakes & ladders
Have you ever thought of combining snakes & ladders with Ludo? Well, we have done it. Try this pirate style ludo board game with snakes & ladders.
Play the best Warrior Checkers
How good are you at playing Checkers? Find out with the Warrior checkers game. Defeat your opponent to be the checkers champion!
Challenging Battle Chess
Outsmart your opponents in chess. Test your chess skill and improve the strategy with this all-time favorite strategy game.
Become a chess master!
Enjoy the classic Four in a row
Who's up for some quick thinking? Get 4 pieces of your color in a row before the opponent to win the match. Can you do it? Take up the challenge with this fun Four in a Row Game!
Fun Tic Tac Toe
We all love the good old tic tac toe game. So what are you waiting for? Download "Family Board Games All In One Offline" and play tic tac toe with pirate buddies.
Feature of the "Family Board Games All In One Offline":
-"Family Board Games All In One Offline" is a perfect 2 4 player board games for adults and kids loving table games, with the following features:
-Offline unlimited board games fun with family and friends.
-A complete travel-friendly board games fun pack
-All the classic board games in one table games app.
-Top board games for when you are bored or traveling.
-Multiplayer table Game to play with friends and family
-Suitable for all age groups.

bluejetty:00042034:ios.summary:
Welcome to Knucklebones – Tactical Dice PVP!
Enter the ultimate battlefield of brains and bones. Knucklebones is not just another dice board game — it's a 2 player dice puzzle packed with intense tactical PVP action. Every roll counts in th
bluejetty:00042034:ios.description:
Welcome to Knucklebones – Tactical Dice PVP!
Enter the ultimate battlefield of brains and bones. Knucklebones is not just another dice board game — it's a 2 player dice puzzle packed with intense tactical PVP action. Every roll counts in this thrilling mix of strategy dice and chance. Outsmart your rival, plan your moves, and roll the dice to victory like a true dice champion.
Number Strategy in Every Roll
This is where number strategy meets action. Will you protect your high-value dice or go all-in on a risky combo? With mechanics that demand you to plan your moves, every placement becomes a potential turning point. Place your dice wisely and master this strategy dice showdown.
Real-Time Dice Battle
Compete in ranked dice battles and challenge real opponents in high-stakes, real-time tactical PVP duels. Whether you're defending your rank or climbing the leaderboard, you’ll need brains, bold moves, and the nerve to roll the dice under pressure.
Unexpected Combos & Master Moves
Think you're out? Think again. This 2 player dice puzzle is full of twists. Trigger multipliers, delete opponent dice, and flip the board in seconds. If you love dice board games like Yahtzee or Farkle but crave deeper tactics, this is your arena.
Ranked Online Games (Beta Phase)
Face off in global dice battle matchups.
Prove your mettle as a dice champion and make your name on the Elo-based rating system.
Track progress and refine your number strategy.
Play Against Computer
Test your strategy dice skills across ten difficulty levels.
Become a true dice champion by mastering every level.
2 Players Offline Mode
Perfect for friends or foes — no Wi-Fi, just a pure 2 player dice puzzle brawl.
Tactical Game with Luck Elements
A unique blend of strategy dice and randomness keeps every game fresh.
Use protection, deletion, and multiplication tactics to win.
Roll the dice and show off your number strategy.
2 Minute Games
Each match is a rapid-fire showdown. Think fast, plan your moves, and dominate.
Easy to Learn
Anyone can pick up the basics in minutes.
Hard to Master
It may be easy to start, but only those who plan their moves and perfect their dice strategy will win consistently.
RULES of Knucklebones - Tactical Dice PVP
- The aim of the game is to end up with more points than your opponent.
- Each player rolls one die on their turn.
- The game ends when a player has filled all nine spaces with dice.
- You score the points resulting from the sum of the dice values.
- If you have two or three dice with the same value in a column, their value is multiplied by two or three.
- If you place a die in a column where your opponent already has a die with the same value, it is removed.
- A die protects dice below it with other values from being removed. Consecutive dice with the same value can be removed.
Free to Play
Dive into the world of dice board games without paying a penny. Whether you love a tense tactical PVP match or a clever number strategy, Knucklebones has it all. Be the next dice champion. Join now, roll the dice, and win the ultimate dice battle!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177779:ios.description:
Guns at Dawn is a mobile online shooter where players battle in fast-paced 1vs1 FPS royale combats. It features multiplayer PVP action with 3D graphics and realistic gunplay. There are many different guns to choose from, and heroes with unique abilities. The goal is to survive and be the last player standing.
Can you survive in deadly all-out gun battles and be the last gunslinger standing? Grab your weapon and don't miss the shot. Make each bullet count!
Key Features
• Skill based PvP Duel Battles
Play online and master the art of shooting pistols and dodging bullets. Unleash lethal skills to gun down your enemy in split seconds. 
• Intuitive Controls
It’s so simple than you learn quickly tactics to kill your opponent and rank up in your leaderboard. The skill-cap is high enough to be extremely challenging and be the best in this PvP shooting game
• Customizable Characters and accesories
8+ gunslingers with special skills: The Outlaw, the Bounty Hunter, The Graverobber or the Marshall. Create a unique hero by using a combination of hundreds of accessories and find the perfect look. 
• Cool weapons
10+ iconic weapons: Walker, Navy, or the PeaceMaker. Choose the specific gun-fighting skills you want to develop and acquire new shooting abilities to become the best shooter
• High Quality 3D Battlegrounds
Fight across 5+ console quality multiplayer maps with objects to hide and destructible environments and obstacles
• Worldwide competitions and modes
Rise in the leaderboards Leagues and weekly Rival Ranks to battle to the top in competitive ranked mode. Compete against thousands of shooters worldwide in realtime 1v1 matches.
Note: An internet connection is required to play online this game. the gameplay uses realtime online matches with player across the globe.
Discord: https://discord.gg/RMu3Nq7
Privacy policy: http://www.vivastudios.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.vivastudios.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00174879:ios.name: My Jump 2
bluejetty:00174879:ios.summary:
*****Designed by sport scientists. Validation published on the Journal of Strength & Conditioning Research and Journal of Sports Sciences*****
***Featured by Apple under ‘Best New Apps’ in 100+ countries***
***The only app which calculates
bluejetty:00174879:ios.description:
*****Designed by sport scientists. Validation published on the Journal of Strength & Conditioning Research and Journal of Sports Sciences*****
***Featured by Apple under ‘Best New Apps’ in 100+ countries***
***The only app which calculates the force-velocity profile using the groundbreaking Samozino’s method***
My Jump 2 is the first app scientifically developed to measure your jump height. With a great design and validated by sport scientists, My Jump 2 is as reliable as a 10000$ force platform. Scientifically probed!
------------------------------
Pierre Samozino (PhD, sport scientist, University of Savoy): “My Jump 2 makes possible the determination of the jump height with a high accuracy, which has been validated in very recent scientific study. The other, and I think the main added value of this app is to propose the determination of the Force-Velocity-Power profile of each athlete and its own imbalance between force and velocity qualities. Very useful to optimize your strength training and improve your explosive performances.”
Jean-Benoit Morin (PhD, sport scientist, University of Nice): “My Jump 2 is the cutting edge, scientifically validated and most practical application to measure athletes vertical jumping performance, and the only one to include the complete "Optimal Force-Velocity Profile" analysis we recently validated. I'm using it with athletes, students, and research subjects. The entire Jumping Force-Velocity-Power and Optimal F-V Profile approach in your pocket!”
------------------------------
My Jump 2 gives you advanced information of your jumps using the camera on your iPhone, iPod touch or iPad. Just record a jump, select accurately its take off and landing and lets My Jump do its magic. My Jump 2 calculates the height, flight time, velocity, force and power of your vertical jumps. Also, it gives you the contact time, vertical stiffness and reactive strength index (RSI) of your Drop Jumps. Moreover, it allows you to calculate your Force-Velocity profile using Samozino's method. Complete analysis of your jumps right on your hand!
FEATURES:
• Accurate measurement of your vertical jumps. Scientifically demonstrated!
• Calculate the force-velocity profile using the groundbreaking Samozino’s method. You can know your maximal theoretical force, velocity, power and how far you are from your optimal capabilities! You can even get information about which quality (force or velocity) you should work to increase your explosive performance.
• Record stunnig slowmo videos up to 240fps or import as much as you like from your camera roll.
• Different jump types: countermovement jump (CMJ), squat jump (SJ), drop jump (DJ), CMJ free arms, horizontal jumps and repeated jump test!
• Annotate the external load used (CMJ & SJ) or the height of the box (DJ) to organize your best performances in different categories.
• Multi-user. My Jump 2 allows you to create as many users as you want. Monitor all your team on your iDevice!
• iCloud sync (iOS 13+)
• History. Record as many jumps as you want for each user created. With My Jump 2 you can analyze the evolution of your performance during time. You can even observe exactly how much you have improved!
• Export your data to Excel, Numbers, Google Drive and more!
• Beautiful, intuitive like design.
• Universal app: purchase once and install it on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (10.15+)
Note: My Jump 2 works better with slow-motion videos.
MY JUMP 2, A JUMP PLATFORM RIGHT ON YOUR HAND!

bluejetty:00152373:ios.description:
Welcome to VRChat — a virtual world filled with limitless possibilities.
Spend your afternoon dogfighting in fighter jets, before winding down in a treehouse that exists floating in a nebula. Make a new best friend while exploring a haunted mansion, right before playing a hand of cards with a robot, alien, and eight-foot tall wolf.
In VRChat, there are hundreds of thousands of worlds, millions of avatars – all created by the users. No matter what you’re into, there’s a space in VRChat for you. And if there isn’t, we’ll give you the tools to make your dream a reality.
While not required to join in on the fun, VRChat was built to take advantage of VR headsets in many unique ways. That means avatars that flow with your movement, and systems that work alongside various hardware platforms to provide full-body tracking, finger tracking, and much, much more. Even if you’re jumping in on your phone or tablet, you’ll get to experience the magic of hanging out with people that feel like they’re really there – not just some character on a screen!
Use the companion app to keep up with your VRChat friends, or launch into a VRChat world to meet new friends right from your iOS device!
There’s something magical around every corner. Come take a look, and see what you find.
MEET NEW FRIENDS
In VRChat, there’s always something to do – and people to meet there.
Visit a planetarium and have a chat about astronomy. Go on a virtual hike through a majestic fantasy forest. Pull up to a car meet, and talk shop with some gearheads. Attend a live music event underneath a chemical storage facility, and talk obscure genres with DJs.
Your community – whatever it is – is here.
GO ON AN ADVENTURE
There are thousands of games to play in VRChat. Try running a kitchen in a busy restaurant, or racing go-karts in zero gravity. Fancy a battle royale? We’ve got those, too. Just probably with a wider diversity of avatars than you’ve ever seen before.
It doesn’t matter what you like to play: casual card games, shooters, racing, platformers, puzzles, horror, and of course, endless party games.
BUILD YOUR DREAMS
Everything here was built by the community using the VRChat SDK. Combined with Unity and Udon, our in-house scripting language, we give our users as much power as possible to build whatever their imaginations can conjure up.
But creation isn’t just limited to worlds.
VRChat provides a level of creative freedom that is unmatched anywhere else, and nowhere is that reflected best than on the avatars of our users. In VRChat, you can be anything, and explore your identity however you’d like. Want to be an alien? A talking dog? A sentient shoe with glowing bits that react to the beat of music by changing color? I mean, sure, if that’s what you’re about.
VRChat is free to download and play on compatible devices. Subscribing to VRC+ grants access to enhanced features. Learn more at https://hello.vrchat.com/vrchatplus
Privacy Policy: https://hello.vrchat.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://hello.vrchat.com/legal

bluejetty:00042215:ios.description:
YallaGo! is a ridesharing taxi application to grab a taxi ride any time of day or night.
YallaGo! is the best car booking service for cars and taxis.
YallaGo - Safeer (ambassador)
There’s no need to park or wait for a taxi or bus. With YallaGo!, you just tap to book a car ride. Our taxi car booking app is backed by the largest community of Safeers (drivers who own the car). Whatever you need or wherever you want to go, we got you you covered.
YallaGo - the way it works
1. Simply enter your destination address to grab a taxi. The estimated fare and route is displayed.
2. Your taxi Safeer picks you up at your location point anywhere whenever you book a taxi.
3. You can always track your taxi on its way to your destination, which gives you a full control over process.
Enjoy comfortable ride. Pay in cash.
4. Rate your ride! Thanks to your feedback, our taxi service will adapt to your needs and expectations.
YallaGo! - other features
Features
- Fast: We always assign the nearest car to pick you up.
- Safe: We thoroughly train our Safeers. Rating system helps select best Safeers.
- Modern: we have developed innovative car booking technology, which makes customer service even more accessible and safe.
YallaGo! - various service categories
As the Safeer can locate the positioning of each passenger in real time mode, clients can book a car of a different category that can be ordered up to their choice, depending on their needs. That allows to keep fair competitive rates.
Excellent quality service
Thanks to the quality of our service, one can always be sure to get the best tech support providing quick and precise answers, since we are always open to your needs and problems 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. That's what allows us to surpass the competition at all levels and be adaptable to any challenges.
So, don't wait any longer. Just grab a car and enjoy your trip!
--
Contact us at
Email: ali.yallago@gmail.com

bluejetty:00136103:ios.description:

Presets: Quickly apply the perfect look with a curated collection of vintage presets. From soft film styles to bold retro colors, explore unique options that make your photos & videos stand out.
Templates: Choose from a variety of minimal, paper, film, and polaroid templates to frame your images beautifully. Customize colors and layouts to create your own signature style.
Effects: Add character and nostalgia with classic effects like texture overlays, authentic film grain, and timeless cinema-inspired finishes.
Date Stamp: Add a classic date stamp to mark your memories with an authentic vintage detail.
Batch Editing: Save time with batch editing. Copy your adjustments from one photo or video and instantly apply them to as many images or videos as you like.

Adjustments: Fine-tune every photo with precise controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, grain, glitch, glow, blur, haze, and more.
Frames: Give your photos an authentic vintage touch with old-style frames inspired by classic prints and film borders.

bluejetty:00014450:ios.description:
"موبي مال" هو التطبيق الرسمي المقدم لعملاء المصرف التجاري الوطني، والذي يمنحك وصولًا فوريًا وآمنًا إلى حسابك المصرفي، مع مجموعة واسعة من الخدمات الذكية التي تلبي جميع احتياجاتك المالية اليومية بسهولة وأمان.
مميزات التطبيق:
• الاطلاع الفوري على رصيد حسابك المصرفي في أي وقت ومكان.
• طلب كشف حساب مفصل وإرساله مباشرة إلى بريدك الإلكتروني.
• إصدار وتفعيل وتجديد وإيقاف البطاقات الدولية والمحلية بكل سهولة وأمان.
• طلب إصدار بطاقات محلية جديدة وإدارتها بالكامل عبر التطبيق.
• طلب توصيل بطاقتك الدولية إلى أي مكان داخل ليبيا مع تحديد طريقة الاستلام الأنسب لك.
• إجراء التحويلات المالية السريعة عبر البطاقات الدولية.
• تحويل الأموال فوراً بين الحسابات المختلفة داخل المصرف التجاري الوطني.
• الدفع والتحويل المالي بين مختلف المصارف الليبية بسهولة عبر خدمتي "وان باي – One Pay" و"LYPay".
• الاشتراك في خدمة "سداد" وشحن المحافظ الرقمية مثل "سداد" و"تداول" بضغطة زر.
• سداد فواتير الكهرباء وخدمات الاتصالات لشركة المدار الجديد مباشرة من حسابك.
• شراء مُختلف أنواع بطاقات الدفع المسبق بخطوات بسيطة.
• إتمام عمليات الدفع الإلكتروني السريع عبر خدمة "يسر باي".
• الحصول على سيولة مالية مسبقة تصل إلى 60% من راتبك القادم عبر خدمة "يسر باي بلس"، مع إمكانية تفعيلها ومتابعة حركتها من التطبيق.
• سحب الأموال نقدياً مباشرة من نقاط البيع لدى التجار.
• طلب إفادة بالحساب الجاري وإيقاف الصكوك المصرفية عند الحاجة.
• طلب دفاتر الصكوك الورقية والصكوك الإلكترونية.
• معرفة حالة أجهزة الصراف الآلي (ATM) المتاحة للخدمة لتوفير وقتك وجهدك.
• مسح وقراءة المستندات والوثائق آلياً عبر تقنية (OCR) المدمجة لتسهيل عملية تحديث البيانات.
• إدارة متكاملة للعملة الأجنبية مع إمكانية تحويل داخلي بالعملة الأجنبية.
• خدمة التخصيص “عائلتي بلس” ، خصص قيمة لاحدى أفراد عائلتك مع التحكم في نوع الاستخدام (دفع أو شراء كروت).

Understand Your Body

bluejetty:00179960:ios.name: Block Puzzle : Match Combo
bluejetty:00179960:ios.summary: "Use your brain strategically and try your luck at the same time. It may seem like a simple mission, but it's not easy to overcome obstacles that will challenge you. Lying in bed before going to sleep, secretly during office hours, and whil
bluejetty:00179960:ios.description:
"Use your brain strategically and try your luck at the same time. It may seem like a simple mission, but it's not easy to overcome obstacles that will challenge you. Lying in bed before going to sleep, secretly during office hours, and while eating dinner alone. Etc. This game can be enjoyed by people of all ages, anytime, anywhere. It is the best puzzle game that relieves stress and stimulates the brain with exciting block explosions. It has two modes: 'Classic' with endless levels and 'Journey' where you travel the world of jigsaw puzzles. You can enjoy it in a variety of ways. Download it for free and play “Puzzle Blast” right now, no Wi-Fi required!
•Classic Mode: Drag blocks across the board to place as many blocks as possible. While playing the game, blocks of different shapes appear continuously, and when there are no more empty spaces on the board, the game is over.
•Journey Mode: Take a trip around the world on a jigsaw puzzle! From the Eiffel Tower in Paris to the Opera House in Australia, travel all over the world to broaden your horizons and enjoy the fun of puzzle games. 
How to play Puzzle Blast:
•Drag and drop blocks onto the 8x8 board.
•Blocks are removed when a row or column is complete.
•The game ends when there is no more space on the board to place any more blocks.
Tips for playing Puzzle Blast:
•You can get higher scores by matching multiple lines at the same time. (The thrill of exploding many strings at once is a bonus!)
•It is important to plan and design the game by considering block shapes and positions rather than making decisions on the fly.”

bluejetty:00093455:ios.name: First Carolina Bank
bluejetty:00093455:ios.summary: First Carolina Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easi
bluejetty:00093455:ios.description:
First Carolina Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with First Carolina Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First Carolina Bank app, you must be enrolled as a First Carolina Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Agrega stickers, luces LED, alerones, escapes, colores locos, rines, y cualquier cosa que se te ocurra para que tu bus o coaster sea el más recio de todos. Aquí no hay límites para tu creatividad: tu estilo manda. Competí en carreras épicas por lugares increíbles de El Salvador, ya sea en local o con tus cheros en modo en línea. Ganá billete en las carreras, y úsalo para mejorar tu Bus o Coster para que todos te respeten. Con gráficos brutales, cinemáticas de lujo y música que te pone en modo carrera, Sivar Race El Salvador es todo lo que necesitas para correr, tunear y ser el rey de la calle de SV. ¿Se va hacer o no se va hacer?
Al inicio tendrás un par de vehículos inspirados en los buses y coasters más famosos de las calles de El Salvador. Escogé el que más te guste y empezá a transformarlo en la bestia personalizada que siempre soñaste. ¡Tu creatividad es el límite!

bluejetty:00187688:ios.name: Handy Bible
bluejetty:00187688:ios.summary: The Handy Bible gives you a Bible that is extremely useful in every aspect- it not only provides an easy and fast way(one of the fastest bible lookup/search apps - compared to other top selling apps) to read the Bible, but it also has vario
bluejetty:00187688:ios.description:
The Handy Bible gives you a Bible that is extremely useful in every aspect- it not only provides an easy and fast way(one of the fastest bible lookup/search apps - compared to other top selling apps) to read the Bible, but it also has various helpful features that allows for more convenient bible studies. 
Features: 
-------------------------------------- 
* Universal app (if you buy the app, you can install it for both the iPhone and the iPad); it also supports both the portrait and the landscape mode; no internet connection needed 
* Support iOS built-in Text-to-Speech feature, no need to download huge audio recording data(optional In-App purchase)
* One of the fastest bible search engines, as it uses a powerful SQL database engine that allows you to lookup or load any bible verse almost instantly; also features an “instant search” setting that automatically starts searching even as you type 
* Ability to add/edit personal notes for every single verse (will show a NOTE icon next to that verse). This personal NOTE window is depicted as a floating, half-transparent, and movable window; this allows you to keep the window open as you read the Bible 
* One of the best rich text note editing: supports "rich text editing" including "Bold", "Italic", "Underline", "Strike Through", "Font color/highlight/size", "Ordered or unordered list", etc. Video demo: http://facebook.com/handybible 
* Includes ASV, BBE, DARBY, ISV, KJV, NHEB, WEB, YLT free domain bible text. Unlike other apps, need to go through several steps, with one single touch you can easily switch to the different Bible versions on the top navigation bar. 
* Uses a rolling wheel-Picker to quickly and easily pick or lookup various books, chapters, or verses; it can also let you type the first letter of a book, which then helps you instantly select that particular book 
* Powerful and rich search features: search for any text inside the Bible or any text in your own personal notes; it can also filter OT and NT books. Can also use "AND" or "OR" (words separated by space, or use begin-end double quotes to search as a whole phrase) to narrow down the search. 
* Unlike other apps, can only show search result page by page, Search Result will be presented with all scriptures found in order by a Book with Book Index for easy access and the frequency of that serach strings within each Book. 
* Easy navigation to the next or previous verse/chapter/book via a group of cursor buttons on the lower-right corner * The text of each bible verse or personal note can be copied or emailed to others 
* Will automatically store any verse you search or lookup as “History”. You can also add personal bookmarks. 
* Features customizable settings that allows you to change the primary Bible text, the Bible text font type/color/size, and the background image (can choose from built-in patterns or you can choose to add an image from your own iPhone Photo Albums library) 
* Tools-Store - Purchase Copyrighted Contents: can purchase authorized copyright contents like ESV, Message, NASB, NET, NKJV bible 
* The Chinese version is also available for purchase 
* Can purchase"Pro version" separately-"Handy Bible Pro" will include features like the Dictionary/Strong Number concordance search, KJV with Strong Number, Bible text parallel comparison, and Bible Commentary(MHCC, CLARKE, JFB) lookup. 
* Useful Tips/FAQ: http://vincentchiu.com/iphone_apps
* Latest info: http://facebook.com/handybible

bluejetty:00027627:ios.summary: Plot your scores! ArcherySuccess is an archery scoring app with archery journal. Keep all your archery scores, arrow plots, notes and gear setups at your fingertips. Calculates your archer skill level and handicaps per round. Used by Beginn
bluejetty:00027627:ios.description:
Plot your scores! ArcherySuccess is an archery scoring app with archery journal. Keep all your archery scores, arrow plots, notes and gear setups at your fingertips. Calculates your archer skill level and handicaps per round. Used by Beginner to Elite level archers in 60 countries!
Track your training progress! Use as an archery diary for training activities and report arrow numbers, journal items and scores to your coach. ArcherySuccess does ALL THIS and MORE!
Tailored to track the training progress of an individual archer ArcherySuccess will save you and your coach time. Time you can use to shoot arrows!
What do you get?
•An archery scorekeeper
•Quick and easy arrow scoring and plotting (incl. precision plotting) 
•Your archer skill rating and handicap number (old and new tables) auto calculated for select rounds
•Arrow tagging and arrow group analysis
•Over 600 built in round types or create own custom rounds from built in
•Set an arrow count goal then track and report your arrow volumes 
•Personal best scores by bow type, gear setup and competition level
•Add detailed notes to rounds, gear setups and make journal notes
•Capture training information on the go
•Compile, display or email weekly progress reports with one tap
•Coaches get uniform reports from all archers, easy to copy for further analysis.
•Export data to Excel or CSV. 
...and more!
If you are passionate about archery, this is the archery app for you! 
Have a feature request or an app issue? Email support@archerysuccess.com
More on https://archerysuccess.com
CURRENT BUILT IN ARCHERY ROUNDS
• USA Archery Rounds
• World Archery (Target, Indoor, Field,3D), incl. VI and Barebow
• Archery GB (Imperial, Metric, Indoor) - Worcester, VI Burntwood
• UK: 252 Personal Archery Challenge & UK Frostbite (3 & 6 arrow ends) 
• NASP Indoor, 3D
• DBSV Rounds – 144, half 144, Short Metric, 900, 720, Indoor, Field
• Bodnik Bowhunter & Shrew Bow Challenge 
• NFAS
• NFAA/IFAA 
Vegas,1, 3, and 5 Spot
International, Lake of the Woods, Field (Pro & Expert), Hunter (Pro) Indoor, Flint Bowman
600, 800, 810, 900, Classic 600
Animal
Marked 3D
• Archery Australia
• IBO 3D
• ASA 3D
• IAA 3D
• 3DAAA 3D 
• Beiter Hit-Miss
• Lancaster Qualification/Match
• Archery NZ Target/Indoor
•Clout: AA, AGB, BLBS, WA 
•FITA 
•WTAU:Puta, Zhamby
Or
Build your own rounds based on built in rounds
FIVE MAIN FEATURES
1. Progress Tab
• Automatically compile a weekly progress report; send via email
• Personal Best scorecard
• Progress graphs, which shows arrow averages by setup, and by round shot
• Graph and table of arrow count vs weekly arrow count target by gear setup
2. Journal Tab
• A searchable list of notes and all rounds shot
• Add arrow count, and use as arrow counter
• Add notes; examples: Gear, Nutrition, Rest and Recuperation, Strength and Conditioning, SPT, etc
• View and email archery rounds scored and distance plots 
• Record summary information for a round not scored in app
3. Score Tab
• Select and score archery rounds, using a flexible scorecard
• Create custom rounds based on existing in app rounds
• Score via color coded keypad
• Using Round Notes, select gear setup used for the round, change date and time of round, rename the round and add notes about the round
• Favorite setup assigned to the round by default
• Round scores updated in real-time throughout the app
• Round Search and Filter feature, make finding a round easy
• Switch to Plot scoring at any time
4. Plot Tab
• Quick plotting: Simply tap the zoom-able target face to plot and score
• Precision plotting: Touch and hold, then move cross hairs and lift finger to plot and score
• Quick navigation: Center, zoom out, or switch to a target number
• Arrow group indicator
• Quick undo button
• Add notes and select gear setup used for the round
5. Gear Tab
• Track gear setups: a bow, arrow set and sight settings
• Set favorite setup

Plot your scores! ArcherySuccess is an archery scoring app with archery journal. Keep all your archery scores, arrow plots, notes and gear setups at your fingertips. Calculates your archer skill level and handicaps per round. Used by Beginner to Elite level archers in 60 countries!

Track your training progress! Use as an archery diary for training activities and report arrow numbers, journal items and scores to your coach. ArcherySuccess does ALL THIS and MORE!

Tailored to track the training progress of an individual archer ArcherySuccess will save you and your coach time. Time you can use to shoot arrows!

What do you get?
•An archery scorekeeper
•Quick and easy arrow scoring and plotting (incl. precision plotting) 
•Your archer skill rating and handicap number (old and new tables) auto calculated for select rounds
•Arrow tagging and arrow group analysis
•Over 600 built in round types or create own custom rounds from built in
•Set an arrow count goal then track and report your arrow volumes 
•Personal best scores by bow type, gear setup and competition level
•Add detailed notes to rounds, gear setups and make journal notes
•Capture training information on the go
•Compile, display or email weekly progress reports with one tap
•Coaches get uniform reports from all archers, easy to copy for further analysis.
•Export data to Excel or CSV. 
...and more!

If you are passionate about archery, this is the archery app for you! 
Have a feature request or an app issue? Email support@archerysuccess.com
More on https://archerysuccess.com

CURRENT BUILT IN ARCHERY ROUNDS

• USA Archery Rounds
• World Archery (Target, Indoor, Field,3D), incl. VI and Barebow
• Archery GB (Imperial, Metric, Indoor) - Worcester, VI Burntwood
• UK: 252 Personal Archery Challenge & UK Frostbite (3 & 6 arrow ends) 
• NASP Indoor, 3D
• DBSV Rounds – 144, half 144, Short Metric, 900, 720, Indoor, Field
• Bodnik Bowhunter & Shrew Bow Challenge 
• NFAS
• NFAA/IFAA 
Vegas,1, 3, and 5 Spot
International, Lake of the Woods, Field (Pro & Expert), Hunter (Pro) Indoor, Flint Bowman
600, 800, 810, 900, Classic 600
Animal
Marked 3D
• Archery Australia
• IBO 3D
• ASA 3D
• IAA 3D
• 3DAAA 3D 
• Beiter Hit-Miss
• Lancaster Qualification/Match
• Archery NZ Target/Indoor
•Clout: AA, AGB, BLBS, WA 
•FITA 
•WTAU:Puta, Zhamby
Or
Build your own rounds based on built in rounds

FIVE MAIN FEATURES

1. Progress Tab

• Automatically compile a weekly progress report; send via email
• Personal Best scorecard
• Progress graphs, which shows arrow averages by setup, and by round shot
• Graph and table of arrow count vs weekly arrow count target by gear setup

2. Journal Tab

• A searchable list of notes and all rounds shot
• Add arrow count, and use as arrow counter
• Add notes; examples: Gear, Nutrition, Rest and Recuperation, Strength and Conditioning, SPT, etc
• View and email archery rounds scored and distance plots 
• Record summary information for a round not scored in app

3. Score Tab

• Select and score archery rounds, using a flexible scorecard
• Create custom rounds based on existing in app rounds
• Score via color coded keypad
• Using Round Notes, select gear setup used for the round, change date and time of round, rename the round and add notes about the round
• Favorite setup assigned to the round by default
• Round scores updated in real-time throughout the app
• Round Search and Filter feature, make finding a round easy
• Switch to Plot scoring at any time

4. Plot Tab

• Quick plotting: Simply tap the zoom-able target face to plot and score
• Precision plotting: Touch and hold, then move cross hairs and lift finger to plot and score
• Quick navigation: Center, zoom out, or switch to a target number
• Arrow group indicator
• Quick undo button
• Add notes and select gear setup used for the round

5. Gear Tab

• Track gear setups: a bow, arrow set and sight settings
• Set favorite setup

bluejetty:00044823:ios.description:
eXciteOSA® is the only daytime solution clinically proven to treat the root cause of mild obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and snoring, rather than simply relieve the symptoms. The device only needs to be worn for twenty minutes a day, once a day, for six weeks, and twice a week thereafter.
eXciteOSA® improves the muscle function of the tongue through painless stimulation therapy. Improving these muscles prevents the upper airway tissue from collapsing and trains the upper airway to remain open during sleep, thereby improving sleep quality.
The eXciteOSA® app connects to the device via Bluetooth to activate and customize each therapy session. The app conveniently tracks your progress, keeps you focused on therapy goals, and shares valuable sleep tips with you along the way.
Let’s begin your journey towards better sleep. Download the app today.
The eXciteOSA device is available in the following countries: United States, UK, Canada, European Union countries, and Australia.

bluejetty:00162160:ios.description:
A round timer for boxing, kickboxing, martial arts, HIIT and Tabata training.
Huge, high-contrast digits let you read the remaining time from across the gym.
FEATURES
• Your music keeps playing
 Use it with Apple Music or Spotify running. The gong is mixed over your music instead of interrupting it.
• A real gong
 Recorded from an actual gong, not a synthesised beep.
• A warning before the bell
 A sound marks the last 10 or 30 seconds of a round. You can turn it off.
• The screen changes colour during rest
 Tell work from rest at a glance, without reading the numbers.
• The screen stays awake
 Auto-lock is disabled while the timer runs, so you can leave the phone on the floor.
• Vibration
 Get the cue without sound. Switch it on or off.
SETTINGS
• Round time: 30 seconds, or 1 to 10 minutes
• Rest: 0 seconds, 15 seconds, 30 to 150 seconds, or 3 to 10 minutes
• Rounds: 1 to 15, or unlimited
TIPS
• Wearing gloves? You can tap START with your tongue.
• If the sounds are too quiet, check the ringer volume in Settings > Sounds & Haptics.
NOTE
• The timer does not advance while you are in another app. It resumes where it left off when you come back.

bluejetty:00061740:ios.description:
Simplify your life with TBC's Mobilebank 
Experience banking fully digitally – simple, instant, secure. TBC’s Mobilebank offers various features to make your daily banking experience seamless – from customizing your homepage to activating products wherever you are, right from your phone. 
Become TBC’s customer in just 30 seconds. Register in Mobilebank without any documents by verifying your identity with just a selfie. 
Get your new TBC Card via Mobilebank and use it instantly. Earn on every payment, unlock exclusive offers across Georgia, and transfer your loyalty rewards straight to your account. 
Transfer money 24/7. Send money to someone else in TBC, to another Georgian bank, or from another Georgian bank to your account – anytime you need. 
Pay utilities and recurring expenses with just one tap. Simple, fast, and always at hand. 
Get a fast consumer loan in under 2 minutes. Access up to 80,000 GEL, with an effective rate starting at 18%.

Invest in more than 6,500 U.S. stocks. Enjoy $0 fees for trading, account opening, deposits, and withdrawals. Build your portfolio on your terms and invest across the world’s largest sectors and industries. 
Manage remittances digitally, 24/7. Send or withdraw money from home at any time and enjoy special exchange rates.

bluejetty:00121490:ios.description:
Jewel Crush - Match 3 Games：match 3 puzzle with addictive and exciting adventure, bejeweled classic free gems match game.
Match and quest jewels in fun gameplay to complete the mission goals.
It has a beautiful and cute game style, ideal for girls to play with their families and to play in anytime and anywhere! 
Be the jewel stars and unlock the castles in this legend game. Designed for the beautiful girls.
Easy to control, fun to player, beautiful graphics!
Just swap & match with your finger!
How to play:
- You have a specific list of goals in each level.
- Match 3 or more identical gem-jewels in a line to crush them.
- Match 4 in a row or column to create special direction jewels.
- Match 5 in T or L to create special jewels bomb. 
- Match 5 in a line to create special color jewels. 
- You must have the sharpest mind. Learn to use special jewels.
- If you have any difficulties passing a level you can use helpful props.
- Combine 2 special jewels to make huge chain reaction to help you pass the level.
Special highlights：
* Direction Jewels: it will can destroy all jewels in a line.
* Jewels Bomb: it will can destroy all jewels around it.
* Color jewels: it can destroy all jewels with the same color of selected gem.
* Super value gift: Diamond and props power-ups help you pass level
* Less moves, More Stars, Higher scores! Crush all jewels!
* Pass the levels and try to get all stars in each level.
* Try your best to make super combinations with super match!
Features:
- Designed for the beautiful girls
- Easy and free fun to play, challenging to master.
- 1000+ well-designed puzzle levels.
- Daily free bonus in the games.
- Helpful magical boosters to win jewels stars.
- Games you can play offline.
- Classic jewels match 3 game.

bluejetty:00184907:ios.description:
Play the best new free Solitaire for iPhone! Millions of players around the world love this classic game (also known as Klondike or Patience) because it's easy to play but hard to master. It's the perfect game to play to keep your mind sharp.
Modern design, easy to read cards, beautiful graphics, and cool features make Real Solitaire® the one game you won't be able to put down.
FEATURES:
• NEW! All of the holiday themes you love in Real Solitaire for iPad are now available in Real Solitaire for iPhone!
• Enhanced gameplay supporting all iPhones and screen sizes
• Uses same card shuffling algorithm as Windows Solitaire to offer a truly authentic experience
• Supports all device orientations (portrait, landscape left, and landscape right)
• Right handed and left handed layouts
• NEW! Auto Complete finishes the game for you when all cards are turned over and aligned for a win
• NEW! Intelligent hints
• Drag and drop cards
• NEW! Double tap cards to move them automatically
• NEW! Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Automatic game saving
• Easy Mode (Draw 1)
• Hard Mode (Draw 3)
• Vegas Mode with cumulative scoring
• Timed Mode: the faster you play, the more bonus points you win!
• Unlimited undo
• Record high scores and game statistics for both Standard and Vegas modes
• Built-in help with explanations for Klondike rules, scoring, and a strategy guide
• Choose from many beautiful wallpapers
• Rewarding win animation
• No interference with Apple Music and other music apps so you can listen to your favorite songs while playing solitaire
CHAT WITH US! Let us know what you'd like to see next by messaging us on Facebook or Twitter.
Facebook: facebook.com/realsolitaire
Twitter: twitter.com/realsolitaire

https://www.edgerift.com
Created and supported by EdgeRift. Thanks for playing and if you have feedback we would love to hear from you so please feel free to contact us!

bluejetty:00042182:ios.description:
Courial brings premium chauffeur service, nationwide U.S. delivery and on-demand lifestyle
services together in one app.
Book a professional chauffeur in Bangkok, Phuket, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Oahu, Maui or
the Big Island. Ride on demand, reserve by the hour or schedule your trip in advance.
Choose your vehicle before booking, see your fare upfront, track your chauffeur live and set your
ride preferences for a smooth, personalized journey.
CHAUFFEUR SERVICE
• Book an on-demand ride
• Schedule a ride in advance
• Reserve a chauffeur by the hour
• Select your preferred vehicle class
• See available vehicle details before booking
• Arrange airport transfers, meetings, tours, shopping trips and nights out
• See your fare before confirming
• No surge pricing
• Track your chauffeur live on the map
• Chat directly with your chauffeur
• Receive ride-status and arrival notifications
• Save home, work and favorite locations
• Save and rebook preferred chauffeurs
• Add quiet-ride, music and route preferences
• Use promo codes at checkout
• Pay securely in the app
• Receive a 20-minute cancellation grace period
A PREMIUM RIDE EXPERIENCE
Courial chauffeurs are screened and trained for safety, driving and hospitality. Vehicles are
inspected and professionally maintained.
Depending on the vehicle and market, your ride may include bottled water, phone charging and
additional comfort amenities.
WHERE CHAUFFEUR IS LIVE
THAILAND
• Bangkok

bluejetty:00183955:ios.description:
Activation of IDBI Bank Go Mobile+ App couldn’t be easier and takes only a few minutes. Simply download the Application, just like you would have installed any other iPhone App from Apple App Store. You can then instantly activate the Mobile Banking App (one-time activity) and set your personalized MPIN by authenticating your Debit Card or Internet Banking credentials. On successful authentication, you can immediately start transacting on your accounts.
Before activating the Mobile Banking App, please ensure that you have registered for the mobile banking channel. If not, you can do so at the ATM or through your Internet Banking account or by submitting a channel registration form at the nearest Branch.
You can view the account statements on the go at your convenience, even while at work or commuting. Checking the balance in your account, managing and scheduling utility bill payments, adding a top-up in your prepaid mobile phone or DTH account, paying VISA credit card bills, or instantly transferring money from one bank account to another through IMPS is now possible at the click of just a few buttons on your phone.
Banking through the IDBI Bank GO Mobile+ App is not only very simple and convenient but also saves your time or a visit to the Bank. You will also receive an SMS alert whenever a transaction is initiated in your account through any digital banking channel like ATM, Point of Sale (POS), Internet or Mobile Banking. 
The IDBI Bank GO Mobile+ App allows you to personalize your banking experience with a host of user friendly features and services;
 • Personalize with a Selfie picture or choose a favorite image from your mobile gallery.
 • Select your wall paper theme initially with seasons and with more options coming soon.
 • Enhanced User experience with your accounts displayed in a card deck style which can be swiped or expanded.
 • Financial Calculators to help you take informed investment decisions.
 • Control your Debit Card by setting your own ATM and PoS transaction limit, switching your Debit card transactions On or Off and much more.
 • Set International or Domestic usage on your card or instantly Block card if misplaced or lost.
 • Select your frequently used options to appear on the main screen or menu drawer at the bottom of the screen.
 • View and Manage your IDBI Bank Credit Card.
Security:
We take every step to keep the account safe and secure when banking on the mobile device. IDBI Bank uses sophisticated encryption technology for secure data transfer from your mobile phone to the Bank’s mobile banking server. Every transaction or beneficiary addition requires a dynamic OTP (one- time- password) authentication. No account information or any other account sensitive credentials is stored on your mobile phone, making it completely safe and secure.

bluejetty:00121209:ios.summary: Unlock the full potential of your creativity with DrawingEZ, the ultimate digital art platform for drawing, coloring, and animating. Ideal for artists and enthusiasts, this app combines intuitive digital painting, sketching, and animation t
bluejetty:00121209:ios.description:
Unlock the full potential of your creativity with DrawingEZ, the ultimate digital art platform for drawing, coloring, and animating. Ideal for artists and enthusiasts, this app combines intuitive digital painting, sketching, and animation tools to offer a unique creative journey.
- Versatile Templates for Every Genre: 
Dive into an array of templates for Anime, Animals, Flowers, Landscapes, Mandalas, and more. Perfect for artists seeking specific coloring themes or inspiration.
- Dual Drawing Modes for Every Style: 
Embrace your artistry in both Auto and Freehand modes. Auto mode ensures precise fills on coloring pages, while Freehand unleashes your creativity in doodling and sketching.
- Expansive Brush and Pencil Collection: 
Discover over 100+ brushes and pencils tailored for various artistic techniques, whether you're sketching details or coloring boldly.
- Customizable Color Palettes: 
Create and personalize your color palette. Mix and match to craft unique shades, breathing life into your drawings and animations.
- Draw Symmetrically:
Multiple Symmetrical Lines: Create complex designs with up to 50 symmetrical lines. Each stroke you make is intelligently mirrored, forming perfect symmetrical images.
Adjustable Anchor Points: Easily adjust the anchor points to change the direction and angle of the symmetrical lines, offering limitless creative possibilities.
Enhanced Drawing Speed: This tool not only helps in generating unique designs but also saves time, improving efficiency for artists and designers.
- Animation Tools:
Elevate your art by animating your drawings. Our easy-to-use animation features bring your sketches to life, adding motion and dynamism to your creations. And export animation to VIDEO, GIF, IMAGE, PDF.
- Versatile Animation Export: Image Tilemap, Video Format, GIF, PDF
- Adaptive for All Skill Levels:
Whether a beginner or a pro, our app's versatile modes cater to all. Beginners enjoy easy coloring with Tap-To-Fill, while advanced artists can delve into more intricate Freehand and Automatic modes.
- Share Your Masterpieces:
Showcase your art, from detailed drawings and vibrant coloring pages to lively animations, across social networks like Facebook, Instagram, and more.
- Optimized for All Devices: 
Enjoy a responsive drawing experience, whether using fingers, Apple Pencil, or third-party styluses.
- Apple Pencil Enhanced: 
Experience precise control in drawings, colorings, and animations with the Apple Pencil's adjustable pressure and stroke size.
- PDF Coloring Book Import: 
Uniquely, DrawingEZ allows you to import PDF coloring books, blend traditional and digital art forms, and export your art back to PDF. This feature is perfect for coloring and animating on-the-go.
DrawingEZ is more than just a drawing app; it's a comprehensive digital canvas for your art, animation, and creativity.

bluejetty:00067715:android.description:
On sale for a week!
An eerie, uncomfortable horror is creeping from PC over to Android!
"It is a game as much about horror as it is of horror" — Rock Paper Shotgun
"Knock-Knock is a gorgeous survival horror game with more style than sense" — IGN
"One of the most fascinating and even endearing gaming experiences I’ve had in ages" — GameFront
***
Three generations of Lodgers have occupied the cabin, but lately, the walls seem to undulate, skittering unknowns shift in the darkness, and an unruly growl seeps from the attic. Are they hallucinations pecking at the insomnia-afflicted Lodger, or the gnarled remnants of a darker secret?
The last rays of dusk fade, and the dreadful things come out to play.
Survive the night while maintaining the dilapidated cabin and preventing the threadbare sanity of the Lodger from unraveling completely. Hide from the grotesque intruders peering from the gloom and seek out the key to ending the Lodger's ordeal.
Features:
- A game of survival and troubling madness.
- Hide from the invading creatures.
- Fix the lights and keep the cabin rooms repaired to ward off evil.
- Survive the night with your sanity intact.
- Solve the mystery of the Lodgers nightmare.

Sua aprovação no ENEM está mais perto do que você imagina.

bluejetty:00095444:ios.description:
Sua aprovação no ENEM está mais perto do que você imagina.
Transforme sua preparação para o ENEM com a ferramenta de estudos definitiva, criada para levar seu desempenho a um novo patamar. Nosso aplicativo não é apenas um banco de questões; é o seu treinador pessoal, seu planejador e seu analista de dados, tudo em um só lugar. Pare de estudar no escuro e comece a treinar com estratégia e inteligência.
SIMULADOS PERSONALIZADOS AO SEU MODO
Cansado de simulados genéricos? Aqui, você está no controle.
Simulado Completo: Simule o dia da prova com 180 questões e sinta a verdadeira experiência do ENEM.
Simulado por Matéria: Precisa focar em Matemática ou fortalecer sua base em Ciências Humanas? Crie simulados focados em uma única área de conhecimento.
Simulado por Tópicos: Vá ainda mais fundo! Selecione os assuntos específicos que você mais tem dificuldade, como "Logaritmo", "Urbanização" ou "Filosofia", e crie um teste cirúrgico para eliminar suas fraquezas.
ANÁLISE DE DESEMPENHO INTELIGENTE
Dados são a chave para a evolução. Entenda exatamente onde você precisa melhorar.
Estatísticas Detalhadas: Acompanhe seu progresso com resumos visuais. Veja sua média geral, seu melhor desempenho, e o total de simulados realizados.
Histórico Completo: Revise cada simulado que você fez. Veja sua pontuação, o percentual de acertos, o tempo gasto e identifique padrões de erro. Aprenda com cada questão e não cometa o mesmo erro duas vezes.
Diagnóstico Preciso: Nosso sistema mostra seus pontos fortes e fracos, permitindo que você direcione seu tempo de estudo para o que realmente importa.
PLANEJE SUA JORNADA ATÉ A APROVAÇÃO
A organização é o segredo dos aprovados. Com nosso gerenciador de tarefas, você nunca mais vai se sentir perdido.
Crie Tarefas de Estudo: Adicione tudo o que você precisa fazer: "Revisar Redação", "Resolver lista de Física" ou "Fazer simulado de Linguagens".
Defina Prioridades: Classifique suas tarefas como Baixa, Média ou Alta prioridade para focar no que é mais urgente.
Estime seu Tempo: Planeje seu dia definindo o tempo estimado para cada atividade, criando uma rotina de estudos realista e produtiva.
EXPERIÊNCIA FOCO TOTAL
Desenvolvemos uma interface limpa, rápida e sem distrações para que você possa se concentrar 100% nos estudos. Durante os simulados, você terá um cronômetro, navegação fácil entre as questões e um ambiente que te prepara para a pressão do dia da prova.
QUEM DEVE USAR ESTE APP?
Estudantes que estão começando a se preparar para o ENEM e querem construir uma base sólida.
Vestibulandos na reta final que precisam de prática intensiva e direcionada.
Qualquer pessoa que queira transformar a maneira como estuda, usando dados e tecnologia para alcançar a tão sonhada vaga na universidade.
Não deixe sua aprovação ao acaso. Assuma o controle, treine com inteligência e veja seus resultados decolarem.
Baixe agora e dê o passo definitivo rumo à sua vaga na universidade!

bluejetty:00074636:ios.description:
Rummy 500 is a fun, classic card game. Rummy 500 is one of the most popular card games for 2 players, which is a classic card game with a fresh, modern appearance that makes you love playing it right away. With the guide of this card game, you can quickly learn how to play Rummy 500.
HOW TO PLAY RUMMY 500:
- Take turn to draw cards, make melds and discard a card to end your turn.
- The hand is over when a player play their last card. The melded cards score points, and any cards left in a player's hand count negative.
- The objective is to reach 500 points first!
- There are 5 modes: Regular, 3 Players, Team Play (2 vs 2), Persian Rummy, and Dealer's Gambit.
SCORING:
- Ace, Jokers: 15 points
- Face cards: 10 points
- Card 2 to 9: number value

This classic card game Rummy 500 is a great way to pass the time and relax after a long day of work or study.
You won't want to miss this Rummy 500 if you're seeking a quick, easy, and amusing offline card game. Download and enjoy Rummy 500 game!

bluejetty:00039383:ios.description:
Застосунок Резерв+ від Міністерства оборони України створено для призовників, військовозобов’язаних та резервістів. У ньому можна отримати електронний військово-обліковий документ, подати запит на відстрочку, створити направлення на ВЛК та вибрати свою вакансію у Силах оборони серед тисяч різних варіантів. 
Щоб згенерувати електронний військово-обліковий документ, необхідно:
 - Авторизуватися за допомогою BankID;
 - Внести актуальні контакти: мобільний номер, електронну пошту та адресу проживання.
Після цього ви побачите документ у застосунку. Він відображатиме інформацію про вас з реєстру Оберіг — чи є відстрочка, чи маєте порушення правил військового обліку, коли проходили ВЛК тощо. 
Електронний військово-обліковий документ має таку ж юридичну силу, як паперове тимчасове посвідчення чи приписне. За QR-кодом працівники ТЦК чи поліції зможуть легко перевірити його справжність.
У випадку, якщо ваші дані не знайдено, дані можна виправити без походу до ТЦК. У інших ситуаціях — зверниться у службу підтримки Резерв+ (посилання є в застосунку).

bluejetty:00186311:ios.description:
Shoot the ball out, and have fun with lots of different stages!
There are tons of cute monsters and different challenges waiting for you in each of the 26 stages.
Clear each challenge, and go on to the next stage!
*Rules of Play
Players release balls and earn points, clearing a stage once they have reached 100 points.
A road will open up once a stage is cleared, allowing players to move on to the next stage if they shoot a ball up into the road.
By tapping the screen, players can add pins which help control the movement of the balls.
Stages are saved by the system once they have been played, so players can access previous stages by selecting them from the menu.
*Explanation of Controls
Release a ball: Drag back the part labeled with an arrow (the spring)
Place a pin: Tap the screen
Stage selection: Accessed from the menu screen
Restart: Accessed from the menu screen

‣ America with outstanding dishes: Apple pie, sandwich, pizza, fast food, burger,...

‣ Get the right ingredients to make the meals on time, with the right taste
‣ Serve diners complex combo dishes to earn more coins and rewards
‣ Upgrade kitchen utensils and ingredients to improve cuisine.
‣ Open new delectable restaurants in new lands, and learn a lots new cooking techniques.

bluejetty:00061881:ios.description:
This mobile app lets you access and interact with the applications that you have built on Zoho Creator or with Creator apps that have been shared with you. Equipped with a huge range of custom touch-controlled gestures and actions, engaging with your Zoho Creator apps has never been more intuitive or more personalized! Just not that, you can access your important reports even while you are offline and export them in any format you need.
About Zoho Creator
Zoho Creator is a renowned low-code/no-code app builder that abstracts 90% of the complexities in the app development lifecycle, enabling users to create the apps with less effort and time. It combines the robust power of Business Intelligence (BI), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Automation to help businesses build solutions and innovate more easily than ever. So far, over 13,000 businesses have built 6 million apps on Creator to cater to more than 7 million end users. 
Key Features:
Equipped with intuitive, visual builders and ready-made code blocks, Creator lets you build an application for almost any situation—be it a task manager, a CRM, or an ERP without prior coding knowledge. Its proprietary, easy-to-grasp programming language, DELUGE, allows for advanced workflows and limitless customization. 
Other exciting features include: 
• Data management (one-click data imports from popular databases, export data in multiple format, AI-assisted data fields, quick data operations, pre-built data charts, access reports offline, and more)
• App planning and design (schema builder, custom layouts, reusable Java, nodeJS code snippets, and more)
• Rapid application development ( low-code development, oversee your app through various phases―development, staging, and production, AI/ML-led assistant, native mobile app development)
• App deployment (managed cloud, on-premise, sandboxing, single click deployment to production environment, and more)
• Administration (user authentication and domain-based restriction, access logs, audit trails, enterprise governance capabilities and more)
• Experience first (self-service stakeholder portals, PWA, native feature support like geo-tagging, signature capture, bar code and QR code scanner, custom branding and design options, and more)
• Collaboration (approval centers, notifications, schedulers, real-time collaborative development, smooth handovers with application testing teams, and more)
• Integrations (out-of-the-box integrations with 600+ apps and services , low-code enabled custom API creation, and more)
• Security (geographically-distributed, fully-encrypted, fully-owned data centers, real-time cloud-based backups, low maintenance, 99.9% uptime, and more)
Promo video: 
https://youtu.be/zuh8hzIczZ4

A dark mystery full of hidden objects is here!
Adventure beyond the gates of a mysterious castle to discover a story rich with enchantment and thrilling secrets. Explore what lurks in the Mystery Chamber and save the fate of the Midnight
bluejetty:00185161:ios.description:
A dark mystery full of hidden objects is here!
Adventure beyond the gates of a mysterious castle to discover a story rich with enchantment and thrilling secrets. Explore what lurks in the Mystery Chamber and save the fate of the Midnight Castle!
• STUNNING VISUALS AND SPOOKY CHARACTERS!
Meet a new character in every scene! From the beautiful royalty, to menacing dragons and trolls, experience a world of wonder! Your quest will lead you through dark passages and down illuminated paths!
• PLAY FOR FREE! 
Start searching for magical items now! Unveil mysterious treasures and use your coins and diamonds to unlock more fantastic locations. Stock up your inventory, or sell glorious relics for more currency! Want to speed up your journey? Coins and diamonds are always available for purchase.
• CRAFT INCREDIBLE ITEMS TO HELP YOUR QUEST!
Use items you find on the castle grounds to craft exquisite relics, potions, and poisons! Craft as many as you can and be rewarded each time!
• ENJOY THE FANTASY WITH YOUR FRIENDS!
Play with all your friends, even sign in with Facebook! Share gifts and wish lists, and help your friends get items they need to move on. Now it pays to connect! The more friends you have, the more gifts you will have to open!
Follow the adventure on Facebook! Stay connected for exciting news and details on the story!
https://www.facebook.com/midnightcastle
Please Note: Midnight Castle currently supports iPhone 4S or above, iPad Air, and iPad 2 or above, running iOS 8 or above.
**************************************************

This, by far, has been the most entertaining and fun game I have played. Not complicated and brings a sense of accomplishment as you achieve more and open new hidden object sites. Thank you . This sure beats housework :)

A very fun game! Lots of mini-games with hidden objects to fine. Lots of imagination and fine artistry in the scenes and objects found. Love it!!
Midnight castle by Northern will 
This is an amazing game to use your eyes and memory to find objects and progress to the next level. Lots of fun!

bluejetty:00027376:ios.name: Drone Pilot Canada
bluejetty:00027376:ios.summary: The Drone Pilot Canada app allows Canadian drone pilots to easily meet Transport Canada’s procedural requirements under the 2019 Canadian RPAS (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems) regulations. Drone Pilot Canada provides a simple map interf
bluejetty:00027376:ios.description: The Drone Pilot Canada app allows Canadian drone pilots to easily meet Transport Canada’s procedural requirements under the 2019 Canadian RPAS (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems) regulations. Drone Pilot Canada provides a simple map interface to help identify safe flying locations. It offers flight logging capabilities to record flight location and time, pilot and crew identification, the aircraft used, and weather at the time of the flight. Standard pre-flight checklists and procedures are built into the app and can be tailored by the user. Pilot and crew certification data can be managed directly in the app. Aircraft registration data and maintenance log recording is included. All user records can be exported from the tool into csv format for reporting or archival. Numerous other features make the Drone Pilot Canada app a simple one-stop-shop for meeting all Transport Canada procedural requirements for drone pilots in Canada.

bluejetty:00170919:ios.description:
Think you’re a word nerd? Put your vocabulary to the test with new word puzzles every day
Retrogram is a love letter to the 1970s — a cozy collection of handcrafted word games, curious words and satisfying puzzles to make part of your daily routine
PLAY EVERY DAY
SPELLOTRON
Make as many words as you can using seven letters. Find the pangram, climb the ranks and discover interesting stories behind some of your favorite words
WORDWAY
Build a bridge of words from one word to another. Use the letters you’re given and find a path across the board
THERE’S MORE
Subscribe to Retrogram to catch up on the past week of daily puzzles, explore the Puzzle Vault, play limited-edition bonus packs, switch things up with vintage app icons, and play after dark with Neon Nites
FEATURES
* Two handcrafted word puzzles every day
* Play today’s Spellotron and Wordway puzzles for free
* Catch up on the past seven days
* A growing Vault of bonus puzzles
* Limited-edition puzzle packs
* Neon Nites dark theme
* Vintage alternate app icons
* SharePlay — solve together over FaceTime
* Play Spellotron on your Apple Watch
* No ads, ever

bluejetty:00122024:ios.summary:
Designed for skydivers and wingsuiters, Skydive Logger automatically records your jumps and captures detailed information so you can geek out on data back on the ground. Each jump log includes:
- Exit and pull heights
- Time in freefall
- V
bluejetty:00122024:ios.description:
Designed for skydivers and wingsuiters, Skydive Logger automatically records your jumps and captures detailed information so you can geek out on data back on the ground. Each jump log includes:
- Exit and pull heights
- Time in freefall
- Vertical and horizontal speeds
- Flight path displayed on a map
- And lots more...
Skydive Logger is packed with loads of additional features:
- Jump signing so you can throw away that paper logbook.
- AirPrint so you can print jump logs, including signatures.
- iCloud support to back up your jumps and make them available on larger devices, including iPads.
- Jump export to JSON and kmz formats for Google Earth™ so you can view your jump in 3D.
- Apple Watch app for in-air information like the distance and direction to the landing area (requires 200 jumps).
- Configurable in-air audio commentary telling you your speed, glide ratio, direction to landing area and much more (requires 200 jumps).
- Access HealthKit to plot your heart rate against your jump data, so you can see how calm you were at key points. 
*Please note:* 
For recording jumps Skydive Logger works best on iPhones that include a barometer. It can also be installed on other iOS devices for viewing the data. 
Skydive Logger should only be used by skydivers with an FIA C-license or above in the UK and is not a replacement for jumping experience or common sense. Skydivers and wingsuiters outside of the UK should check local regulations or speak to an instructor before use.
