bluejetty:00160361:ios.name: FitrWoman
bluejetty:00160361:ios.summary: FitrWoman is a female health app that helps you train, compete and recover in sync with your menstrual cycle. Harness your inner superpower as a female athlete: learn about how your body works and get individualized recommendations tailored
bluejetty:00160361:ios.description:
FitrWoman is a female health app that helps you train, compete and recover in sync with your menstrual cycle. Harness your inner superpower as a female athlete: learn about how your body works and get individualized recommendations tailored to your unique physiology so you perform at your best, every day. 
KNOW YOUR BODY
• Track your period and log menstrual cycle-related symptoms on a daily basis.
• Use the interactive calendar to see your future cycles and plan ahead.
• Visualize historical data to identify trends over time and gain insights from recurring patterns. 
• Learn how changing hormone levels influence your body and impact your performance.
TRAIN SMARTER, RECOVER FASTER
• Receive personalized content based on your cycle status and logging activity, providing what you need to know, when you need to know it to maximize your training and recovery.
• Leverage data visualization tools and an expansive resource library to develop the performance strategies that work for you.
• Get customized alerts at key times in your cycle so you can always be on top of your preparation.
FUEL YOUR PERFORMANCE
• Action nutritional insights and recommendations on top foods to help reduce menstrual cycle symptoms, fuel your training and accelerate recovery.
• Browse an expansive library of healthy snack and meal recipes with advanced search and filtering to zero in on what’s right for you. Save your favorites for each phase of your cycle.
FitrWoman is a no excuses app: we are here to educate and empower female athletes to be at their best on any given day of their cycle. 
FitrWoman is built on evidence-based science to provide simple, actionable recommendations for female athletes on a daily basis. All content is grounded by peer-reviewed research. 
It is important to recognize, however, that there are limitations: much work remains to further enhance our collective understanding on female physiology and sport performance, and while studies may support certain insights, there are always individual variations and exceptions to expected patterns to take into consideration. 
We provide suggestions based on our best interpretation of the latest research, yet there is no guarantee that our recommendations will work for you, or implication that alternative approaches will not work for you. The nutritional information provided is in addition to maintaining a healthy balanced diet.
At FitrWoman, your privacy is our #1 priority. Please review our privacy policy here (link:http://www.fitrwoman.com/privacy-policy/) and contact us at privacy@fitrwoman.com if you have any questions.
Get in touch! We want to hear from you. Please send your feedback, questions or suggestions to support@fitrwoman.com.
Connect with us to hear about the latest news and top tips:
Twitter: @fitrwoman
Instagram: @fitrwoman
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fitrwoman/
Web: https://www.fitrwoman.com

bluejetty:00012828:android.description:
App access to digital services of the health history of the Canary Islands Health Service. Remember your next appointments and obtain the identification, clinical data (antecedents, allergies, habits, constants, diagnoses, vaccines) and reports (of attention
 primary hospital discharge, nursing care, emergencies, outpatient consultations, diagnostic tests) of its history and electronic prescription.
Card
 health: Identifying data of the person who uses the application, as it appears in the database of health cards of the Canary Health Service. In addition, data on your Primary Care center and family medicine professionals
 and of nursing to which it is assigned.
Upcoming
 appointments: Information about your future appointments in the centers of Primary Care and Specialized Care of the Canary Islands Health Service.
Reports:
 Reports obtained from the user's medical history in Primary Care and Specialized Care: clinical reports, hospital discharge, nursing care, emergencies, consultations, diagnostic tests and others.
Background
 personal: Health problems that are currently not active but have been relevant in the past.
Allergies:
 It includes both drug and non-drug allergies.
Habits:
 Information recorded in its history on the consumption of tobacco, alcohol, other drugs, and physical activity and food.
Constants:
 Graph with the evolution of the last values of the main exploration constants (weight, blood pressure, etc.) and essential laboratory values of follow-up (cholesterol, triglycerides and others).
Analytics:
 Reports of results of laboratory tests.
Diagnostics
 assets: Health problems present today as they are recorded in their history of Primary Care.
Drugs:
 Medications prescribed in the therapeutic plan of the Electronic Recipe system Continued. With access to a copy of your current Single Treatment Plan.
Vaccines:
 List of administered vaccine doses, presenting the diseases against those that protect said vaccines.

Explore the ocean with our new Ship Tracker app. Whether you're a maritime enthusiast, a professional in the industry, or simply an avid traveler, our app offers a wealth of features tailored to meet your needs.
Experience the thrill of tracking vessels in real-time, accessing details about their routes, destinations, and estimated arrival times. Plan your coastal adventures and stay informed about new ships entering ports, giving you the ultimate edge in exploring new horizons.
For Industry Professionals:
Effortlessly manage vessel traffic, streamline port operations, and gain valuable insights into maritime activities. Our app provides you with detailed information about port statuses, vessel specifics, and current maritime conditions, empowering you to make informed decisions and efficiently handle maritime operations.
Key Features:
- Real-time vessel monitoring: Get live updates on vessel locations, routes, and schedules.
- Expected arrivals: Plan ahead with information on anticipated vessel arrivals at ports.
- Port details: Access comprehensive port information, including country, codes, and vessel counts.
- Customizable fleet management: Add, remove, and track vessels according to your preferences.
- User-friendly search: Seamlessly search for specific ports or vessels and explore detailed vessel information effortlessly.
Benefits for All Users:
Gain access to additional insights such as vessel types, callsigns, and specific vessel details, providing an all-encompassing experience for maritime exploration, leisure, or work-related needs.
With a beautiful interface and intuitive design, our Ship Tracker app is your passport to the world of maritime adventure. Stay ahead of the tide, plan your voyages, and explore the high seas effortlessly.
Download our app today and embark on your maritime journey with confidence! Ahoy, adventure awaits!

• Show all articles or just unread

bluejetty:00154100:ios.description:
Welcome to 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! '—a hidden object adventure that combines relaxation and excitement into one extraordinary gaming experience! Whether you're a seasoned detective or a casual player, 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! ' offers something for everyone. Get ready to uncover hidden treasures, solve intricate puzzles, and embark on a journey through stunning, hand-crafted scenes.
EXPLORE BEAUTIFUL, IMMERSIVE WORLDS
Step into lively environments ranging from bustling city streets to enchanted forests, each packed with intricate details and hidden surprises. Zoom in and out to examine every corner and find the hidden objects cleverly concealed within the vibrant artwork.
RELAXING, STRESS-FREE GAMEPLAY
With no timers or pressure, 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! ' lets you explore and solve puzzles at your own pace. Take a moment to unwind, sharpen your focus, and enjoy the satisfying challenge of discovering hidden objects. Need a little help? Use hints to guide you through tricky spots without missing a beat.
LEVEL UP YOUR OBSERVATION SKILLS
Playing 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! ' isn't just fun—it's a great way to exercise your brain! Sharpen your attention to detail, improve memory, and boost cognitive skills as you solve unique challenges across diverse levels.
CONTINUOUSLY EVOLVING EXPERIENCE
With regularly added levels and seasonal events, there's always something new to discover in 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! ' From festive celebrations to thrilling mystery scenarios, each update brings fresh challenges and adventures to keep you engaged.
ENGAGING FEATURES FOR ALL AGES
User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy smooth, distraction-free gameplay.
Zoom & Search: Spot even the smallest details with intuitive zoom controls.
Hints & Boosters: Get help whenever you need it with free hints and boosters.
Varying Difficulty Levels: Challenge yourself with levels ranging from beginner-friendly to expert mode.
PERFECT FOR RELAXATION & FUN
Escape from the stresses of daily life and dive into a world of hidden mysteries. Whether you're playing on a short break or diving into hours of gameplay, 'Spot Hidden Objects: Find It! ' is the perfect way to relax and enjoy yourself.
HOW TO PLAY
Search for and find the listed objects in each level.
Zoom into the image for better clarity and to spot tricky items.
Use hints to uncover particularly well-hidden objects.
Complete levels, earn rewards, and unlock new adventures!

bluejetty:00125984:ios.summary:

City Governance + Military + Strategy. An old-school Three Kingdoms simulation game.In this game, you play as a vassal in Three Kingdoms Perio
bluejetty:00125984:ios.description:
Three Kingdoms: Overlord
Relive the history of the Three Kingdoms Period with hundreds of cities.
City Governance + Military + Strategy. An old-school Three Kingdoms simulation game.In this game, you play as a vassal in Three Kingdoms Period, aiming to unify the whole country.
The fate of your empire is in your hands!
Once a game has ended. You may start a new one at any time!
Features:
Detailed World Map
All details on the world map are clearly displayed. 
Whenever a cities ownership changes hands, it will be clearly displayed on the world map.
Develop and Dominate 
Hundreds of cities originating from Ancient China are awaiting your conquest. 
After capturing a city, you may manage it and build new constructions. 
By building Huts, Markets and Farms, you’ll earn the resources required for battle.
Recruit and Conquer 
Heroes play an important role in your domination. 
Here you may recruit all kinds of heroes from the Heroes Union. 
To unlock the full potential of your heroes, you need to raise their levels and ranks, and equip them with high-quality weapons and horses.
Through your careful development, your heroes will become unstoppable.
Allies and Skills 
It is hard to unify this war-torn country by your sword alone. Why not find an ally? 
Once you have unified the whole country, you and your ally will share the fruits of victory! 
Skills from the Strategist Camp may help you turn the tide of battle.
Round Based Game
This game is round based. You can always start a new game at will, regardless of your performance in your last game.
There is never an end to the strategy and war in the Three Kingdoms: Overlord.
If you failed to defeat your enemies, devise better plans to crush them in the future!
If you have unified the country, try your best to extend your era of dominance!

bluejetty:00092335:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate Dry Cleaning & Laundry service tailored to your schedule.
Features:
- Free collection & delivery
- 24-Hour turnaround
- Download now, have a driver with you in as little as 1 hour
- Quick & simple booking
- Luxury service with high street prices
- Convenient time slots from 7am to 9.30pm
- Based in London and New York City, also serving Brighton, Oxford, Edinburgh. 
Say goodbye to laundry woes and hello to more free time. Just follow these easy steps:
1. Book effortlessly on our app with your address and preferred time slots.
2. We collect your items and send an itemised invoice, 
3. Your clothes are delivered back within 24 hours.
Services:
- Wash & Press
- Wash & Fold
- Dry Cleaning
- Alterations
- Repairs
- Duvet & Bedding
- Shoe Mending & Cleaning
- Wedding Dress Cleaning
Join thousands of satisfied customers who trust us for impeccable cleaning and exceptional service, every time.
GQ Magazine: "Britain's Best Delivery Service"
Evening Standard: "Best Digital Dry Cleaners" 
Frequently Asked Questions
1. How does it work?
Simply choose your time slot and address on our app, then leave the rest to us and our trusted cleaning partners. We’ll come and collect, expertly clean, and return your items in 24 hours.
2. How do I choose a service?
ihateironing is a one-stop shop with several laundry and dry cleaning services to choose from. You can tell us your special requirements when placing your order. 
3. Where are you based?
We have superb on-demand dry cleaning and laundry coverage across the biggest cities:
- In the UK, serving London & surrounding areas, Edinburgh, Oxford and Brighton.
- In the US, serving New York (Manhattan and Brooklyn) and New Jersey. 
4. Who cleans my items?
After our ihateironing drivers collect your items, we take them to one of our professional dry cleaner facilities in your local area. There, each item is inspected and weighed and you will receive an itemised invoice with the total cost. Your clothes are cleaned or repaired to perfection before being returned to you. 
5. What is your turnaround time?
Our laundry and dry cleaning service can be turned around in 24 hours or less! However, bigger items such as bedding and duvets can take up to 48 hours. Alterations and repairs services will also require a longer processing time. Our team will be in touch every step of the way to let you know how long we need to process your items.

bluejetty:00134534:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00134534:ios.description:
Get real film look while shooting digital. 
At RNI we always wanted to transfer the true character of analogue film to digital medium. So we did by digitising our library of analog slides and negatives, building their profiles and packaging those profiles into a lightweight and easy to use mobile app.
RNI Films is a great mobile companion for those who appreciate the beauty of analogue photography. And this little app enables creators to bring the artistic flair of film into their mobile workflow. 
Many professional photographers find our film profiles to be more sophisticated and true to real film than rivals. That's because we work really hard to recreate every subtle aspect of real film, with great attention to general accuracy, colour separation, skin tones and grain texture.
RNI's film-simulating expertise is proven by time and appreciated by photographers from all over the globe. Our desktop and mobile solutions have been praised in a number of independent online reviews, so don't hesitate to search for RNI Films online to find out more about our products, philosophy and approach.
REAL FILM FILTERS
The RNI Films' filters are born from real film stocks and split into categories that include negative, slide, instant, black & white and vintage. The app comes with a generous introductory package of free film filters. Also additional filter packages can be added via in-app purchase.
REAL FILM GRAIN
Authentic film grain powered by our custom engine—accurately simulating grain structure, colour, and resolution behaviour.
REAL FILM BLOOM & HALATION
Recreate the optical effects of real film. Bloom adds a soft glow to highlights, while halation produces a warm, subtle halo around bright areas. Both are modelled to behave naturally, just like in real film photography.
ADJUSTMENT TOOLS
Use RNI image adjustment tools to make sure your images perfectly meet your creative vision. You can crop and rotate, alter the brightness, contrast, and colour, enhance shadows and highlights, add vignette and real film grain, and much more. 
RAW EDITOR
RNI Films can open and edit RAW files from your mobile or third-party camera*. Some minor image artefacts may be seen while editing RAW in the app's viewport which uses draft mode. Those artefacts won't be there on export. Generally, the quality of the output of this little app is comparable with professional desktop software.
* Your third-party camera RAW format needs to be supported by iOS. Please refer to your iOS version documentation for more details.
VIDEO GRADING (beta)
RNI Films can colour-grade your videos. All its film filters and many editing tools now support video. More video-focused tools and features will be added later. At the moment video grading is in beta. So if you spot any bugs or issues—please let us know at support@reallyniceimages.com

listings.description:
Get real film look while shooting digital. 

At RNI we always wanted to transfer the true character of analogue film to digital medium. So we did by digitising our library of analog slides and negatives, building their profiles and packaging those profiles into a lightweight and easy to use mobile app.

RNI Films is a great mobile companion for those who appreciate the beauty of analogue photography. And this little app enables creators to bring the artistic flair of film into their mobile workflow. 

Many professional photographers find our film profiles to be more sophisticated and true to real film than rivals. That's because we work really hard to recreate every subtle aspect of real film, with great attention to general accuracy, colour separation, skin tones and grain texture.

RNI's film-simulating expertise is proven by time and appreciated by photographers from all over the globe. Our desktop and mobile solutions have been praised in a number of independent online reviews, so don't hesitate to search for RNI Films online to find out more about our products, philosophy and approach.

REAL FILM FILTERS
The RNI Films' filters are born from real film stocks and split into categories that include negative, slide, instant, black & white and vintage. The app comes with a generous introductory package of free film filters. Also additional filter packages can be added via in-app purchase.

REAL FILM GRAIN
Authentic film grain powered by our custom engine—accurately simulating grain structure, colour, and resolution behaviour.

REAL FILM BLOOM & HALATION
Recreate the optical effects of real film. Bloom adds a soft glow to highlights, while halation produces a warm, subtle halo around bright areas. Both are modelled to behave naturally, just like in real film photography.

ADJUSTMENT TOOLS
Use RNI image adjustment tools to make sure your images perfectly meet your creative vision. You can crop and rotate, alter the brightness, contrast, and colour, enhance shadows and highlights, add vignette and real film grain, and much more. 

RAW EDITOR

bluejetty:00177914:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00177914:ios.description:
You’ve never played Sudoku like this.
Good Sudoku turns your iOS device into an AI powered Sudoku genius whose only mission is to help you learn and love this classic game.
Whether you’ve never tried Sudoku, or you play every day, Good Sudoku’s elegant layout, intelligent hint system, and busywork reducing tweaks will help you play better and have more fun.
- Over 70,000 of the highest quality puzzles you’ll see anywhere
- Optional tools to reduce busywork
- AI powered hint support to continuously boost your skills
- 3 standard modes: Good, Arcade, and Eternal
- 3 Daily puzzle modes that get harder throughout the week + global leaderboards
- 5 levels of difficulty
- Import your own puzzles from elsewhere in Custom mode (and share them with friends!)
---
We put everything we could into making the best digital Sudoku game ever released:
- We wrote a puzzle generator from scratch to create over 70,000 of the highest quality puzzles you’ll see anywhere. We spent weeks figuring out how to generate intricate and complex puzzles you won’t find in other Sudoku apps. Our hardest puzzles require wild techniques like “XYZ Wings”, “Hidden Quadrouples”, “Jellyfish”, and “Swordfish”.
- Most people don’t know this but Sudoku puzzles are actually generated by programatic Sudoku solvers. The fastest way to know how hard your puzzle is, or if it’s valid, is to write a solver that knows all the strategies that can try it. With Good Sudoku, we run our solver as you are playing, so if you get stuck, it can detect what you know by looking at your answers and your notes, and then help you find the next technique you need to solve the puzzle.
- Most Sudoku games classify difficulty into vague Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties — But what do these difficulties mean? Typically they refer to the kinds of solving techniques that are required to solve a given puzzle without resorting to guess-and-check. In Good Sudoku we aren’t vague about it at all. We lay out exactly which techniques are required for each difficulty level. Good Sudoku allows you to practice them individually outside of puzzles, and keeps track of which ones you’ve learned!
- When we first got interested in Sudoku we noticed that a lot of players spend most of their time looking at the board and counting. On easy puzzles, this counting serves as a way to increase the difficulty by making the puzzle take longer. We know some sudoku players love the counting but we found it a bit tedious and designed some tools to alleviate the busywork. At first these tools might feel a bit like cheating, but once your mind is freed up from counting you’ll have space to see the much deeper more fascinating side of Sudoku: all of the beautiful technique structures. Freed from the burden of busywork Sudoku becomes one of the best search-style games we’ve ever played. More fun than word-searches and solitaire, high-level Sudoku is a real treat — and with Good Sudoku and a little practice, anyone can learn it!
- We noticed when looking at other Sudoku apps although there are often daily puzzle modes, those modes never include global leaderboards. Weird! Good Sudoku remedies this problem!
- We wanted to make the best Sudoku out there, and while we’re proud of our puzzles, we recognize that puzzles come from all places. That’s why we built a quick and easy custom puzzle mode into Good Sudoku, so if you have a paper puzzle that you’re stuck on, or you’re trying some wild variant (Like the Miracle Sudoku!) it’s easy to put it into the game, play it, and share it with your friends. If the puzzle follows standard Sudoku rules, our hint system will even help you get unstuck!
We truly hope Good Sudoku can introduce you to, or deepen your love for this great game.
-Zach and Jack

bluejetty:00175425:ios.summary:
Get up to speed faster by listening to interesting and insightful audio articles from top-tier publications on the Noa app. Human read. One low monthly price.
Listen while exercising, driving, cooking, or walking.
What publications can I
bluejetty:00175425:ios.description:
Get up to speed faster by listening to interesting and insightful audio articles from top-tier publications on the Noa app. Human read. One low monthly price.
Listen while exercising, driving, cooking, or walking.
What publications can I listen to on Noa?
• The Atlantic
• Harvard Business Review
• Foreign Policy
• The Telegraph
• Bloomberg
• ProPublica
• Fast Company
• Business Insider
• MIT Technology Review
• Foreign Affairs
• The Independent
• The Conversation
• And more.
What features are available on Noa? 
Along with the usual audio features, you’ll find:
• Read Along
• Apple CarPlay
• Offline Listening/Downloads
• Sleep Timer
• Playback Speed Adjustment
• An editable Article Queue, and
• Rewind 15 seconds.
How much does Noa cost?
To get the most value from Noa you need to become a Premium member. By choosing to support Noa with a monthly or annual Premium membership you’ll get unlimited, ad-free access to over 25k audio articles (and counting) from the world’s best publishers, including our Premium-only publications. We would love to welcome you as a member of Noa’s growing community.
What are Noa's editorial principles?
1. Multiple Perspectives: Offer multiple perspectives from trusted sources and empower listeners to make up their own minds on where they stand on a topic.
2. Thought-provoking: Present audio articles that inform, inspire, and offer fresh insights, through both a global and a national lens. Focus on opinion, feature, and analysis articles.
3. Storytellers: Be storytellers and educators. Help our listeners understand global topics, and perspectives, while also telling the stories of the people behind the headlines.
4. Global Impact: Ensure coverage and raise awareness of important topics, regardless of a topics popularity or ability to drive “clicks”. 
5. Fourth Estate: Uphold journalism’s values as a democratic check on power. And always celebrate great journalism.
6. Embrace Complexity: Encourage thought and avoid black and white explanations that aren't followed with depth. The world is complicated and can seldom be explained in minutes. Our goal is to help listeners navigate it. 
Who reads the articles on Noa?
Listening to the best journalism is a great way to stay informed, especially when you don’t have time to read. Audio articles are produced and recorded daily by Noa’s talented voice actors – Sam Scholl, Adrienne Walker, Peter Hanly, Martin Buchanan, Les Smith and more. They’re probably in the booth recording as you read this!
What are 'Series' on Noa?
Each week, Noa’s editors select the very best audio articles and add them to topic-specific playlists. Every Series begins with a short explainer – written by a Noa editor – that provides valuable context on the subject at hand before you dive in. Within 20-30 minutes, you’ll walk away fully informed.
Are there any additional features?
We know you expect more. That’s why the Noa app also offers:
• In-app chat (we respond quickly)
• My Stats to view your daily streak and listening stats
• Save, Download, and Follow
• Share – articles and Series
• Read Along
Noa's commitment to privacy:
We’re real people and we take great care to protect your data. Noa does not share your data with others or allow advertisers to track you. Your data is used solely for the purpose of providing you with the best news and listening experience possible.
Privacy: https://www.newsoveraudio.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.newsoveraudio.com/terms

bluejetty:00187141:ios.summary: Textilus Pro is a great word processor app for students and business people, also being excellent for writing reports, papers, blog posts, journals or ebooks! Textilus Pro can help you organize your research, generate ideas, and remove dist
bluejetty:00187141:ios.description:
Textilus Pro is a great word processor app for students and business people, also being excellent for writing reports, papers, blog posts, journals or ebooks! Textilus Pro can help you organize your research, generate ideas, and remove distractions so you can focus on the most important thing: writing. Thanks to iCloud and Dropbox Sync, your documents in Textilus will synchronize between your iPad and iPhone automatically.
MAIN FEATURES
+ Create, edit, import and export text, RTF, Markdown and LaTeX documents.
+ Export and share your text documents to PDF, RTF, RTFD, ePUB, PNG, TXT, Markdown or HTML 
+ Modify margins and paper sizes, MLA and APA style format support including document headers/footers, very useful for students and teachers
+ Insert inline photos, signatures, charts and drawings in your documents.
+ MLA and APA style format support including headers/footers
+ Install your own TrueType fonts. 
+ Full-text search engine: It allows you to search the contents of your document library
+ Create unlimited notebooks, folders and nested subfolders
+ Create your own templates for new documents
+ User defined document headers and footers with tags for date, page number, total of pages, etc.
+ Offline/Online document sync with iCloud, Dropbox, Box, Google Drive, iCloud Drive, webDAV
+ Text to Speech for proofreading with text being read aloud starting at the cursor position
+ Scan documents: Use the camera of your iPad/iPhone to scan documents, notes, recipes, tickets, etc. directly in Textilus !!!
+ Wi-Fi Transfer: transfer your documents between your iPad/iPhone and your computer via Wi-Fi with a web browser
+ Protect individually your folders/notebooks with a password, very useful for iPads with more than one user in office, classroom or home
+ Zip folders and email them as an attachment
+ iCloud sync support: it keeps automatically your documents up to date on all your devices iPhone/iPad
+ Share Link via iCloud: Share your documents via public iCloud web link
Other main features:
# Stay organized
+ Create notebooks, folders and nested subfolders
# Essential Writing Tool
+ Rich-text formatting: Bold, italic, underline, highlight, subscript/superscript, alignment, line and paragraph spacing, first-line indent, page breaks, footnotes, comments, text and paper color, etc.
+ Insert special symbols, math symbols, date, current GPS location, pictographs and web links 
+ Sign your documents realistically with your finger 
+ Document Statistics: characters, words, reading time, sentences, average word length 
+ Right to Left and bi-directional text editing supported for Hebrew, Arabic, Thai, etc.
# Customizable Keyboard Bar
+ Exclusive extra keyboard row with direct access to styling and punctuation functions. 
+ Quick keys for tab, forward delete, cursor up/down/left/right, etc. 
+ Tap and hold to easily set your own custom keyboard buttons to your commonly-used keys, special symbols, text snippets or hard to reach characters

bluejetty:00148956:ios.summary:
Ping Pong Squad is the ultimate table tennis game for mobile. Hit epic loops, heavy chops, sneaky flips, and unstoppable smashes in quick, pick-up-and-play matches! 
Simple controls but rallies that feel like you're really at the table.
bluejetty:00148956:ios.description:
Ping Pong Squad is the ultimate table tennis game for mobile. Hit epic loops, heavy chops, sneaky flips, and unstoppable smashes in quick, pick-up-and-play matches! 
Simple controls but rallies that feel like you're really at the table. 
You get all the spin, rhythm, and tactical depth of true table tennis - yet it’s effortless to play with one hand. 
Easy to learn, deeply satisfying to master.
And the best part? It’s fully offline. No lag, no disrupted rallies, no waiting for opponents, and no stressing about a dodgy connection - just smooth, uninterrupted table tennis whenever and wherever you want.
Unlock your squad of attackers, defenders, and all-rounders, and learn to master each style of play. Upgrade your players to unlock their full potential and dominate the table. Collect skins in seasonal events to dress your squad in style.
Complete challenges to earn Tokens and unlock rewards each season. Win Trophies to rank up and climb to the Golden League where the Legend badge awaits. Take part in the weekly competition which rewards the best players with huge prizes each week. 
Ready to play? Download Ping Pong Squad today!
HIGHLIGHTS
- Simple controls
- Realistic 3D gameplay
- 10 fantastic arenas to choose from
- Unlock advanced shots, upgrade power and spin
- Compete in weekly competitions
- Show off badges and avatars on the leaderboards
- Daily and season challenges
- Collect skins for your squad
- Take part in time limited events
- Loads of achievements to collect
- No wifi needed
IN APP PURCHASES
Ping Pong Squad is completely free to play but some optional in-game items will require payment. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

bluejetty:00131264:ios.description:
The Ultimate Tennis Game
Pick your racket and choose your ball. Get ready to go onto the court in this brand-new tennis game! Experience tennis like never before in this fresh and easy-to-play game. In Mini Tennis, you can enjoy a casual gameplay experience that still remains loyal to the original game. It’s time for you to get a standing ovation from the crowd in the arenas and courts, score some amazing points, and build the strongest tennis legend that ever existed!
Pick Up and Play
Welcome to the first casual experience of tennis. Mini Tennis has a casual, pick-up-and-play feel that still remains true to the original sport. No need to waste time on endless mechanics—just pick it up and jump straight into the action!
Build, Upgrade, and Customize your Tennis Legend
In Mini Tennis, you will be able to win players, from common to epic, and upgrade them to turn your player into the most fearsome opponent on any court. Not only can you build your player, but you will also be able to fully customize them with more than 100 customizable options from:
Unique shirts, shorts, rackets, balls, and wristbands
Personalize your gameplay experience by choosing the ball you prefer
Win the rarest pieces of equipment and show them off!
Play in Different Courts
10 unique and original courts that will get bigger, louder, and more impressive as you progress through your tennis career.
Whether it’s in central park or in a mansion setting, every game will feel different. New and more impressive courts are on their way, so keep an eye out for future updates.
Rule the World
Rise up the leaderboards to win amazing prizes and stay on top of the competition. Each week, you will have a chance to move up the leagues, from the Brass League to the All-Stars League, so make sure that you grab those promotion spots by the end of the week to win bigger and better prizes!
--------------------------------------
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

support@miniclip.com

bluejetty:00136363:ios.description:
neurolist is an AI-based planner that helps neurodivergent folks reach their potential.
First, you enter a scary task and the app automatically estimates how long it will take and assigns it to a category. Then you can use the "magic subtasks" button to turn the task into a manageable list of steps. The best part? You can even add context about your life, which our AI will use to generate even better tasks.
neurolist also helps you stay present by only showing you one to-do at a time. No more overwhelming lists.
Any to do you create you can get back with one easy tap via the task library. Ultimate flexibility.
To help you actually do your to-do's, neurolist has a smart timer, which lets you complete each task like a playlist, with a timer for each subtask. Then it dynamically estimates how long it will take to complete, while notifying you via voice notifications along the way. Perfect to avoid ADHD procrastination.
This is just the beginning: In the future neurolist will allow you to give more context on each task and will provide advanced productivity analytics.

bluejetty:00033738:ios.summary:
Prepry is radiography and CT registry review for rad tech students, built so you want to study every day. 30,000+ radiography students have studied with Prepry for their ARRT® Radiography and CT exams.
Content is created and taught by regi
bluejetty:00033738:ios.description:
Prepry is radiography and CT registry review for rad tech students, built so you want to study every day. 30,000+ radiography students have studied with Prepry for their ARRT® Radiography and CT exams.
Content is created and taught by registered radiography educators, R.T.(R)(ARRT)® and R.T.(R)(CT)(ARRT)®, with technology adapting it to you. Real educators write the content.
Take timed mock exams, see exactly where you are weak, and drill those areas until your readiness score says you are ready. Missed questions come back on a spaced repetition schedule until you master them.
NEW: X-RAY POSITIONING GUIDE
A radiographic positioning library inside the app, organized by body region from chest and thorax to the extremities. Step by step positioning for each projection, with collimation and the expected radiograph, right next to your practice questions.
NEW: CHALLENGE MODE
Questions appear without the answer choices, so you recall the answer from memory instead of recognizing it. Not sure? Work through the options one at a time and eliminate the wrong ones, just like on exam day.
NEW: CLINICAL
Track clinicals. Clock in and out, see weekly hours, log each exam in seconds, and follow your skills progress, with protocols and measurement references one tap away.
MOCK EXAMS AND READINESS
 • Timed Mock Exams: full length practice tests that follow the ARRT® registry exam format and timing.
 • NEW Exam Simulator: a locked screen layout modeled on the test center, so exam day feels familiar.
 • Weak area identification and chapter by chapter breakdown after every mock.
 • NEW Score Trends: see your scores climb.
 • AI Readiness Score: tells you when you are exam ready.
 • Study Planner: a day by day schedule built from your exam date.
QUESTION BANK (2,700+ Questions)
 • ARRT® Radiography exam: 2,085+
 • ARRT® Computed Tomography (CT) exam: 625+ for CT registry review
Covers patient care, safety, radiation protection, image production, equipment operation, quality control, imaging procedures, and radiographic anatomy and positioning. Step by step explanations for every answer.
475+ DIAGNOSTIC IMAGES
X-ray anatomy, pathology, positioning, and CT imaging across every topic.
BUILT FOR DAILY STUDY
 • Streaks that keep you on track, plus exam countdown, study reminders, and daily goals.
 • Flashcards with spaced repetition scheduling.
 • Quiz Builder: custom quizzes in seconds by chapter, topic, or difficulty.
 • Free Question of the Day and Quick 10 quizzes.
 • Study Blocks for focused review sessions.
 • Badges and XP.
AI STUDY TOOLS
 • AI Explanations: instant breakdowns of any question.
PASS GUARANTEE
Did not pass? Get 3 extra months free.
MORE
 • Dark mode and offline access. Also on Android and web (app.prepry.com).
 • Notes linked to questions and explanations.
 • Educator portal with cohort management, assignments, and analytics.
For radiography students, rad tech program graduates, and working radiologic technologists pursuing R.T.(R)(ARRT)® or R.T.(R)(CT)(ARRT)® credentials, including CT registry prep. Not for clinical use or medical advice.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in App Store Settings after purchase. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

bluejetty:00166028:ios.description:
Do you snore or talk in your sleep? Deep Sleep Tracker helps you understand what happens while you sleep and build a bedtime routine that works for you.
Track your sleep, listen to nighttime recordings, and explore sounds to help you unwind. No smartwatch required.
Who is Deep Sleep Tracker for?
- People who have trouble falling asleep, wake easily, dream often, or feel they sleep lightly
- People who want to understand their sleep patterns and nighttime habits
- People who want to build a more consistent bedtime routine
- People who want to understand how changes in their body relate to their sleep
Features:
【Sleep Recording and Analysis】
Review your bedtime, estimated sleep cycles, and trends over time to see how your sleep habits change.
【Snore Detection】
Record sounds overnight, see how often snoring was detected, and listen to your snoring clips.
【Sleep Talking Recorder】
Listen back to clips of sleep talking and discover what you said while you were asleep.
【Customizable Wake-Up Alarm】
Enable notifications to receive bedtime reminders. Set an alarm for a specific time or choose a wake-up window with the smart alarm.
【Sleep Booster】
Explore more than 200 sounds and audio sessions, including ASMR, binaural beats, gentle rain, white noise, bedtime stories for adults, and mindfulness sessions. Use calming music and sounds to unwind before bed, meditate, or focus. Explore the audio library and find your favorite sounds.
【AI Skin Analysis】
Use your phone’s camera to scan the skin on your face. When the scan is complete, you can view the results in the app.
【Sleep Position Detection】
The app detects your sleeping positions while tracking your sleep. When you wake up, review the positions recorded overnight to see how you tend to sleep.
Deep Sleep Tracker Premium
Unlock all sleep sounds and meditations
Track snoring, sleep talking, and other nighttime sounds
Review your sleep trends
Back up your data to the cloud
Reminder: Deep Sleep Tracker can provide some information about sleep quality but cannot replace professional medical equipment and expert opinions. Therefore, if you have any long-term sleep problems, it is recommended that you seek professional medical assistance.
Ensure your bedroom is quiet, dark, and cool to relax before sleeping.
May you sleep as sweet as a baby!
You can subscribe to Deep Sleep Tracker to obtain unlimited access to all features.
Subscriptions are billed weekly, annually, or through a one-time advance payment at the rate selected by the subscription plan.
Specific details are subject to display within the application.

bluejetty:00118847:ios.description:
Calculator Max makes both simple and complex calculations easy. It offers all calculators you’ll ever need in one carefully designed, uncluttered and easy-to-use package. 
Switching between calculators is buttery-smooth and natural. The basic calculator with big buttons swiftly handles everyday tasks. The more advanced scientific calculator is loaded with all important mathematical functions and constants.
A history tape with your entries is comfortably accessible in all calculator modes. Thanks to it, you never lose track of what you’ve entered and the entries can be reused effortlessly in your calculations. The tape can also be exported to common formats and shared or printed.
On the large screen of any iPad it is pure joy to make handwriting notes or draw your ideas right in the app. Write down any math equation and let the app calculate it for you in the blink of an eye. Or reuse any handwriting which you can easily convert to editable text.
—————————
WHAT YOU GET
—————————
/// POWERFUL CALCULATOR ///
— Basic calculator with big buttons
— Scientific calculator packed with functions and constants
— History tape with the calculations at your fingertips in all modes
— Extensive rounding options (e.g. two decimal places for accounting)
— Up to 5 memory slots for frequent numbers
— Plain Text, Monospaced Text, CSV, PDF and image export formats
— Advanced export, share and print options
— Scribble Pad on iPad for easy math equations solving, handwritten notes and sketches
/// PRODUCTIVE WORKFLOW ///
— Side tape layouts for easier long records handling
— Clean and uncluttered interface with refined haptic feedback
— Multitasking support on iPad for side-by-side work
— External keyboard support for even faster input and app control
— Universal app for all your iPhones, iPads and Macs
— User interface precisely adapted for each device capabilities
/// FAST ACCESS ///
— Home Screen widgets with last calculations and memory
— Widgets for direct access from the Lock Screen
— Control Center and Lock Screen fast access buttons
/// MIGHTY SCRIBBLE PAD ///
— The right place for your quick notes and sketches
— Easily calculates any written down math equation
— Recognizes your handwriting and converts it to editable text
— Fully-fledged notebook with unlimited number of paper sheets
— Exportable as text, image or PDF
— Optimized for your finger as well as Apple Pencil
— Support for LAMY and Adonit styluses (on iPad)
— Available on all iPad models
/// EXTENSIVE CUSTOMIZATION ///
— Handcrafted design themes with dark mode support
— Loads of app icons you can easily choose from the best one for your Homescreen
— Carefully selected sound sets

bluejetty:00045189:ios.description:
MEC Patient App is your personal gateway to superior care management and enhanced patient experience. With convenient features designed to empower patients to take charge of managing their care, MEC Patient App makes your healthcare journey smoother and more efficient than ever.
As a HIPAA-compliant mobile app and online patient portal in one, MEC Patient App simplifies your healthcare processes, from effortless payment and medication management to seamless appointment scheduling and more. With MEC Patient App, a healthier you is just a tap away.
Take Control of Your Care With MEC Patient App
Effortless Appointment Booking:
Schedule appointments with ease at your convenience. Select your preferred provider and receive instant confirmation without the need to talk to a representative. Experience convenient appointment booking with MEC Patient App.
Secure Communication:
Connect with your healthcare provider securely through our messaging feature. Say goodbye to phone tag and get quick, reliable responses to your health-related questions.
Proactive Document Delivery:
Accelerate your check-in process with proactive document delivery. Sign consent and other ad hoc pre-appointment forms from your mobile device, ensuring a fast, smooth experience.
Seamless Cross-Platform Experience:
MEC Patient App offers seamless synchronization across the patient portal app and web platform, providing a consistent and user-friendly experience, no matter where or how you access it.
Hassle-Free Access:
Experience the convenience of MEC Patient App with our simple, one-time password (OTP) login. Securely access your healthcare information by utilizing the convenience of a clinic ID or explore a range of alternative search methods.
Download MEC Patient App today and embark on a journey to a healthier, more empowered you! Your wellness is our priority.

Please show the appeared individual graphic to the bus driver or controller for control.
Should you meet a controller, please show the QR code version of the ticket or the pass on your mobile device, which is controlled by the personnel.
Please make sure your mobile phone is charged and has internet access.
In case you do not sign out of the application, the verified tickets are available for control scanning, while the ticket validation and visual controlling function are not available.

bluejetty:00063602:ios.description:
Train your brain. Solve clever puzzles. Free the red block.
Dive into a captivating collection of simple yet highly addictive puzzle games designed to challenge your logic, sharpen your mind, and keep you coming back for more. Your mission is straightforward—but never easy: guide the red block to freedom.
Explore five unique game modes, each offering its own twist on classic puzzle mechanics:
1. Flow Slider (406 Levels)
Slide your way through hundreds of cleverly designed puzzles. Every move counts—can you find the perfect path?
2. Flow Slider 2 (25,185 Levels)
An enormous puzzle collection with endless challenges. Push your limits and master thousands of increasingly complex levels.
3. Digit Slider (80 Levels)
Combine logic and numbers to solve digit-based puzzles. Think strategically and plan ahead to succeed.
4. Fuzzle Puzzle (450 Levels)
A fresh take on puzzle-solving. Each level presents a new brain-teasing challenge waiting to be unraveled.
5. Flow Fill (260 Levels)
Fill the board strategically to create a clear escape path. Precision and planning are key.
Game Features
1. Unlimited Hints
Stuck on a level? Get help anytime and keep the fun going.
2. Optimize Your Moves
Challenge yourself to complete each puzzle in the fewest steps possible.
3. Progress Tracking & Rankings
Monitor your achievements, track your records, and compete with others.
4. Custom Themes
Personalize your experience with light, dark, skin-tone, and beautifully crafted themes.
5. In-Game Upgrades
Enhance your gameplay with options like ad removal, coin packs, and double rewards.
Endless puzzles. Endless satisfaction.
Put your IQ to the test and become a true puzzle master.
For feedback or support, contact us at: miaozhi.ai@gmail.com

bluejetty:00033307:ios.description:
Find the perfect palette with the Sherwin-Williams Color Expert™ app. Take the guesswork out of choosing the right paint color for your next project. Color Expert is your tool for finding the perfect color and transforming your space with confidence. Dive into a world of endless possibilities and visualize color like never before.
*Sample ordering is currently only available in the U.S. and Canada (excluding Quebec).
Key Features Designed for You:
COLOR VISUALIZER Our color visualizer lets you explore and visualize colors in your space instantly. Snap a photo of your space and see our colors on your walls with any Sherwin-Williams® color. See how a new shade will look in and around your home before you lift a brush, this intuitive color visualizer helps you gain color confidence.
PERSONAL COLOR RECOMMENDATION TOOL Overwhelmed by the endless color possibilities or unsure where to begin? Let our intelligent color recommendation tool simplify the process. Simply snap a picture of your space, and our app will analyze it to provide complementary colors that enhance your home's aesthetic.
SAVE & PLAN Found your perfect shade? Save your favorite colors for future projects with ease. Experience your chosen color in your space before you commit by ordering samples directly through the app. Your color journey from inspiration to application is made simple.
EXPLORE & DISCOVER Browse our extensive collection of Sherwin-Williams® colors by family, collection, or trend. Find inspiration and discover new favorites with ease.
ORDER COLOR CHIPS & PEEL & STICKS* Love a color you see? Order physical color chips and peel & sticks directly from the app, delivered right to your home. This is your chance to experience how a color can look in your home's unique lighting conditions before you commit. Whether you're planning a full home renovation, a quick room refresh, or an interior design update, Color Expert provides the inspiration you need. We help your ideal paint color come to life, and make your color journey exciting. Be your own color expert and download the app today to start your home transformation and gain color confidence.
*Sample ordering is currently only available in the U.S. and Canada (excluding Quebec).

bluejetty:00031136:ios.description:
Gifts.com
Find the Perfect Gift, Every Time
Gifts.com is your one-stop gifting destination for premium, customized gifts. Whether you’re shopping for him, for her or for the kids, or for a birthday, anniversary or graduation, Gifts.com makes it easier than ever to find just the right gift they’re sure to love. And since it’s perfectly personalized just for them, there won’t be any other gift like it!
Celebrate all the special people in your life and every special occasion with thousands of unique, thoughtfully customized gifts, keepsakes and home décor items they’re guaranteed to love. Making your personalized gift couldn’t be simpler! Simply open the app and easily browse or search for just the right gift for any friend or family member. Then personalize it your way with just a few taps! Add a name, favorite photos, a custom message or even a special date to commemorate a birthday, wedding or anniversary. The possibilities are endless!
At Gifts.com we believe the most thoughtful gifts are personalized. You’ll never have to worry about finding just the right present for everyone on your list. From cherished holidays like Christmas, Easter and Valentine’s Day to special occasions and milestone events like weddings, birthdays and back to school, we have all your gifting needs covered. The perfect present is here, just waiting to be personalized by you! 
We’re obsessed with quality, which means your custom gift is guaranteed to last. Year after year, friends and family will think of you fondly as they admire their one-of-a-kind item. They’ll look radiant wearing their bespoke necklace that dazzles with their children’s birthstones, hanging their thoughtfully personalized wedding ornament on the tree will become an annual tradition, and cozying up in a monogrammed blanket will give them warm thoughts of you.
Not only will you be the best gift-giver in your friends and family circle, you’ll never miss an important date! Our super-fast turnaround time means your order will be shipped and delivered to your doorstep (or theirs!) in just days. Your gift will arrive in plenty of time for all of your special celebrations. 
Discover for yourself what sets us apart. Every personalized item is backed by our “love it or your money back” guarantee, so you have nothing to lose. Make yours today! 
Why is Gifts.com so popular?
• We’re the easiest and most affordable way to find thoughtful, high-quality custom gifts crafted just for them.
• Our sophisticated, intuitive search tool makes it easy to find and choose from thousands of personalized products for every milestone event and special occasion.
• Add your favorite photos, names, special dates and/or a personal message.
• For photo gifts, easily upload pictures from your camera roll, Facebook, Instagram and more.
• Customize your gift in minutes and get it delivered in just a few days.
Why Gifts.com?
If you’re ready to find the perfect gift, every time, then you’ve come to the right place. Wondering what to buy a 10-year-old girl for her birthday, what to give your grandparents for their anniversary or how to surprise a dad who has (almost) everything? At Gifts.com we make it fast and easy to choose from a wide assortment of gifts tailored to specific ages and interests. We offer the most customizable, highest-quality, destined-to-be cherished gifts available anywhere—all in an intuitive app that makes personalizing your present a breeze.
It’s Never Been Faster … or Easier … to Find the Perfect Gift than with Gifts.com.

bluejetty:00060925:ios.description:
The BlackBerry® UEM Client integrates iOS devices (iPhones and iPads) with your organization’s enterprise mobility management (EMM) software: BlackBerry UEM or BES®12. Once activated, the BlackBerry UEM Client enables:
• Secure access to work email, calendars and contacts
• View administrator controlled configuration of work-related policies
• Easy installation of your organization’s approved mobile apps
• Dual business and personal use of mobile devices for Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policies
Additional security and enterprise mobility management capabilities are available for BlackBerry UEM-managed iOS devices with BlackBerry® Dynamics apps such as BlackBerry® Work installed, including:
• Secure mobile productivity apps for document editing and sharing, intranet browsing, and more…
• BlackBerry Dynamics SDK and app-wrapping and containerization for internally developed enterprise apps
• Popular enterprise apps, secured for UEM-managed iOS devices
• End-to-end secure connectivity 
IMPORTANT NOTE: To activate the BlackBerry UEM Client, your organization must use BlackBerry UEM or BES12 for EMM. Please check with your organization’s mobility experts before downloading this app. You will not be able to activate the BlackBerry UEM Client unless your organization creates an account for you from a compatible EMM solution from BlackBerry.

bluejetty:00060796:ios.description:
iHub is the ultimate stock research & discussion app for those who want more than just basic charts. We combine a professional-grade stock analyzer with the world’s most active 
trader & investor forum to give you a 360-degree view of the markets. From NYSE blue chips to OTC penny stocks and crypto. Whether you are a trader hunting for momentum or an investor conducting stock fundamental analysis, iHub’s data and community puts the pulse of the market in your pocket.
TRADING AND INVESTING CHAT ON AN INVESTING FORUM WITH DISCUSSION BOARDS
Join active stock forums and discussion boards where traders share ideas, analysis, and opportunities in real-time. 
• Participate in tens of thousands of threads on our trading forum for specific tickers and 
trading analysis. 
• Access user-generated stock insights, deep-dive stock analysis, and real-time stock ideas published on the iHub finance forum. 
• Build your profile, track your posts, and connect with other traders. 
• Follow top posters for when they post new ideas. 
• Read real DD, technical analysis, and user breakdowns of catalysts. 
• Share your insights and get feedback from thousands of active members. 
LIVE STOCKS, FOREX CURRENCY, CRYPTO PRICES WATCHLIST 
Stay ahead of the tape with a high-performance stock market tracker built for speed and accuracy. Our stock monitoring provides the essential data you need to make informed 
moves in a fast-paced environment: 
• Real-time quotes for U.S. stocks and ETFs, including NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, OTCMarkets, Pink Sheets, OTCQB, OTCQX Toronto, Toronto Venture, Canadian Securities Exchange, Cryptocurrency markets, Forex ...and many more across the globe. 
• Fast real-time streaming. 
• Watchlists for tracking your favorite stocks 
• Interactive charts and performance data 
ADVANCED MARKET DATA & LEVEL 2 
Move beyond basic stock market updates with professional market research tools: 
• Real-Time Level 2 Data: Gain an edge with order book trading insights. See the "market depth" to understand where big buyers and sellers are sitting. 
• Advanced Chart Reading: Use our high-performance stock charts for precise technical analysis and price action tracking. 
• Stock Monitoring: Set custom stock updates and price alerts so you never miss a move. 
• Live trades: overview the latest trades for any stock and see price, size, time, and buy/sell ratio.
STOCK MARKET NEWS, HOT STOCKS & TRENDS 
Find the next breakout with the latest financial news and our powerful stock analysis features: 
• Trending Tickers: See which stocks are dominating the conversation and identify early stock forecast trends.
• Finance and trading news: Stay ahead on iHub where we combine finance news with real-time community sentiment. 
• Breakout Scanners: The go-to stock market tracker for biotech plays, earnings movers, and momentum trading.
ADDITIONAL FINANCIAL & INVESTING TOOLS 
Beyond the core research and community features, iHub provides a suite of professional tools designed to streamline your financial workflow: 
• Manage and monitor your holdings with our integrated stock portfolio tracker. 
• Navigate international markets with ease using our built-in live forex quotes and currency pairs. 
• To ensure you are trading with institutional-grade precision, the app also facilitates secure contracts with market data agreements. 
WHO USES IHUB 
• Day traders scanning for momentum plays 
• Swing traders looking for the next breakout 
• Long-term investors sharing research and updates 
• Crypto enthusiasts following emerging coins 
• Penny stock hunters tracking high-risk, high-reward plays 
Whatever type of stocks you're trading, iHub is where the conversation happens first. 
Try iHub for free.

apple-itunes:6758680826.name: TravelPack
apple-itunes:6758680826.description:
Group travel, all in one place.
TravelPack makes it easier to plan, organize, book, and experience trips together. Instead of juggling group chats, spreadsheets, booking sites, and itinerary apps, your group can keep the entire trip connected in one place.
Whether you're planning a friends' getaway, family vacation, birthday trip, destination celebration, or your next big adventure, TravelPack helps everyone stay organized from the first idea to the final memory.
PLAN TOGETHER
Create a TravelPack, invite your group, coordinate trip details, and build a shared itinerary everyone can follow.
DISCOVER WHAT'S NEXT
Explore destinations and get personalized recommendations to help turn an idea into your next trip.
KEEP EVERYONE CONNECTED
Bring trip conversations, decisions, RSVPs, plans, and important details together instead of losing them across different apps.
SEARCH & BOOK TRAVEL
Find flights, hotels, activities, and experiences without separating planning from booking.
MANAGE TRIP EXPENSES
Keep track of shared trip costs so your group has a clearer picture of what has been paid and what's still ahead.
BUILD YOUR TRAVEL STORY
Your trips don't disappear when you get home. Keep your travel history, memories, and destinations connected to your TravelPack profile.
From “we should take a trip” to “remember when we…”, TravelPack is built for the entire journey.
Move the trip out of the group chat.

apple-macos:6477916913.developer: Xalera Games Online Bingos & Slots OÜ
apple-macos:6477916913.description:
Bring your favorite classic games and friends together in Lua Chat. Start with Bingo 90, the community's most popular game, switch to Bingo 75 or Bingo 60, roll the dice in Ludo, play dominoes, or choose from a broad collection of card games.
BINGO 90, 75 AND 60
Join a Bingo 90 room and follow every number with other players. Change the pace with Bingo 75 or Bingo 60. Optional VIP features can add conveniences such as automatic marking.
SPONSORED BINGO ROOMS
Any player can create a sponsored Bingo room that is open to everyone. Choose the room name, sponsor name and image. Cards cost half as many virtual coins as in regular rooms, while all rewards remain virtual coins with no monetary value.
CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE APP
Move between Ludo, dominoes and Memory, or sit down for a game of Cinquillo, Chinchon, Tute, Mus, Solitaire, Guinyot, Scopa, Blackjack, Belote, Brisca, Remigio, Petit Chevaux, Hearts, Spades or Gin Rummy. Other matching and card games complete the collection.
PLAY AND CHAT WITH FRIENDS
Add friends, join the global chat and send private messages. Play with people you already know or meet community members who enjoy the same classic games. Players can report or block other users, and public chats use automatic moderation.
Online multiplayer, chat and private messages require an internet connection. Please treat other players with respect and use the community tools responsibly.
WEEKLY MISSIONS AND VIRTUAL REWARDS
Complete weekly missions, level up and earn virtual bonuses while you play. Optional VIP features can include extra time in selected card games, automatic Bingo marking and cosmetic styles.
All coins, bonuses and rewards in Lua Chat are virtual and have no monetary value. Optional in-app purchases are available.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Lua Chat is intended for users who meet the minimum age shown on the App Store in their country or region and is provided for entertainment only. It is a social casino simulation and does not offer real-money gambling or the opportunity to win money or prizes of real-world value. Success in social casino games does not imply or guarantee future success in real-money gambling.
Need help or want to share feedback?
Email: support@luachat.com

apple-macos:6793098523.name: SwizzleSync
apple-macos:6793098523.description:
SwizzleSync is a secure communication platform that helps teams communicate faster, collaborate efficiently, and stay connected from anywhere.
SwizzleSync brings together direct messaging, group conversations, file sharing, and real-time communication in one place. Whether you're collaborating with a team, coordinating a project, or sharing updates, every conversation stays organised, secure, and instantly synchronised across your devices.
Why SwizzleSync?
Designed with productivity, reliability, and simplicity in mind, SwizzleSync lets you communicate without distractions - with fast message delivery, offline access, intelligent synchronisation, and strong security, so you can focus on the conversation instead of managing it.
Features
* Direct Messaging — secure one-to-one conversations with typing indicators, delivery status, and read receipts.
* Group Conversations — create dedicated discussions and keep everyone on the same page.
* Real-Time Communication — instant, reliable synchronisation across mobile and desktop.
* File & Media Sharing — share documents, images, and videos securely within any conversation.
* Smart Notifications — timely alerts for new messages, mentions, and updates.
* Offline Access — read recent conversations offline; messages sync automatically when you reconnect.
* Powerful Search — quickly find people, conversations, and shared files.
* Presence & Profiles — see who's online and available.
* Pinned Messages — highlight important information for quick access.
Built for Teams
SwizzleSync is designed for anyone who needs reliable, secure communication - whether working from an office, remotely, or across locations. A clean interface and dependable performance help reduce communication gaps and keep every conversation connected.
Download SwizzleSync and bring your conversations into one secure, reliable place.
